v: Ha juntzanh lolonel tik ix yal winhaj Moisés t'a heb' yetisraelal ayik ayek' heb' t'a yol yik Moab, t'a slak'anil jun chonhab' Zuf t'a tzinan lu'um t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a ha' Jordán, haton t'a lum Arabá, haton lum ay t'a yichanh ha' Chakchak Mar. Ayek' heb' t'a snanhal chonhab' Parán yet' juntzanhxo chonhab' tik, haton Tofel, Labán, Hazerot yet' Dizahab. Ayik toxo ix satjiel chawanh heb' rey yuj winhaj Moisés yet' heb' soldado Israel, haton winhaj Sehón sreyal heb' amorreo kajan t'a Hesbón yet' winhaj Og sreyal Basán kajan t'a Astarot yet' t'a Edrei, hata' yal winhaj Moisés chi' tas schek Jehová yal winh t'a heb'. Uxluche' k'ual stek'nab'il t'a lum witz Horeb, sb'at t'a switzal Seir masanto sk'och t'a Cades-barnea. Wach'chom icha chi', palta ha t'a b'ab'el k'u yik yuxluchil uj yik stz'akwi 40 ab'il yelta heb' t'a Egipto, haton ta' ix yal winhaj Moisés tas syalelk'och juntzanh cheknab'il yalnak Jehová t'a winh yuj heb' schonhab'. Ix yalan winh icha tik:
Ha Jehová ko Diosal lolonnak t'ayonh t'a lum witz Horeb, yalannak icha tik: Niwanxo tiempo eyajek' t'a yichtak jun witz tik.

Ha tiknaik, ixikekxi, tzex b'atkan t'a lum switzal yik heb' amorreo yet' t'a masanil yol smakb'en heb' t'a Arabá, t'a tzalkixtak, t'a ch'olkixtak, t'a Neguev yet' t'a stitak ha' mar, t'a lum yik heb' Kananeo yet' t'a masanil yoltak yik Líbano masanto t'a ha' niwan Éufrates,

yujto toxo ix wak' lum lum chi' t'a yol he k'ab'. Ochanhek kajan t'ay yujto wak'nak in ti' wak'an lum t'a heb' he mam eyicham, haton winhaj Abraham, winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Jacob yet' t'ayex yinhtilal ex heb', xchi Jehová t'ayonh.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi' walnak t'ayex: Manh ol yal-laj ex wilan in ch'okoj.
Tzijtum kuninal ix ak'ji yuj Jehová ko Diosal, yuj chi' a wal tiknaik, te niwan chonhab'xo onh aji, lajanxo ko b'isul icha k'een k'anal ay t'a satcha'anh to manh b'ischajb'enok.
Aokab' Jehová ko Diosal, sDiosal pax heb' ko mam kicham, a tz'ak'an q'uib' ko b'isul t'a smilalxo, ek'b'al t'a yichanh icha ko b'isul tiknaik. Yak'okab' wal swach'k'olal, icha wal ix aj yak'an sti'.
Yuj chi' max yal-laj wuj in ch'okoj ex wilani yet' in b'oanel masanil owal yet' chaklajb'ail ay t'a he kal.
Yuj chi', sik'ekel heb' winh te ay sjelanil t'a skal junjun inhtilal, haton heb' aj pensar, heb' ojtakab'ilxo to syal yuj, a juntzanh heb' chi' ol wak'och eyajalilok, xin chi.
Haxo he tak'wi: Scha ko k'ool masanil tas ix a na' chi', xe chi.

Icha chi' aj in sik'anel t'a skal junjun eyinhtilal heb' winh ay spensar, niwan yelk'ochi, wak'anoch yopisio heb' winh yoch eyajalilok: Ay heb' winh wak'och yajalil t'a mil anima, t'a kien, t'a kinkuenta yet' t'a lajunhwanh, slaj och heb' winh yajalil chi' t'a yinhtilal.

Hanhejtona' wak'an juntzanh cheknab'il tik t'a heb' eyajalil chi': Tzeyila' tato ay owal ma telajb'ail sk'e waan t'a skal heb' ketchonhab', tato ay tas ay t'a skal chawanhok heb', mato ay tas ay t'a skal junok yet' junok ch'ok chonhab'il, wach'nhej tzeyutej he b'oan yaj t'a heb' t'a stojolal.

Ayik tze b'oan yaj t'a heb', malajokab' sk'exanhil heb' t'a yol he sat. Lajannhej tzeyutej t'a heb' emnakiltak yet' t'a heb' niwak yelk'ochi. Mokab'a junok b'aj tzex xiwi, yujto a jun eyopisio chi', manh eyikok, yujto ak'b'il t'ayex yuj Dios. Tato ay wal tas te niwan yaj jun, tzeyik'kot t'ayin, a inxo ol in b'o yaj t'a heb', xin chi t'a heb'.
Hata' walnak masanil t'a heb' tastak yowalil sk'ulej heb'.

Ayik kel t'a lum witz Horeb, ko t'inhb'anb'at t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol yik heb' amorreo, yuj ko k'anab'ajan tas syal Jehová ko Diosal. Te ay smay eyila' ayik onh ek'nhej t'a jun niwan tzinan lum chi', masanto onh k'och t'a Cades-barnea.
Hata' wal t'ayex to toxo onh k'och t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol yik heb' amorreo, haton jun chi' ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayonh.
Ochanhek an, iq'ek ek' lu'um, kajnajanhek ta', icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'ayonh, haton ko Diosal yet' heb' ko mam kicham. Manh ex xiwok, mokab' chab'axk'e he k'ool, xin chi.

Ha exxo tik ul eyal t'ayin: Te wach' ama tato ay jaywanhok onh tzonh b'ab'laj b'ati yik tzonh b'at kil juntzanh chonhab' chi', tzonh paxta yik tzul kalani tas b'eal b'aj ol onh b'atok yet' tas chonhab'il b'aj ol onh ochok, xe chi.
Ha tas eyal chi', wach' wab'i. Yuj chi' in sik'el lajchawanh winak t'a he kal, junjun t'a junjun inhtilal.
Haton heb' chi' b'at t'a tzalkixtak, sk'och heb' t'a sch'olanil Escol, yek'chaj heb' t'a juntzanh lugar chi' smasanil.
Slajwi chi' yik'ankot heb' jab'ok sat tas awab'il t'a jun lu'um chi' t'ayonh. Ha yuj tas yal heb' chi', yuj chi' nachajel kuuj to te wach' lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayonh.
Ha exxo tik, maj yal he k'ol ex b'at t'a jun lu'um chi', palta to he tenek' tas yal Jehová ko Diosal.
Haxo b'aj ayex ek' chi', ex och ijan eyalan icha tik: Ha Jehová malaj snib'ej t'ayonh, yuj chi' onh yik'elta t'a Egipto yujnhej onh yak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' amorreo, yik tzonh satanel heb'.

Haxo tiknaik jun, ¿b'ajtil ol onh b'atok? Ha heb' ketchonhab' tz'alani to hata' ay heb' winh winak te tek'an, niwak winak, chaanh steel heb' winh t'a kichanh, niwak chonhab' juntzanh schonhab' heb', te chaanh yajoch smuroal spatiktak. Ix yilanpax juntzanh niwak winak yinhtilal winhaj Anac heb'. Ha yuj masanil juntzanh chi', junelnhej ix chab'axk'e ko k'ool, xe chi.
Ichato chi' in tak'wi: Manh ex xiw yuj juntzanh chi'.
Ha Jehová ko Diosal ol b'ab'laj t'a kichanh, ha' ol ak'an owal kuuj, icha wal tas ix aj kilan tas ix sk'ulej kuuj t'a Egipto,
yet' t'a tzinan lu'um. Yet' wal yipal onh yik'ankot t'a yoltak b'e t'a tzinan lum chi', masanto ix yal ko jawi t'a tik, icha wal junok mamab'il to sya'ilej yal yuninal, xin chi.
Palta a ex tik maj eyak'och Jehová ko Diosal t'a he k'ool.
Ha wal Jehová chi' b'ab'el t'a kichanh. Ha t'ak'walil syak' sakil k'inal t'ayonh icha junok k'ak', haxo t'a k'ualil, sch'oxpax yet' jun asun b'aj tzonh b'ati yet' b'aj tzonh och waan.
Ayik yab'an Jehová tas eyal chi', te kot yowal, yak'an sti' icha tik:
Malaj wal junok juntzanh winak te chuk spensar tik ol ilan lum lum wak'nak in ti' wak'an t'a he mam eyicham.
Anhej winhaj Caleb yuninal winhaj Jefone ol ilan lu'um, yuj chi' ha t'a winh yet' yinhtilal ol wak' lum xit' eyil chi', yujto ix sk'anab'ajej winh yet' smasanil sk'ol tas ix wala', xchi Jehová chi'.
Eyuj wal a ex tik, yuj chi' kotpax yowal Jehová t'ayin, yalan t'ayin icha tik: Manh ol ach ochpaxlaj t'a lu'um a ach tik.

Ha winhaj Josué yuninal winhaj Nun skolwaj het'ok, a winh ol och a k'exulok. Yuj chi' iptzitej winh yujto a winh ol ak'an jun lu'um chi' t'a heb' etisraelal tik, xchi t'ayin. Yalanpax t'ayex icha tik:

Wach'chom a ex tik tzeyak'och t'a he k'ool to ol ochkan heb' eyuninal chekab'ok t'a heb' ajk'ool, palta a heb' eyuninal mantalaj spensar chi', ol och heb' t'a jun lu'um chi'. Ha in ol wak' lum smakb'enok heb'.
Yakb'an manto elk'ochlaj, meltzajanhek t'a tzinan lu'um, tzex b'atkan junelxo t'a b'e sk'och t'a ha' Chakchak Mar, xchi Jehová chi' t'ayin.

Ha ex tik, eyal t'ayin icha tik: Ix och ko mul t'a Jehová ko Diosal, palta a tiknaik jun, koyek, kaq'ek kip icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová t'ayonh, xe chi. Eyik'anb'at eyamk'ab' yik owal, a he naani to sekojtak ol aj eyik'an lum tzalkixtak chi'.

Palta a Jehová halani to swal t'ayex: Manh eyak' owal, manh he tek'b'ej he b'a t'a heb' ajk'ool, haxo talaj tz'aji tzex yak'an ganar heb', yujto manh ol in b'atlaj heyet'ok, xchi Jehová, xa chi, xchi t'ayin.
Wak' juntzanh chi' eyojtakejeli, palta a ex tik maj he chalaj eyab'i. Haxo aji, he tenek' tas yal Jehová chi', eyak'an icha he gana, k'e ex t'a tzalkixtak chi'.
Yuj chi' a heb' amorreo kajan ta', elta heb' t'ayex icha nok' nok'al chab', masanto yal ex yak'an ganar heb' t'a Seir, k'ochnhej heb' t'a Horma.
Haxo yik ex meltzaj jun, och ex ijan eyok' t'a yichanh Jehová, palta majxo tak'woklaj t'ayex.
Yuj chi' te niwan tiempoal onh ek' t'a yol smakb'en Cades chi'.
Slajwi chi', ko b'at t'a tzinan lu'um, t'a b'e sk'och t'a ha' Chakchak Mar, icha wal aj yalan Jehová t'ayin. Te niwan tiempoal onh ek' t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Seir.
Slajwi chi', yalan Jehová t'ayin:
Te niwan tiempo ex ek' oyoyok t'a lum tzalkixtak tik. Ixikekxi tiknaik t'a stojolal norte.

Al juntzanh cheknab'il tik t'a heb' etchonhab' to ha t'a yol yik heb' he k'ab' eyok ol ex ek'ok, haton heb' yinhtilal winhaj Esaú, heb' kajan t'a Seir. Ha heb' chi' ol xiw heb' t'ayex. Anhej jun, tze tanhwej wal he b'a,
mokab' eyak' owal yet' heb', yujto malaj jab'ok slum heb' ol wak' t'ayex, yujto masanil lum tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Seir chi', yiknhej lum heb' yinhtilal winhaj Esaú chi'. Ha in wak'nak lum t'a heb'.
Yuj chi' ol he man masanil tas ol he wa t'a heb', ol he tup ha ha' ol eyuk'ej, xchi t'ayin.

Ha Jehová ko Diosal chi' yak'nak wal swach'k'olal t'a kib'anh t'a masanil tas ko k'ulej. Ha t'a jun 40 ab'il tik, aynhejoch ket'ok, tzonh stanhwejnhej b'aj tzonh ek' t'a jun niwan tzinan lu'um tik. Malaj b'aj ix yak' palta tas t'ayonh yuj.

Icha chi' aj ko kotnhej t'a stitak sluum heb' ko k'ab' kok, haton heb' yinhtilal winhaj Esaú kajan t'a Seir. Onh kotkan t'a b'e tzek' t'a Arabá, skot t'a Elat yet' t'a Ezión-geber. Ko meltzajpax t'a b'e tzek' t'a tzinan lum t'a yol yik Moab.

Haxo yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Manh he tzuntzej heb' moabita, yinhtilal winhaj Lot. Manh eyak' owal yet' heb', yujto malaj jab'ok slum heb' t'a yol smakb'en ol wak' t'ayex. Ha in wak'nak masanil smakb'en winhaj Ar t'a heb', xchi t'ayin.
(Hata' kajan heb' emita t'a peka'. Te niwan chonhab' yaj heb', chaanh steel heb', lajan wal heb' icha heb' yinhtilal winhaj Anac.
Refaíta heb', icha heb' yinhtilal winhaj Anac chi', palta emita tz'aj yalan heb' moabita chi' t'a heb'.

Ha t'a masanil smakb'en Seir, hata' ek'nak kajan heb' horeo. Haxo heb' yinhtilal winhaj Esaú pechannakel heb', satanel heb', haxo heb' kajnajnak t'a slum heb' chi', icha ix ko k'ulej a onh israel onh tik t'a lum lum ix yak' Jehová t'ayonh.)
Haxo aj jun, yalan Jehová: Ixikek tiknaik, tzex ek' t'a yol ha' takinh melem skuchan Zered, xchi, yuj chi' onh ek' ta'.

Atax t'a yik onh ek' t'a Cades-barnea, masanto pax t'a jun k'u onh ek'ta t'a yol ha' takinh melem Zered chi', atax ta' ix ek' 38 ab'il, yuj chi' a masanil heb' winh ketchonhab' stiempo sb'at t'a owal ayik kelta t'a Egipto, toxo ix cham heb' icha ajnak yak'an sti' Jehová.
Ha yowal sk'ol Jehová chi' ix kot t'a yib'anh heb', yuj chi' ix cham heb' smasanil.
Ayik manhxalaj junok juntzanh heb' winh winak chi',
yalan Jehová t'ayin:
Ha tiknaik ek'anhekb'at t'a smojonal yik Moab t'a chonhab' Ar.

Palta ayik tze chalan he b'a yet' heb' amonita, heb' yinhtilal pax winhaj Lot, manh he tzuntzej heb', manh eyak' owal yet' heb', yujto malaj jab'ok he makb'en ol wak' ta', yujto wak'nakxo jun lu'um chi' smakb'enok heb', xchi t'ayin.
(Hanhejtona', a jun lu'um chi' yik heb' refaíta t'a peka', yujto ek'nak kajan heb' ta', haton heb' skuchan zomzomeo yuj heb' amonita t'a peka'.

Ha jun chi', te niwan chonhab', tzijtum anima ay t'ay, te chaanh steel heb' icha heb' yinhtilal winhaj Anac. Ha Jehová ak'annak satel heb' yuj heb' amonita chi'. Ha heb' amonita chi' pechannakel heb', skajnajnakkan heb' ta'.
Lajan wal ajnak icha ajnak heb' yinhtilal winhaj Esaú, ayik sk'ochnak heb' t'a lum Seir. Ha Jehová ak'annak satel heb' horeo, skannakxonhej heb' yinhtilal winhaj Esaú t'a slum heb' chi'.
Icha pax chi' ajnak heb' aweo ayek' kajan t'a slak'anil Gaza. Ha heb' chi' satnakel heb' t'a junelnhej yuj heb' filisteo kotnak t'a Caftor. Icha chi' ajnak skajnajkan heb' filisteo chi' ta'.)

Yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ixikek, tzex k'axpajek' t'a ha' takinh melem Arnón, ol wak'och heb' amorreo t'a yol he k'ab' yet' winhaj Sehón, kajan t'a Hesbón, haton winh sreyal heb'. Hak'ek owal yet' heb', tzeyik'anek' sluum heb'.
Ha wal tiknaik tz'el yich wak'anoch junjun chonhab' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik t'a xiwk'olal t'ayex. Ayik ol yab'an he pekal heb', ol ib'xok'e heb', haxonhej xiwelal ol och t'a heb', xchi Jehová chi'.
Ha t'a tzinan lu'um yik Cademot, hata' in chekkot juntzanh chekab' t'a winhaj Sehón, haton winh rey kajan t'a Hesbón, yik wach' syal juntzanh tik heb' t'a wach'ilal t'a winh:
Sko nib'ej tzonh ek' t'a yol a makb'en, anhej t'a yol niwan b'e ol onh ek'ok, malaj b'aj ol onh komon b'atkan t'a yol a chonhab' chi'.
Ol ko tup tas ol kab'lej yet' ha ha' ol kuk'ej. Anhej to sko k'an t'ayach to tzonh ek' t'a yol a makb'en chi',

masanto ol yal ko k'axpaj t'a ha' Jordán, ol onh k'och t'a lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayonh, icha ix onh yutej schaan ek'ta heb' yinhtilal winhaj Esaú kajan t'a Seir yet' heb' moabita kajanpax t'a Ar, xin chikot t'a winh.

Palta a winhaj Sehón chi', maj yal-laj sk'ol winh onh scha ek'ta t'a yol smakb'en chi', yujto a Jehová ko Diosal ix ak'an sk'ulej winh yik malaj snib'ej winh, yik skan heb' t'a yol ko k'ab', icha chi' ix aji.
Yuj chi' yal Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ha wal t'a jun rato tik swak'och winhaj Sehón yet' smakb'en t'a yol he k'ab'. Ochanhek tiknaik t'a yol smakb'en tik, yik tz'ochkan eyikok, xchi t'ayin.
Ix elta winhaj Sehón chi' onh scha yet' masanil soldado, yik syak' owal heb' ket'ok t'a Jahaza.
Haxo Jehová ko Diosal ix ak'anoch winh t'a yol ko k'ab'. Ix ko satanel winh yet' yuninal yet' masanil schonhab'.

Masanil junjun chonhab' t'a yol smakb'en winh ix ak'jioch t'a yol ko k'ab', ix ko satankanel t'a junelnhej. Ix ko milcham heb' smasanil yet' heb' ix ix yet' masanil unin. Manhxo junok pitzan ix kan kuuj.
Anhej juntzanh tastak ix kik'kani, haton masanil nok' nok' yet' juntzanh tas ix ilchaj kuuj t'a juntzanh chonhab' ix ko satel chi'.

Ix kikej slum heb' chi' smasanil, skotnhej t'a Aroer ay t'a spanhanil stitak ha' Arnón masanto t'a Galaad yet' masanil juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a sch'olanil ha' Arnón chi'. Manhxalaj mach ix stek'b'ej sb'a t'a kichanh, yujto a Jehová ko Diosal ix ak'anoch heb' t'a yol ko k'ab'.
Palta a onh tik, maj onh ochlaj t'a schonhab' heb' amonita ay t'a tzalkixtak, ma pax t'a sti' ha' Jaboc, icha wal ix yutej yalan Jehová t'ayonh.
Ixlajwi chi', ch'okxo junxo b'e ix kik'a', ix onh b'atkan t'a Basán, palta a winhaj Og, sreyal jun chonhab' chi', ix elta winh yet' smasanil soldado yak' owal ket'ok t'a Edrei.

Yuj chi', ix yalan Jehová t'ayin: Manh ex xiwok, yujto a jun winh chi' yet' soldado yet' schonhab' toxo ix wak'och t'a yol he k'ab' yik tze sataneli, icha ix eyutej winhaj Sehón sreyal heb' amorreo kajan t'a Hesbón, xchi t'ayin.
Icha chi' ix yutej Jehová ko Diosal yak'an winhaj Og chi' yet' schonhab' t'a yol ko k'ab'. Ix ko milancham heb' smasanil, manhxalaj junok pitzan ix kan kuuj.
Ix kak'anpax ganar masanil junjun chonhab' t'a yol smakb'en winh. Manhxa junok maj kak' ganar, syalelk'ochi, masanil yol yik Argob t'a yol smakb'en winhaj Og t'a Basán, 60 chonhab' chi' smasanil.
Masanil juntzanh chonhab' chi', te chaanh yajoch smuroal, spuertail yet' k'een k'een k'atanoch syamnub'alok spuertail chi'. Tzijtum pax chonhab' malaj smuroal ix ko sateli.
Masanil juntzanh chi' ix ko sateli, icha ix ko k'ulej yet' winhaj Sehón sreyal Hesbón. Yuj chi' ix ko satel masanil heb' winh winak yet' heb' ix ix yet' masanil heb' unin.
Haxonhej nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' kajk'ol chi' yet' masanil tastak ay t'a heb' ix kik'kani.

Icha wal chi' ix aj yak'ji slum heb' amorreo t'a yol ko k'ab' t'a jun pekti' chi', haton heb' kajan t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a ha' Jordán, sb'atnhej t'a ha' takinh melem Arnón, masanto sk'och t'a switzal Hermón.
(Ha jun witz chi' Sirión sb'i yuj heb' aj Sidón, haxo heb' amorreo, Senir sb'i yuj heb'.)
Masanil juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol smakb'en winhaj Og t'a Basán, ix kak' ganar, haton juntzanh chonhab' t'a lum panhan, masanil t'a yol yik Galaad yet' Basán, masanto t'a Salca yet' Edrei.

(Haxonhej winhaj rey Og yinhtilal heb' anima chanh steel aykan t'a jun lugar chi'. Ha skaxail winh yik smukil, nab'a k'een. Chanhe' wal metro steel, kenxonhej manh chab'ok metro sat, chekelto t'a chonhab' Rabá t'a yol yik heb' amonita.)

Ha lum lum ix ko makkan t'a jun pekti' chi', ix wak' lum yikok heb' junjun chonhab'il t'a yinhtilalkan Rubén yet' t'a heb' yinhtilalkan Gad, haton lum skotnhej t'a Aroer, t'a stitak ha' takinh melem Arnón, masanto sjawi t'a snanhal switzal lum Galaad.
Haxo janik'xo lum Galaad chi' jun, masanil lum Basán, haton smakb'en winhaj Og t'a yalanhtaxo yet' pax lum Argob, ojtakab'il to slum heb' refaíta. Ha lum chi' ix wak' t'a nanhal yinhtilalkan Manasés.
(Ha winhaj Jair, yinhtilal Manasés chi' ix ik'ankan lum Argob, masanto t'a smojonal lum Gesur yet' Maaca. Ix yak'anoch sb'i winh t'a Basán chi', yuj chi' Havot-Jair ix sb'iejnhejkani.)
Ha t'a winhaj Maquir ix wak' lum Galaad chi'.

Haxo t'a yinhtilalkan Rubén yet' t'a yik Gad ix wak' lum ay t'a snanhal Galaad yet' ha' takinh melem Arnón. Ha t'a snanhal yol ch'olan ay smojonal, masanto sk'och t'a ha' takinh melem Jaboc, haton t'a smojonal yik heb' amonita.

Ha smojonal b'aj tz'em k'u, haton ha' Jordán, sk'ochnhej t'a ha' nhajab' Cineret, masanto sk'och t'a ha' mar yik Arabá, haton ha' mar Muerto, haton t'a yich switzal Pisga, t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a ha' mar Muerto chi'.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ix wak' juntzanh cheknab'il tik t'a heb' yinhtilalkan Rubén, t'a heb' yik Gad yet' t'a nanhalxo heb' yinhtilalkan Manasés. Ix walan icha tik: Ha Jehová ko Diosal ix ak'an jun lu'um tik he makb'enok. Haxo masanil heb' winh winak syal yak'an owal t'a he kal, b'ab'lajokab' heb' winh t'a yichanh heb' ketisraelal tik.
Haxonhej heb' ix eyetb'eyum yet' heb' eyuninal skan t'a he chonhab' ix wak' chi' yet' nok' he molb'etzal nok'. Wojtak to tzijtum nok' nok' molb'il eyuuj.

Kolwajanhek yet' heb' ketisraelal, masanto ol yik'kan lum lum heb' ol yak' Jehová, haton t'a sk'axepalek' ha' Jordán tik. Haton wal yik ol yak'an sjunk'olal Jehová t'a heb', icha ix yutej yak'an t'ayex tik, ichato chi' ol yal he paxta t'a he lum ix wak' tik, xin chi t'a heb'.
Ha t'a winhaj Josué ix wak' jun cheknab'il tik: Ix kil wal tastak ix sk'ulej Jehová ko Diosal yet' chawanh rey tik. Icha chi' ol yutok t'a masanil heb' rey t'a yoltak smakb'en b'aj ol ach ek'nhej.
Manh ach xiwok, yujto a Jehová ko Diosal ol ak'an owal kuuj, xin chi t'a winh.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi' ix in tewi t'a Jehová, ix walan icha tik:

Mamin Jehová, a ach ix a chael yich a ch'oxani to te niwan elk'ochi, ix a ch'oxan a poder t'ayin a chekab' in tik. Malaj junokxo Dios t'a satcha'anh, ma t'a sat lu'um tik syal sk'ulan tastak satub'tak icha tza k'ulej tik.
Yuj chi' tzin tewi t'ayach to tzin a chaek' t'a junxo sk'axepalek' ha' Jordán, yujto tzin nib'ej swil jun tzalkixtak manhxo jantakok swach'il yet' switzaltak Líbano, xin chi.
Palta eyujnhej ix kot yowal Jehová chi' t'ayin. Maj schalaj yab' tas ix in k'an chi' t'ay, palta ix yal t'ayin icha tik: k'okb'ilxo chi', manhxo al jun lolonel chi' t'ayin.
Anhej tzach k'e t'a jolom witz Pisga, scham wal ilankanb'at lum t'a norte, t'a sur, b'aj sjawi k'u yet' b'aj tz'em k'u, yujto manhxo ol ach k'axpajek' t'a ha' Jordán chi'.
Yuj chi' tza k'ayb'ej wal winhaj Josué sik'lab'il, yujto a winh ol kuchb'an in chonhab' tik. Ha winh ol pojanek' jun lum tzilkanb'at tik, xchi Jehová chi' t'ayin.
Icha chi' ix aj ko kan t'a ch'olan t'a yichanh Bet-peor.

Ha tiknaik jun, ex wetchonhab' Israel, ab'ek wal cheknab'il yet' b'eyb'al ol wal t'ayex, yik tze k'anab'ajej yet' he b'eyb'alani, yik wach' ol yal eyoch t'a sat lum lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayex, sDiosal pax heb' ko mam kicham. Ol ex kajnajkan ta'.
Manh ol eyak'och stz'akub' juntzanh lolonel ol wal tik t'ayex, ma ol eyik'eli, palta to ol he k'anab'ajej scheknab'il Jehová ko Diosal icha wal tz'aj walan tik t'ayex.
Eyilnak wal tas utajnak heb' ochnak ejmelal t'a jun Dios Baal yik Peor, wal t'a eyichanh satjinakel heb' yuj Jehová.
Ha exxo pax tik ochnak ex tzak'an yuj Jehová, ina pitzan exto.
Scham wal eyab'ankani to a k'ayb'ub'al yet' cheknab'il yik Jehová ko Diosal swalkanel t'ayex, yik wach' ol he b'eyb'alej ayik ol he chaan lum lum chi' he makb'enok.

Scham wal he k'anab'ajan juntzanh cheknab'il tik, yik ol cheklajel t'a yichanh juntzanh nakión to te jelan ex. Ayik ol yab'an juntzanh cheknab'il tze k'anab'ajej tik heb', ol yalan heb' icha tik: Yelton wal te jelan jun chonhab' tik, niwan nakión ton wal, xcham heb'.
Malaj junokxo niwan nakión ayek' sdiosal yet'ok, icha wal yajek' Jehová ko Diosal t'a ko kal tik, skolwaj ket'ok ayik tzonh awaj t'ay.
Malaj junokxo nakión ay sk'ayb'ub'al yet' scheknab'il tojol yaj icha jun k'ayb'ub'al swalkanel t'ayex tik tiknaik.

Yuj chi', k'anab'ajejek, sik'ekkan t'a he pensar, yik wach' max b'at satk'olal eyuuj t'a tas ix eyila', manh eyik'el juntzanh tik t'a he pensar yakb'an pitzan ex, tzeyalkan t'a heb' eyuninal yet' t'a heb' eyi he chikin.

Naekkot t'a yik jun k'u ayik ayonhek' t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal t'a lum witz Horeb, ayik yalannak t'ayin icha tik: Molb'ej heb' etchonhab' smasanil yik wach' ol wak' yojtakejel in lolonel heb', ol sk'ayb'ankan heb', yik wach' ay welk'och t'a yol sat heb' yakb'an pitzan heb' t'a sat lum tik yet' sk'ayb'ankan yuninal heb', xchi Jehová chi' t'ayin.
Ayik ayonhek' t'a yich lum witz chi', haxo t'a lu'um sk'e wal k'ak' yet' sk'e topan stab'il t'a chaanh, k'ik'xonhej yilji satcha'anh yuj.
Lolonnak Jehová t'ayonh t'a kal k'ak' chi'. Kab'nak wal yoch sjaj sloloni, palta maj kilochlaj jab'ok.
Ayik yalannakkan strato ket'ok, yalnak to sko k'anab'ajej lajunhe' cheknab'il stz'ib'ejnakoch t'a chab' pachanh k'een k'een.
Yalannakpax Jehová t'ayin to tzex in k'ayb'ej t'a scheknab'il yet' t'a sk'ayb'ub'al chi', yik wach' tze k'anab'ajej he b'eyb'alan t'a sat lum lum ol he makb'enej t'a sk'axepalek' ha' Jordán chi'.
Ayik slolonnak Jehová t'ayonh t'a lum witz Horeb chi', ha t'a jun k'u chi', malaj junok tas eyil t'a kal k'ak' chi'.
Naek wal koti yik max eyixtejb'at he b'a he b'oank'e junok yechel tas he diosalok, yechel junok winak, ma yechel junok ix ix,
ma yechel nok' nok' ay t'a sat lu'um tik, ma yechel nok' much,
ma yechel junok nok' tzek' nhererok, ma tzek' jachjon t'a sat lu'um tik, ma yechel nok' chay, ma junokxo nok' ay t'a yol ha ha'.

Hanhejtona' ayik tzex k'e k'elan t'a satcha'anh tzeyilank'e k'u, k'een uj yet' jantak k'een k'anal yet' masanil tastak ay t'a satchanh chi', tzeyil wal he b'a, yik max och t'a he pensar to tzex och ejmelal t'ay, ma tzeyalan he b'a t'ay, yujto a Jehová Dios ixb'o'an masanil juntzanh chi' yik tz'och yopisio t'a masanil chonhab' ay t'a sat lu'um tik.

Palta a Jehová onh ik'annakelta t'a chonhab' Egipto b'aj manh jantakok syaelal b'aj ayonh ochi, ichato ayonh och t'a skal junok niwan k'ak' b'aj tz'ulax k'een k'een. Onh yik'elta yik wach' tzonh och schonhab'ok, ichaton kaj tiknaik.
Kotnak yowal Jehová chi' t'ayin eyuuj. Yalannak to manhxo ol in ek' t'a sk'axepal ha' Jordán, manhxo ol in k'och t'a sat lum lum manh jantakok swach'il ol yak' he makb'enok chi'.
Yuj chi', ha t'a tik ol in chamok, manhxo ol in k'axpajek'laj t'a ha' Jordán chi'. Ha exxo tik, ol ex k'axpajek'ok, ol ex kajnaj t'a lum lum manh jantakok swach'il chi'.
B'at ta wal strato Jehová ko Diosal satk'olal eyuuj, haton strato ix yak' ket'ok. Malajokab' junok yechel tze b'o'o, yik tzeyaloch he diosalok, yujto ay yowalil yuj Jehová.
Skot yowal Jehová t'a mach tz'och ejmelal t'a junokxo tasi. Ha wal yowal sk'ol lajan icha te' k'ak' stz'ab'at masanil tastak yuj.

Ha tiknaik toxo ol ex k'och kajan t'a jun lu'um chi', palta ayik niwanxo tiempo ayex ek' ta', ayik ayxo eyuninal yet' eyi he chikin, tzeyil wal he b'a, xe yixtejtab'atlaj he b'a tze b'oank'e junok yechel he diosalok, tzeyak'anoch he mul t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal. Tato icha chi', ol he tzuntzejkot yowal sk'ool ko Diosal chi'.

Swak'kanoch satcha'anh yet' sat lu'um tik testigoal, tato icha chi' ol he k'ulej, t'a wal elanhchamel ol ex satel t'a junelnhej. Manhxo niwanok tiempo ol ex ek' t'a sat lu'um chi', haton lum ay t'a sk'axepal ha' Jordán chi'.
Haxo jaywanhok ex olto ex kanok, ol ex saklemkanb'at t'a juntzanhxo ch'ok nakional, hata' ol ex yak'kanb'at Jehová.

Hata' ol eyak'em he b'a t'a juntzanh komon Dios b'ob'il yuj heb' anima t'a te te' yet' t'a k'een k'een, max yal-laj yilani, max yab'laj, max yal-laj swaan junok tasi, max yab'paxlaj jab'ok sjab' junok tas.
Palta tato t'a skal eyaelal chi' sna sb'a he k'ool, tze naankoti to anhej t'a Jehová ko Diosal smoj eyak'anem he b'a, tato tzeyalxi he b'a t'ay, tze k'anab'ajan t'a smasanil he k'ool, tato icha chi',
manh ol ex yaktejkanlaj. Manh ol ex satjiel yuj t'a junelnhej, manh ol b'at satk'olal strato yak'nak yet' heb' ko mam kicham, yujto aynhej yok'elk'olal.

Naekkot juntzanh tiempoal ek'nakb'at t'a peka', atax sb'oannak heb' anima ko Mam Dios t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, b'at he k'anb'an b'aj sk'och k'aman yol yib'anhk'inal tik, tato ayxo b'aj ix uji, ma ayxo b'aj ix ab'chaj junok tas te niwan yelk'och icha jun tzuji t'a ko kal tik.
Malaj junokxo chonhab' ix ab'an yoch sjaj ko Mam Dios, yik slolonelta t'a kal k'ak', icha wal aj kab'an a onh tik, palta maj onh champaxlaj.

Malaj junokxo Dios sik'anelta junok chonhab' t'a skal junokxo chonhab' icha wal ajnak onh yik'anelta Jehová t'a Egipto yuj ko wach'ilok. Kilnak wal ayik sch'oxan jantak spoder yak'an owal kuuj, sch'oxannak juntzanh tas satub'tak yilji yet' yaelal yet' xiwk'olal ayik onh yik'anelta t'a Egipto chi'.
Ha juntzanh chi' ch'oxji wal kila', yik skojtakej wal eli to malaj junokxo Dios, anhejton wal Jehová.
Hato t'a satcha'anh kab'nak wal sloloni, onh sk'ayb'ani. Haxo t'a sat lum tik, sch'oxnak niwak k'ak' t'ayonh, kab'annak wal slolonelta t'a kal k'ak' chi'.
Ha wal Jehová xajanannak heb' ko mam kicham, yuj chi' onh sik'nakkanel a onh yinhtil onh kan heb'. Slajwi chi' onh yik'anelta t'a Egipto, aynhej och ket'ok yet' wal spoder.
Wan satanel juntzanh niwak chonhab' te ek'to yip t'ayonh yik skikejkan slum heb' chi', icha wal wan yuji tiknaik.
Yuj chi', kanokab' t'a he pensar to anhej Jehová Dios yaj t'a satcha'anh yet' t'a sat lu'um tik, malaj junokxo.

Yuj chi' k'anab'ajejek sk'ayb'ub'al yet' scheknab'il swalkanel t'ayex t'a jun k'u tik, yik wach' ol aj yek' tiempo eyuuj yet' heb' eyinhtilal. Ol najatb'ok he k 'inal t'a sat lum lum ix yak' Jehová t'ayex t'a junelnhej, xchi winhaj Moisés t'a heb' chonhab' israel.
Ix sik'anel oxe' chonhab' winhaj Moisés t'a sk'axepalek' ha' Jordán t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u.
Hata' syal skolan sb'a junok mach smak'ancham junok yetanimail to manh sk'anok sk'ool, malaj b'aj syak' owal yet'ok t'a yalanhtaxo. Ha jun chi', syal skolan sb'a t'a junjunok juntzanh chonhab' chi'.

Ha juntzanh chonhab' chi', haton Beser t'a yak'likal tzinan lu'um makb'il yuj heb' yinhtilalkan Rubén, Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad, makb'il yuj heb' yinhtilalkan Gad. Haxo junxo, haton Golán, ay t'a yol yik Basán, makb'il yuj heb' yinhtilalkan Manasés.
(Haton wal juntzanh cheknab'il tik ix yal winhaj Moisés t'a heb' yetchonhab'. Ha jantak k'ayb'ub'al, kachnab'il yet' cheknab'il tik ix yal winh t'a heb' atax yelnakkot heb' t'a Egipto.

Ix yal juntzanh tik winh ayik aytoek' heb' t'a ak'lik t'a yichanh chonhab' Bet-peor, t'a slak'anil sti' ha' Jordán, t'a lum makb'il yuj winhaj Sehón sreyal heb' amorreo. Ha winhaj Sehón chi', ha t'a chonhab' Hesbón ek'nak winh. Ak'b'il ganar winh yuj winhaj Moisés chi' yet' heb' yetchonhab' ayik ayxo yelta heb' t'a Egipto.

Icha chi' ix aj skan heb' israel t'a lum smakb'en winhaj Sehón chi' yet' t'a lum makb'il yuj winhaj Og sreyal Basán t'a yalanhtaxo. Ha heb' tik sreyal heb' amorreo t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a ha' Jordán.
Ha lu'um chi' sb'atnhej lum t'a chonhab' Aroer t'a stitak ha' Arnón, masanto t'a niwan witz Sirión, hanheja' skuchanpax Hermón.
Masanil smakb'en heb' chi', haton panhan ay t'a sti' ha' Jordán t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, masanto sk'och lum t'a ha' mar Muerto, haton t'a yich lum witz Pisga.)

Ix smolb'an masanil heb' yetisraelal winhaj Moisés, ix yalan winh t'a heb': Ex wetchonhab', ab'ek wal tiknaik, ol walkan juntzanh kachnab'il yet' cheknab'il t'ayex, yik scham wal he k'ayb'ani yet' he b'eyb'alani.
Ha Jehová ko Diosal yak'nak jun strato ket'ok t'a lum witz skuchan Horeb.
Manhoknhej yet' heb' ko mam kicham yak'nak strato chi', palta yak'nakpax ket'ok ko masanil a onh molan onh ek' tik.
Ha wal Jehová lolonnak t'ayonh t'a jolom witz chi', kab'nak wal tas yal chi' ayik slolonelta t'a kal k'ak'.
Ha in kan in t'a he nanhal yet' Jehová chi' yik swal t'ayex tas syala', yujto ex xiwk'e t'a jun k'ak' chi', maj ex k'e t'a jolom witz chi', yalan Jehová chi' icha tik:
Ha in Jehová he Diosal in, ex wik'elta t'a Egipto b'aj ayex och chekab'ok, manh eyikok he b'a.
Malajokab' junokxo Dios b'aj tzex och ejmelal, palta anhejokab' t'ayin.
Malajokab' junok yechel junok tas tze b'ooch he diosalok, tas ay t'a satcha'anh, tas ay t'a sat lum tik, ma tastak ay t'a yoltak ha ha'.

Manh ex em nhojan t'ay, manh eyak'em he b'a t'ay, yujto a in Jehová he Diosal in, ste kot wowal t'ayex tato tzex och ejmelal t'a junokxo tasi. Ol wak'och syaelal heb' mamab'il malaj welk'och t'ay, ol wak'anpax yaelal t'a yib'anh yuninal heb', yixchikin heb' yet' yinhtilal heb'.
Haxo heb' tzin xajanani, sk'anab'ajan in cheknab'il, ol in xajanej heb' yet' yinhtilal yik ol b'eynhejb'atok.
Manh komonok tze lok in b'i a in Jehová he Diosal in tik, ma tzeyak' b'inaj in b'i t'a junok tas t'a ichnhej ta', yujto ol wak' yaelal t'a mach icha chi' sk'ulej.
Niwanokab' yelk'och sk'ual ik'oj ip t'ayex yuj in eyik'anchaanh, icha ix aj walankan t'ayex.
Wake' k'ual tzex munlaj t'a he munlajel.

Haxo t'a yukil k'ual, sk'ual ik'oj ip, wik yaji. Manh ex munlaj t'a jun k'u chi', ma heb' eyuninal, heb' ix eyisil, heb' winh he chekab', ma heb' ix he chekab', nok' he wakax, nok' he chej, ma junokxo nok' he molb'etzal nok', ma heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal, palta masanil heb' syik' yip heyet'ok.
Naekkoti to ek'nakex chekab'wumal t'a Egipto. Ha inxo Jehová he Diosal in tik wik'nakexelta yet' in poder. Yuj chi' swala' to tze k'anab'ajej sk'ual ik'oj ip.
Ayokab' yelk'och he mam he nun t'a he sat, icha wal ix aj walan t'ayex, yik wach' ol najatb'ok he k 'inal, yik wach' ol ex ajek' t'a sat lum lum ol wak' chi' t'ayex.
Manh he milcham heb' eyetanimail.
Manh ex em ajmulal t'a yol sk'ab' eyetb'eyum junjun ex.
Manh ex elk'anok.
Manh he nak'e lolonel t'a spatik heb' eyetanimail.

Manh he nib'ejoch ix yetb'eyum junokxo mach, spat, sluum, heb' winh schekab', heb' ix schekab', nok' swakax, nok' sb'uru, ma junokxo tas ay t'a heb' eyetanimail chi', manh he nib'ejochi, xchi Jehová t'ayonh.

Haton wal juntzanh cheknab'il tik te chaanh ajnak yalanelta Jehová t'a skal jun niwan k'ik'al asun ayoch sk'ak'al, ayik molan onh ek' ko masanil t'a yich lum witz chi'. Anhej wal juntzanh cheknab'il tik yalnak, ichato chi' stz'ib'anoch t'a chab' pachanh k'een k'een, yak'an t'ayin.

Palta a exxo tik, ayik eyab'an yoch jun jaj chi' t'a skal k'ik' k'inal chi', eyilan sk'e nhilnhon k'ak' t'a lum witz chi', masanil ex yajal eyaj t'a junjun eyinhtilal tik yet' heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab', ex jawi eyal t'ayin icha tik:

Wal yel, a Jehová ko Diosal ix sch'ox wal stzikikial yet' yipalil t'ayonh, ix kab' wal slolon t'a skal k'ak'. Ha tiknaik toxo ix nachaj wal el kuuj tob'an syal slolon Dios t'ayonh anima onh tik, palta ina maj onh chamlaj.
¿Tas yuj sko b'ek ko b'a ko cham yuj jun k'ak' to ayxo smay chi'? Tato ol kab' wal yoch sjaj Jehová ko Diosal junelxo, ol onh chamok.
Malaj wal junok anima syal yab'an yoch sjaj jun Dios pitzan t'a skal k'ak' icha ix kab' a onh tik, yujto ay schamelal.
Wach' a ach tzach och t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal chi' yik tzab'an masanil tas syala', slawi chi' tzalan t'ayonh masanil tas syal chi', ol ko k'anab'ajani, xe chi t'ayin.
Ayik wan eyalan chi' t'ayin, wan pax yab'an Jehová tas tzeyal chi', yuj chi' yal t'ayin: Toxo ix wab' tas syal jun chonhab' tik, ix scha in k'ol tas ix yal heb'.
Komonok ichanhej tik spensar heb', aynhej welk'och t'a yol sat heb', sk'anab'ajannhej in cheknab'il heb' yik wach' ol aj sb'eynhejb'at heb' yet' heb' yuninal t'a smasanil tiempo.
Yuj chi' al t'a heb' to smeltzaj heb' t'a skampamento.

Ha achxo tik, kananh wet' t'a tik, yujto ol wal masanil in cheknab'il t'ayach yet' in k'ayb'ub'al, ol a k'ayb'an heb' t'ay, yik wach' ol sb'eyb'alej heb' b'aj ay lum lum ol wak' chi' t'a heb', xchi Jehová chi' t'ayin.
Yuj chi' b'eyb'alejek masanil scheknab'il Jehová ko Diosal. Manh eyik'el t'a he pensar.
B'eyb'alejek b'eyb'al ix sch'oxkan Jehová ko Diosal, yik te wach'xonhej ol aj he b'eyb'ati, ol najatb'ok he k 'inal t'a sat lum lum ol yak' chi' t'ayex.
Haton wal juntzanh k'ayb'ub'al, cheknab'il yet' kachnab'il tik ix schek Jehová ko Diosal wal t'ayex, yowalil ol he k'anab'ajej ayik ol eyik'an lum lum t'a sk'axepal ha' Jordán.

k'anab'ajejek cheknab'il swal tik t'ayex yet' heb' eyuninal yet' heb' eyi he chikin, yik wach' aynhej yelk'och Jehová ko Diosal t'a yol he sat ayik ayex ek' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Tato icha chi', ol najatb'ok he k 'inal.

Yuj chi', ex wetchonhab' Israel, ab'ek, aq'ek wal och t'a he k'ol he k'anab'ajan juntzanh cheknab'il tik, yik te wach'nhej ol aj eyelk'ochi, te niwan chonhab' ol aj he b'isul t'a sat lum lum yax sat chi', icha ix aj yalan Jehová ko Diosal t'ayonh, haton pax sDiosal heb' ko mam kicham.
Ex wetchonhab' Israel, ab'ek wal: Anhej Jehová ko Diosal, malaj wal junokxo.
Tze xajanej Jehová ko Diosal t'a smasanil he k'ool, t'a smasanil he pensar yet' t'a smasanil eyip.
Ha juntzanh lolonel swal tik t'ayex tiknaik, sik'ekkan t'a he pensar.
Ha juntzanh tik ol eyak'nhej sk'ayb'ej heb' eyuninal t'a junjun k'u. Tzeyalan t'a heb' ayik ayex ek' t'a he pat, ayik wan he b'eyi, ayik tzex wayi yet' yik tzex k'e waan.
Tze tzek'anoch juntzanh cheknab'il tik t'a he k'ab' yet' t'a snanhal he sat ichok junok yechel yik tze naankoti.
Tze tz'ib'anpax och t'a yoyal sti' he pat yet' t'a spuertail smuroal he chonhab'.

Ha Jehová ko Diosal, ha' ol ex ik'anb'at t'a jun lu'um yak'nak sti' yak'an t'a heb' ko mam kicham, haton winhaj Abraham, winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Jacob. Ay wal niwak chonhab' manh jantakok swach'il t'a jun lu'um chi', manhok ex he b'onak.

Ay wal te' pat b'ut'an yuj tastak te wach', manhok ex he b'ut'nak. Ay ha' uk'b'ila' joyb'il, manhok ex eyab'nak syail he joyani. Ay te' uwa yet' te' oliwo awab'il, manhok ex eyawejnak. Ha juntzanh chi', toxonhej ol eyab'lej masanto syal he b'ut'ji.
Ayik ol ujok juntzanh chi', b'at ta wal Jehová satk'olal eyuuj. Naekkoti to a Jehová chi' ex ik'anelta t'a Egipto, b'aj ayex och chekab'ok.
Ayokab' yelk'och Jehová ko Diosal t'a yol he sat. Anhejokab' Jehová chi' tzeyak' serwil, anhejokab' sb'i tze loko' ayik tzeyak'an he ti' he k'ulan junok tas.
Manh ex och tzak'an t'a spatik sdiosal heb' anima kajan t'a he lak'anil chi',
yujto skot yowal Jehová ko Diosal t'a juntzanh chi'. Ayek' Jehová t'a ko kal, haxo talaj tz'aji, skot yowal sk'ool tzex sataneli, yujto max yal sk'ol skak'och ko pensar t'a junokxo ch'ok diosal.
Manh eyak' prowal Jehová ko Diosal, icha he k'ulejnak t'a Masah.
k'anab'ajejek wal sk'ayb'ub'al yet' scheknab'il, haton wal jantak scheknab'il ix yala'.
Wach'nhej tzeyutej he pensar yet' he b'eyb'al t'a yichanh Jehová, yik wach'nhej tzex elk'ochi. Ol eyikej lum lum yak'nak sti' yak'an t'a heb' ko mam kicham.
Ol el lemnaj heb' ajk'ol t'a eyichanh yuj Jehová, icha ix yutej yalani.
Tato sk'anb'ej heb' eyuninal t'a b'ak'uinh: ¿Tas yuj sko k'anab'ajej juntzanh kachnab'il yet' cheknab'il yalnak Jehová ko Diosal? tato xchi heb'.
Tzeyalan t'a heb' icha tik: Ha onh tik chekab' kaj t'a winh sreyal Egipto t'a peka', haxo Jehová ik'annak onh elta yet' jantak yipalil.
Ha onh tik kilnak wal juntzanh tastak satub'tak yilji yet'nak yaelal yak'nakkot Jehová chi' t'a yib'anh winh sreyal Egipto chi' yet' t'a masanil schonhab' chi'.
Onh yik'annakelta ta', onh yik'annakkot t'a tik t'a lum lum yak'nak sti' yak'an t'a heb' ko mam kicham.
Yuj chi' scheknak Jehová ko Diosal to yowalil sko k'anab'ajej juntzanh cheknab'il tik yuj ko naankoti, yik wach'nhej ko k'ool, wach'nhej ol aj yek' tiempo kuuj icha kaj tiknaik.
Yuj chi', tato sko k'anab'ajej icha ajnak yalan Jehová chi', wach' onh t'a yol sat, xe cham t'a heb'.

Ayik ol ex yik'anb'at Jehová t'a sat lum lum b'aj yak'nak sti' yak'an t'ayex, ha' ol ik'anel uke' nakión te niwak, te ay yip t'a eyichanh, haton heb' hitita, heb' gergeseo, heb' amorreo, heb' kananeo, heb' ferezeo, heb' heweo yet' heb' jebuseo.
Ayik ol yak'anoch juntzanh nakión chi' Jehová t'a yol he k'ab', ol he satel heb' smasanil, manh he b'o he trato yet' heb', mokab' ok' he k'ol t'a heb'.
Manh eyak' yik'laj sb'a heb' ix eyisil yet' heb' winh yuninal heb'. Manh eyak'pax yik'laj sb'a heb' winh eyuninal yet' heb' ix yisil heb',
haxo talaj tz'aji, tz'ik'jib'at heb' eyuninal chi' yuj heb' ix t'a spatik sdiosal, tz'och heb' ejmelal t'ay, yuj chi' skot yowal sk'ol Jehová, tzex satjiel yuj t'a elanhchamel.
Tze satpaxel masanil sdiosal heb' b'aj slesalwi, yaltaril yet' k'een k'een yet' te te' yechel Asera b'aj tz'och heb' ejmelal. Tze nhustz'a smasanil.
Ha onh tik schonhab' onh Jehová Dios, sik'b'il onh elta yuj t'a skal masanil juntzanh niwak nakión t'a sat lum lum tik, yik wach' yiknhej Jehová chi' tzonh ajkani.
Ha wal Jehová ix el t'a sk'ol ix onh sik'aneli, manh yujok to niwan nakión onh, ina to jaywanh onnhej t'a yichanh juntzanhxo nakión chi'.

Palta yujto xajan onh yuj yik wach' syak'elk'och sti' icha yutejnak yalan t'a heb' ko mam kicham, yuj chi' onh yik'elta t'a Egipto b'aj ayonh och chekab'ok, onh yik'anelta yet' yipalil t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Egipto chi'.

Ojtakejekeli to a Jehová ko Diosal anhej wal Dios. Tz'elnhejk'och tas syal t'a heb' xajanani, haton heb' sk'anab'ajan scheknab'il. Aynhej och yet' heb' yet' t'a heb' yinhtilal heb' yik ol b'eynhejb'atok.
Syak'an spak t'a heb' schakaneli, elanhchamel satel heb' yuj.
Yuj chi', scham wal he k'anab'ajan masanil cheknab'il yet' k'ayb'ub'al swalkanel tik t'ayex.
Tato tze maklej wal eyab' masanil juntzanh cheknab'il tik, tze k'anab'ajani, ol yak'elk'och strato Jehová ko Diosal yak'nak heyet'ok, ol ochnhej heyet'ok icha ajnak yalan t'a heb' ko mam kicham.

Ol ex sxajanej Jehová, ol yak'an swach'k'olal t'a eyib'anh, ol yak'anpax q'uib' he b'isul. Ol yak'an swach'k'olal t'a yib'anh masanil tas ay t'ayex: T'a yib'anh heb' eyuninal, he trigo, he wino, eyakeite, nok' he wakax yet' t'a yib'anh nok' he kalnel t'a sat lum lum b'aj yak'nak sti' yak'an t'a heb' ko mam kicham.

Ay swach'k'olal Jehová t'a eyib'anh t'a yichanh masanil juntzanhxo chonhab'. Malaj junok ix ix to malaj yune', ma junok winak to malaj yuninal t'a yol he chonhab' chi'. Malaj pax junok nok' he molb'etzal nok' to manh ol unewok.
Ha Jehová ol ex kolanel t'a jantak ilya icha wal owal ilya eyilnak yek' t'a heb' aj Egipto. Anhej t'a yib'anh heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayex ol em ilya chi' yuj Jehová.

Yuj chi' yowalil tze satel masanil juntzanh nakión chi'. Ha Jehová ko Diosal ol ak'anoch heb' t'a yol he k'ab', mokab' ok' he k'ol t'a heb'. Manh eyak'em he b'a t'a sdiosal heb' yik manh ol ex yak' juwokel heb'.
Wach'chom tze na' icha tik: Ha juntzanh nakión tik te ay yip t'a kichanh, ¿tas wal ol aj kik'anel t'a sat lum lum tik? wach'chom xe chi.
Palta manh ex xiw t'a heb' anima chi'. Naekkoti tas yutejnak heb' anima Jehová t'a Egipto yet' sreyal.

Ha onh tik kilnak wal juntzanh tastak satub'tak yilji yet'nak yaelal yak'nakkot Jehová yet' wal yipalil t'a yib'anh Egipto chi' ayik yik'annak onh elta ta'. Icha chi' ol yutok juntzanh chonhab' b'aj tzex xiw chi'.
Ha Jehová ol ak'anb'at jun niwan yaelal t'a skal heb', masanto ol satel masanil heb' olto kanok yet' heb' olto sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'ayex.
Yuj chi', manh ex xiw t'a heb' anima chi', yujto a Jehová ko Diosal ayek' t'a ko kal, te niwan spoder.
Ha ol ik'anel juntzanh nakión chi' t'a eyichanh t'a k'ojank'olal. Manh junnhejoklaj tiempo ol satel heb', yik wach' max te q'uib'chaanh nok' chium nok' tzex chi'ani.
Ha Jehová ko Diosal ol ak'anoch heb' anima chi' t'a yol he k'ab', ol och heb' t'a xiwk'olal masanto ol satel heb' eyuuj.
Ha Jehová ol ak'anoch sreyal heb' t'a yol he k'ab', ol he satanel heb', manhxa b'aj ol b'inaj heb' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Malaj mach ol yal skolan sb'a t'ayex, masanil mach ol he sateli.

Tze nhustz'a sdiosal heb'. Manh eyik'el k'een plata ma k'een oro ayoch t'ay. Manh he nib'ejochi yik wach' max ex telwiel yuj. Manh eyixtejb'at he b'a, yujto a juntzanh chi' schakji yuj Jehová ko Diosal.
Yuj chi', malaj junok tas to yajb'ilel yuj Jehová tzeyik'b'at t'a he pat, yik wach' max ex sateli. Masanil juntzanh chi', aykot yowal sk'ol Dios t'a yib'anh, yuj chi' yowalil tze yajkaneli.
Scham wal he k'anab'ajan masanil cheknab'il swalkanel tik t'ayex, yik wach' ol ex elk'ochok, ol te q'uib' he b'isul, ol eyikejkan lum lum yak'nak sti' Jehová yak'an t'a heb' ko mam kicham.
Naekkot sik'lab'il, 40 ab'il onh ek' t'a takinh lu'um yuj Jehová ko Diosal. Ix yak'an ko yaelal, onh yak'an prowal yik syila' tato sko k'anab'ajej scheknab'il, mato maay.

Ix kil syaelal yet' wejel yuj Jehová. Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an maná ko waelok, juntzanh wael to manh kojtakok, manh yojtakokpax heb' ko mam kicham. Icha chi' ix onh yutej yik wach' skojtakejeli to manh yujoknhej tas waji ay ko k 'inal, palta to yuj masanil tas syal Jehová.
Ha ko pichul ix ko k'an t'a 40 ab'il chi', maj lajwiel-laj, maj malk'elaj kok ko b'eyi.
Naek wal to icha junok uninab'il skachji yuj smam, icha chi' ix onh yutejpax Jehová.
Yuj chi' yowalil tze k'anab'ajej scheknab'il Jehová, ochanhek tzak'an yuj, ayokab' yelk'och t'a yol he sat.
Yujto a Jehová ko Diosal wan ex yik'anb'at t'a sat lum lum manhxo jantakok swach'il, ay ha ha' ay sjaj yet' ha ha' skot t'a lum niwak witz.
Ha t'a lum lum chi', te wach' tz'aj ixim trigo, ixim kebada, te' uwa, te' higo, te' granado yet' te' oliwo. Te ay pax nok' yal chab'.
Ayik ayexxo ek' t'a sat lu'um chi', manhxalaj tas tze na' yuj he wael yet' junokxo tasi. Ha t'a skal k'een k'een ay ta', ay k'een hierro, haxo t'a lum witz ay k'een kobre.
Wach' ol ex wa ta', yowalil ol eyak' yuj diosal t'a Jehová yujto wach' lum lum ol yak' chi' t'ayex.
Tze yil wal he b'a, mokab' b'at Jehová ko Diosal satk'olal eyuuj. Yowalil tze k'anab'ajej scheknab'il, sk'ayb'ub'al yet' skachnab'il swalkanel tik t'ayex.
Ayik wach' ol ex waok, ol eyuk'an ha', kajanexxopax t'a he pat te wach', haxo talaj tz'aji sb'at Jehová satk'olal eyuuj.
Hanhejtona' ayik ol te q'uib' sb'isul nok' he wakax, nok' he kalnel, ayik te ayxo k'een plata yet' k'een oro t'ayex yet' jantakxo tastak,
haxo talaj tz'aji tzeyik'anchaanh he b'a, sb'atkan Jehová ko Diosal satk'olal eyuuj, haton jun ik'annak onh elta t'a Egipto b'aj ayonh och chekab'ok.
Ha Jehová chi' ix onh kuchb'an t'a jun niwan tzinan lum te ay smay, b'aj ay nok' chan te ow yet' nok' sinaan, b'aj malaj ha ha', palta a ix ik'anelta ha ha' t'a sat k'een k'een yik skuk'ani.
Ix yak'an maná ko wa t'a tzinan lu'um chi', jun wael to manh yojtakok heb' ko mam kicham. Ix yak'och yaelal t'a kib'anh, ix onh yak'an prowal, yik wach' wach'xonhej tzonh elk'och yuj.
Ek'talaj t'a he pensar he naan icha tik: Ha jantak ko b'eyumal tik, a yet' wal ko munlajel yet' kip ix kik'a', xe chi talaj.
Palta naek wal to a Jehová ko Diosal tz'ak'an he na' yet' eyip yik syal eyoch b'eyumal, yik wach' tz'elk'och strato yak'nak yet' heb' ko mam kicham ichaton wan kilan tiknaik.

Palta tato ol b'at Jehová ko Diosal satk'olal eyuj jun, tato ol ex och tzak'an t'a spatik juntzanh komon Dios, ol eyak'anem he b'a t'ay yet' eyem nhojan ejmelal t'ay. Tato icha chi' ol he k'ulej, a in swalkan t'ayex tiknaik, ol ex satjokel yuj Jehová chi'.
Icha wal ol aj satel juntzanh chonhab' b'aj wan eyik'jib'at chi' yuj, icha wal chi' ol aj he satel yuj tato manh ol he k'anab'ajej tas syala'.
Ab'ek wal ex wetchonhab' Israel. Toxo ix k'och stiempoal yik tze k'axpitan ha' Jordán, yik tze satanel juntzanh chonhab' te niwak, te tek'an t'a eyichanh, te chaanh yajk'e smuroal.
Ha heb' anima kajan ta', chaanh steel heb', a winhaj Anac ay yinhtilal heb'. Ix eyab' yalji: ¿Mach wal junok syal stek'b'an sb'a t'a yichanh heb' yinhtilal winhaj Anac? xchi heb'.

Ojtakejekel tiknaik to a Jehová ko Diosal, a b'ab'el sb'at t'a eyichanh icha junok k'ak' satanel masanil tastak. Ol ak'jokoch heb' t'a yol he k'ab', yuj chi' ol he satnhejel heb', ol he pechanel heb' t'a elanhchamel, icha ix aj yalan Jehová.

Ayik toxo ix yik'el masanil heb' anima chi' Jehová t'a eyichanh, manh he na' to yuj he wach'il, yuj chi' icha chi' ix aji. Palta yuj schukal juntzanh chonhab' chi' ol ik'jokel heb' t'a eyichanh yuj Jehová.

Manh yujok he wach'il, manh yujok pax swach'il he b'eyb'al yuj chi' ol ex k'och kajan t'a sat lu'um. Palta yuj schukal juntzanh chonhab' chi', ol satjokkanel heb' t'a eyichanh, yik wach' tz'elkank'och tas yalnak Jehová t'a heb' ko mam kicham, haton t'a winhaj Abraham, t'a winhaj Isaac yet' t'a winhaj Jacob.
Ojtakejekel an to manh yujok he wach'il syak' jun lum manh jantakok swach'il chi' Jehová t'ayex yik tzeyikej, palta a ex tik junelnhej te pit ex.
Naekkoti, b'at talaj satk'olal eyuuj to he tzuntzejnakkot yowal Jehová t'a eyib'anh t'a tzinan lu'um. Atax kelnakkot t'a Egipto masanto onh jawi t'a tik, te pitnhej tzeyutej he b'a t'ay.
Ha t'a lum witz Horeb he tzuntzejnak wal kot yowal, yuj chi' snib'ejnak ex sateli.

Ayik in k'e t'a sjolom jun witz chi' yuj in chaan chab' pachanh k'een k'een b'aj tz'ib'ab'iloch cheknab'il, haton strato Dios ket'ok, 40 k'ual yet' 40 ak'wal eq'uin ta', malaj jab'ok tas in wa''a, ma wuk'ej.

Slajwi chi', yak'an chab' pachanh k'een k'een chi' Jehová t'ayin. Ha wal Jehová chi' tz'ib'anoch scheknab'il chi' t'a k'een, juntzanh cheknab'il yalnak t'a jolom witz t'a kal k'ak' t'a jun k'u ayik molan onh ek' ta'.
Ayik slajwi yek'kanb'at 40 k'ual yet' 40 ak'wal chi', yak'an chab' k'een yik trato chi' t'ayin.
Yalan icha tik: Emanhxi t'a elanhchamel, yujto a jun chonhab' ix ik'elta t'a Egipto toxo ix sjuel sb'a. Max sk'anab'ajejlaj tas ix wala', toxo ix sb'o jun sdiosal heb' nab'a oro.
Toxo ix wila'' to te pit jun chonhab' tik.

Nitzel a b'a t'a wichanh, ol in satel juntzanh anima tik, manhxa b'aj ol b'inaj heb' t'a sat lu'um tik. Anhej t'a inhtilal ol in b'o junok niwan nakión, te tek'an ol ajok, tzijtum ol aj sb'isul t'a yichanh juntzanh anima tik, xchi Jehová.
Wemxita t'a jolom witz b'aj nhilnhon sk'e k'ak' chi', wet'nak chab' k'een yik trato chi'.
Haxo wemxuli, wilani to toxo ix och he mul t'a yol sat Jehová ko Diosal, yujto he b'o jun yechel wakax he diosalok. Jun wal rato eyik'el he b'a t'a spatik cheknab'il yal ko Diosal chi' t'ayonh.
Yuj chi', in pok'anem chab' pachanh k'een k'een chi' t'a eyichanh, spojb'at k'een.

Slajwi chi' wemxi nhojan t'a yichanh Jehová t'a 40 k'ual yet' 40 ak'wal. Maj in wa jab'ok, maj wuk'ej jab'ok ha' eyuuj, yuj chi' icha chi' in k'ulej, yujto te chuk he k'ulej, he tzuntzejkot yowal sk'ol Jehová.
Te xiw in yujto kot yowal sk'ol Jehová chi' t'a eyib'anh yik tzex sataneli. Palta jun, yab'to Jehová tas wal t'ay junelxo chi'.
Kotpax yowal t'a winh wuk'tak aj Aarón, jab'xonhej maj satjokel winh yuj. Palta tewi in yuj winh yik tz'ak'ji niwank'olal winh.
Elanhchamel in mak'em weknaj jun yechel wakax b'aj och he mul chi'. Elanhchamel in yumb'at t'a kal k'ak'. Slajwi chi' in tenan pojok, in tzipankanb'at t'a yol ha ha' tz'emta t'a lum witz chi'.
Icha chi' he k'ulejpax t'a Tabera, t'a Masah yet' t'a Kibrot-hataawa. Ha wal ta' he tzuntzejkot yowal sk'ol Jehová.

Haton yik yalan Jehová chi' t'ayonh t'a Cades-barnea to tzonh b'at kik' lum ix yak' t'ayonh. Hanhejtona' ta' he tenek' tas yal ko Diosal chi'. Maj eyak'ochlaj t'a he k'ool, maj he k'anab'ajej pax tas yala'.
Atax yik ex wojtakaneli woch ijan wilani to te pitnhej tzeyutej he b'a t'a Jehová.
Yujto maj he k'anab'ajej, yuj chi' yala' to ol ex satelok, yuj chi' em in nhojan t'a yichanh t'a 40 k'ual yet' 40 ak'wal chi'.
Walan t'ay icha tik: Mamin Jehová, manh a satel jun a chonhab' tik. Ha ach ix a kolel yet' ipal, ix ik'anelta t'a Egipto yet' a poder.
Nakot tas alnakkan t'a heb' a chekab', haton winhaj Abraham, winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Jacob. Ha spital juntzanh anima tik yet' smul heb' yet' schuk pensaril heb', manh a nakoti,

yik wach' max yal heb' anima b'aj ix onh ik'elta chi': Maj yal-laj yuj Jehová yik'ank'och jun chonhab' chi' t'a lum b'aj yak'nak sti' yak'an t'a heb', anhej to ix yik'b'at heb' yik b'at yak'ancham heb' t'a takinh lu'um yujto chakb'ilel heb' yuj, xcham heb'.
Ak' niwank'olal t'a jun chonhab'il anima tik, yujto a chonhab' yaji. Ha ach ix ik'elta t'a Egipto yet' a poder, xin chi t'ay.
Yalanxi Jehová chi' t'ayin icha tik: Tzak' b'ojok chab'ok pachanh k'een k'een, icha k'een ix wak' t'ayach t'a sb'ab'elal. Tzak' b'ojokpax junok te' kaxa, slajwi chi' tzach k'eta t'a jolom witz tik.
Ol in tz'ib'anxioch lolonel ayoch t'a k'een ix wak' t'ayach t'a sb'ab'elal, haton k'een ix a mak'pojok. Haxo k'een yik schaelal tik, ol em k'een t'a yol te' kaxa chi', xchi t'ayin.
Wak'an b'ojok jun te' kaxa chi', a te' akakia och t'a te'. Wak'an tzeychaj chab' k'een k'een chi', wik'ank'e k'een t'a jolom witz chi'.

Stz'ib'anxioch lajunhe' scheknab'il Jehová chi' t'a k'een. Icha aj stz'ib'an k'een t'a sb'ab'elal, haton juntzanh cheknab'il yal t'ayonh t'a skal k'ak' t'a jolom witz ayik molanonhek' t'a yich witz chi'. Yak'anxi k'een t'ayin.
Wemxita t'a jolom witz chi' b'ian, wak'anem k'een t'a yol te' kaxa chi', icha aj yalan Jehová chi' t'ayin. Hata' kanxonhej k'een.
(Ix el heb' israel t'a ha' Beerot-bene-jaakán, ix jawi heb' t'a Mosera. Hata' ix cham winhaj Aarón, ix mukji winh ta'. Haxo winhaj Eleazar, winh yuninal winh ix ochkan sk'exulok sat sakerdoteal.
Ixlajwi chi' ix elxi heb', ix jawi heb' t'a Gudgoda. Ix elxi heb' ta', ix jawi heb' t'a Jotbata. Ha t'a jun lugar chi' te aynhej ha ha'.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi' ix ak'jioch yopisio heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Leví yuj Jehová, yik syik'anb'at te' skaxail strato Jehová chi' heb', yik smunlajpax heb' t'a yichanh, yik syalanpax wach' lolonel heb' t'a yib'anh heb' anima t'a sb'i Jehová chi'. Ichaton chi' sk'ulejnhej heb'.
Yuj chi', a heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Leví chi', maj schalaj smakb'en lu'um heb', yujto a Jehová icha smakb'en heb' yajkani, icha ix aj yalan Jehová.)
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', 40 k'ual 40 ak'wal ayinek' t'a jolom witz chi', icha in k'ulej t'a sb'ab'elal. Hanheja' t'a junelxo chi' scha sk'ol Jehová yab'an tas swala', yuj chi' maj ex satjiel-laj yuj.
Yalan t'ayin icha tik: Ixik, kuchb'ejb'at jun chonhab' chi', yik b'at schaan lum lum heb' to ol yikej, haton lum wak'nak in ti' wak'an t'a heb' he mam eyicham, xchi t'ayin.

Ha tiknaik jun, ex wetchonhab' Israel, ¿tas snib'ej Jehová ko Diosal t'ayonh? Haton tik snib'ej t'ayonh: Ayokab' yelk'och t'a yol ko sat, sko k'anab'ajani, sko xajanani yet' koch ejmelal t'ay t'a smasanil ko k'ool yet' t'a smasanil ko pensar.
Tato sko k'anab'ajej masanil sk'ayb'ub'al yet' scheknab'il, wach'nhej ol onh elk'och t'a smasanil.
Scham wal he naani to a Jehová ko Diosal, ha' ay yik satcha'anh yet' t'a yichanhb'at satchanh chi'. A' ay pax yik lum lum tik yet' masanil tas ay t'a sat lu'um.
Yujto xajan heb' ko mam kicham yuj, yuj chi' ix sik'jikanel yinhtilal heb' yuj, a onh toni, ix onh sik'jiel t'a skal juntzanhxo chonhab' yuj icha kajkan tik.
Naeknhejkot jun trato sb'o Jehová heyet'ok, manhxo he pitej he b'a t'ay.

Yujto a Jehová ko Diosal, ek'to t'a yib'anh juntzanh komon Dios, Yajal yaj t'a yib'anh heb' yajal, ayek' t'a yib'anh masanil tas, te ay spoder, sat ko k'ool yuj. Malaj sk'exanhil heb' anima t'ay. Max schalaj tumin yuj sch'olb'itani, max schapax silab' yik smontaji.
Tz'ok' sk'ol t'a heb' meb'a' yet' t'a heb' ix ix chamnak yetb'eyum. Xajanpax heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a ko kal yuj, yuj chi' tz'ak'ji swael heb' yet' spichul heb' yuj.
Ichokab' ta' skutejpax ko b'a, yujto ch'ok chonhab'il ajnak onh ek' kajan t'a yol yik Egipto.
Anhejokab' Jehová ko Diosal niwan yelk'och t'a yol ko sat. Anhej t'ay tzonh och ejmelal, sko k'anab'ajannhej. Tato ay b'aj skak' ko ti' t'a junok tasi, anhejokab' t'a sb'i Jehová chi' skala'.
Kik'ekchaanh Jehová ko Diosal. Kuuj manh jantakok tas te satub'tak yilji ix sk'ulej icha wal ix aj kilani.
Ayik sk'ochnak heb' ko mam kicham t'a Egipto, 70-nhej sb'isul heb', haxo tiknaik jun, a Jehová ix ak'an q'uib' ko b'isul icha sb'isul k'een k'anal t'a satcha'anh.
Yowalil sko xajanej Jehová ko Diosal, sko k'anab'ajan tas schek ko k'ulej t'a masanil tiempo, haton sk'ayb'ub'al, scheknab'il yet' skachnab'il.

Sko naek tiknaik tas ix yutej Jehová onh skachani. Ha onh tik ix kila', manhok heb' kuninal ix ilan tas ix sk'ulej Jehová chi'. Ha onh wal tik ix kila' jantak sniwanil yelk'ochi yet' spoder yet' tas satub'tak ix sk'ulej.
Kilnak tas sk'ulejnak Jehová t'a winh sreyal Egipto yet' t'a masanil heb' anima kajan ta'.

Kilnakpax tas sk'ulejnak yet' heb' soldado winh rey chi' yet' jantak karruaje yet'nak nok' chej. Masanil juntzanh chi' mukchajnakkanb'at yuj Jehová t'a yol ha' Chakchak Mar ayik onh spechan heb', yuj chi' a ko Diosal chi' satannakel heb' t'a junelnhej.
Sko naekpaxkoti jantak wach'il sk'ulejnak Jehová chi' t'ayonh t'a tzinan lum masanto onh jawi t'a tik.

Sko naanpaxkoti tas sk'ulejnak yet' winhaj Datán yet' winhaj Abiram yuninal winhaj Eliab, t'a yinhtilalkan Rubén. Spojnak sb'a lum lum t'a snanhal ko kampamento, mukchajnakkanem heb' yet' masanil yuninal, masanil tas ay t'a heb', smantiado heb', schekab' heb' yet' nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'. Icha chi' ajnak satel heb' yuj Jehová t'a kichanh.
Ha onh tik testigo onh t'a masanil tas sk'ulej Jehová to satub'tak yilji.
Yuj chi', k'anab'ajejek scheknab'il Jehová swak'kan tik t'ayex, yik wach' tz'och wal eyip tzex b'at kajan t'a sat lum lum wan yoch eyikok chi',
yik wach' pax najtil ol ex kajnaj t'a lum lum te yax sat chi', haton lum yak'nak sti' Jehová yak'an t'a heb' ko mam kicham yet' t'ayonh a onh yinhtilal onh heb' tik.
Ha lum wan yak'ji chi' t'ayex, manh lajanok lum icha lum Egipto b'aj onh koti. Ha t'a Egipto chi' slajwi eyawan tas tzeyawej, tzeyak'anoch yalil icha b'aj tz'awchaj anh itaj.
Ha pax lum b'aj wan he k'och chi' jun, ay switzal lu'um. Ay pax spanhanil lu'um, aynhejoch yal lu'um yuj nhab' syak' Jehová.
Ha jun lum chi' tanhwab'il lum yuj Jehová, aynhejoch sat t'a lu'um tzek' ab'il.
Yuj chi', k'anab'ajejek scheknab'il Jehová, haton juntzanh wan walan tik t'ayex. Tze xajanej Jehová ko Diosal, tzeyak'em he b'a t'ay t'a smasanil he k'ool yet' smasanil he pensar.
Tato icha chi', ol yak'nhej b'ab'el nhab' yet' slajwub'xo, yuj chi' te wach' ol aj sat eyawb'en, he trigo, te' eyuwa yet' te' eyoliwo.
Ay pax yax ank'ultak ol swa nok' he molb'etzal nok', ol ste ak'ej sat tas ol eyawej yik wach' ay he wael.
Palta tzeyil wal he b'a, yik malaj junok mach tzex montanb'ati yik tzeyik'anel he b'a t'a spatik Jehová, haxo talaj t'a juntzanhokxo komon Dios tzex och ejmelal, tzex och tzak'an yuj.

Tato icha chi', ol kot yowal sk'ol Jehová chi' t'ayex. Manhxo ol yak'laj nhab', manhxo ol yak'laj sat masanil eyawb'en, haxo he cham yuj wejel t'a sat lum lum te yax sat wan yak'an Jehová chi' t'ayex.
Scham wal eyab'ankan juntzanh lolonel tik, tze sik'ankan t'a he pensar. Tzek'ekoch t'a he k'ab' yet' t'a snanhal he sat.
Ha juntzanh tik ol eyak' sk'ayb'ej heb' eyuninal t'a junjun k'u. Ayexnhejoch eyalan t'a heb', ayik ayex ek' t'a he pat, ayik tzex b'ey t'a yoltak b'e, ayik tzex wayi, ayik pax tzex k'e waan.
Tze tz'ib'anoch t'a smarkoal spuertail he pat yet' t'a spuertailtak he chonhab',

yik wach' ol najatb'ok he k 'inal yet' heb' eyuninal t'a sat lum lum yak'nak sti' Jehová ko Diosal yak'an t'a heb' ko mam kicham. Ol ex kajnajnhej ta' yakb'an ayek' satcha'anh t'a yib'anh lum lum tik.
Tato tze k'anab'ajej masanil juntzanh cheknab'il swalkanel tik t'ayex, tze xajananpax Jehová ko Diosal, tze k'ulan masanil tas syala',
ichato chi' b'ian, a Jehová chi' ol ik'anel juntzanh chonhab' te niwak, te ay pax yip t'a eyichanh, a exxo ol ex kajnajkan t'ay.
Masanil lum b'aj ol ex ek'ok, eyik ol ajkan lu'um, sb'atnhej lum t'a takinh lu'um masanto sk'och t'a Líbano. Sb'atnhej lum t'a ha' niwan Éufrates masanto sk'och t'a ha' mar Mediterráneo.

Malaj mach ol yal stek'b'an sb'a t'a eyichanh. Ha Jehová ol ak'anoch niwak xiwk'olal t'a skal anima b'aj ol ex ek'nhej, manhxo ol yal snaan heb' tas ol yutok skolan sb'a heb' t'ayex icha ix aj yak'an sti' Jehová chi' t'ayonh.
Ab'ek jun, ha t'a jun k'u tik swak' he sik'lej, tom a swach'k'olal Jehová tze nib'ej mato a skatab'.
Ol he cha swach'k'olal Jehová ko Diosal tato tze k'anab'ajej scheknab'il wan walan tik t'ayex.

Ha yowal sk'ol ol kot t'a eyib'anh tato manh ol he k'anab'ajej juntzanh cheknab'il tik, tato tzeyik'el he b'a t'a Jehová, tzeyak'anoch he pensar t'a juntzanh komon Dios to manh eyojtakok, tzeyak'anem he b'a t'ay.
Ayik toxo ix ex k'och t'a sat lum lum chi' yuj Jehová ko Diosal, haton jun lum wan yak'an t'ayex, ol eyalanel wach' lolonel t'a yich lum witz Gerizim yet' katab' lolonel t'a yich lum witz Ebal.

Ha juntzanh lum witz chi', ha t'a yichanhek' niwan b'e ay lu'um, tzek' t'a sk'axepalek' ha' Jordán, t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, b'aj ay sluum heb' kananeo, heb' anima ay t'a yak'likal sti' ha' niwan Jordán t'a yichanhb'at Gilgal. Jun b'aj ay te' ji t'a yol yik More.
Wanxo sk'och stiempoal yik ol ex k'axpajek' t'a ha' Jordán, yik tz'ochkan lum lum chi' eyikok yuj Jehová ko Diosal. Ayik toxo ix eyik' lu'um, haxo he kajnaj t'a sat lum chi',
tzeyak'och t'a he k'ool he b'eyb'alan masanil cheknab'il swalkan tik t'ayex tiknaik.
Haton wal juntzanh cheknab'il yet' k'ayb'ub'al tik yowalil ol he b'eyb'alej ayik ayexxoek' t'a lum lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal yet' heb' ko mam kicham eyikej.

Ha heb' anima kajan t'a lum lum chi', ch'ok sdiosal heb' b'aj syal sb'a. Ayik toxo ix eyikejel lum sluum heb' chi', yowalil tze satel juntzanh yik lesal b'aj syal sb'a heb' t'a sdiosal, wach'chom t'a jolomtak witz yet' t'a tzalkixtak yet' t'a yichtak te te' k'ayum xiil.

Tze mak'poj juntzanh yaltar heb', k'een k'een yet' te te' b'ob'il sdiosalok heb' skuchan Asera, haton b'aj syak'em sb'a heb'. Tze nhusantz'aok, tze mak'anpoj sdiosal heb' chi', yik wach' manhxa b'ak'uinh snachajkot t'a juntzanh lugar chi'.
Manh ichok tz'aj yoch heb' ejmelal t'a sdiosal chi', manh ichokta tz'aj eyoch ejmelal t'a Jehová ko Diosal.
Ha t'a jun lugar ol sik'kanel Jehová t'a skal eyinhtilal to yik yaji, hata' ol b'at eyak'em he b'a t'ay.

Ol eyak'an he silab' stz'a smasanil yet' juntzanhxo silab' yuj eyik'anchaanh Jehová. Ol eyak'anpax he diezmo, he kolwal yet' tas ix eyak' he ti' eyak'ani yet' eyofrenda to tz'el wal t'a he k'ol eyak'ani. Hanheja' ol eyak'anpax nok' sb'ab'el yune' he wakax yet' sb'ab'el yune' nok' he kalnel.
Hata' ol ex wa t'a tzalajk'olal t'a yichanh Jehová yet' masanil heb' ay t'a yol he pat. Icha chi' ol aj he waan tas tzeyik' t'a he munlajel a to syal swach'k'olal Jehová ol yak' t'ayex.
Hata' manh ol he k'ulej icha tas sko k'ulej tiknaik, yujto ha t'a tik yalnhej tas snib'ej junjun anima, a sk'ulej.
Wal yel manto ex k'ochlaj t'a lum lum ol yak' Jehová t'ayex, hata' manhxalaj tas ol he na'a.

Wanxo sk'och sk'ual yik ol ex k'axpajek' t'a ha' Jordán, yik tzex k'ochkan t'a sat lum lum ol yak' Jehová eyikej. Ayik toxo ix ex kolchajkanel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayex, manhxa xiwk'olal t'ayex ta'.

Haxo jun lugar ol sik'kanel Jehová yik tz'och yikok, hata' ol eyak' masanil tas ix wal t'ayex to ol he k'ulej. Hata' ol eyak' nok' silab' stz'ai yet' juntzanh silab' yuj eyik'anchaanh Jehová chi', he diezmo, he kolwal yet' eyofrenda sik'b'ilel eyuj b'aj ix eyak' he ti' eyak'ani.
Tzex te tzalaj t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal yet' heb' eyuninal, heb' he chekab' yet' heb' lewita ol kajnaj t'a he kal. Yujto a heb' lewita chi' malaj smakb'en heb' ol scha heyet'ok t'a lum lum chi'.
Tzeyil wal he b'a, manh he komon nhusejtz'a nok' he silab' t'a yalnhej tas lugaril he gana.
Anhej t'a jun lugar sik'b'ilel yuj Jehová t'a skal he chonhab' smasanil, hata' tzeyik'b'at he silab' yik tze nhusantz'aok yet' he k'anab'ajan masanil tas swalkan tik t'ayex.

Ayik tze naank'e he chi'an nok' chib'ej, syal he milancham junok nok' eyiko' tze chi'an b'aj ayex ek' chi', hato syal tas syak' Jehová t'ayex. Wach'chom ayex wach' eyaji, icha yalan ley, mato maay, syal he chi'ani, ichok tz'aj he chi'an junok nok' ch'ukul ma junok nok' k'ultakil chej.
Anhej wal schiq'uil nok' b'ian, manh jab'ok syal he chi'ani, ma eyuk'ani, anhej to tze tob'kanem t'a sat lu'um ichok ha ha'.

Max yal he wa''an sdiezmoal he trigo t'a yol he chonhab', ma sdiezmoal he wino, eyakeite, ma he chi'an nok' b'ab'el yune' he wakax yet' b'ab'el yune' he kalnel, ma eyofrenda tzeyak' he ti' eyak'ani, ma he kolwal, ma eyofrenda tz'och b'akhan t'a yichanh Jehová.

Anhej t'a jun lugar ol sik'kanel Jehová ko Diosal, hata' ol he chi' juntzanh silab' chi', ajun heb' eyal eyuninal heyet'ok yet' heb' he chekab' yet' heb' lewita ayek' t'a he kal. Hata' tzeyak' tzalajb'ok he k'ol t'a yichanh Jehová yuj tas syak' t'a he munlajel chi'.
Yakb'an ayex ek' t'a jun lu'um chi', mokab' b'at heb' lewita satk'olal eyuuj.
Ha wal yik ol lewanb'ok he lu'um yuj Jehová ko Diosal t'a jantak yak'nak sti' yak'ani, tato syal he k'ol ol he chi nok' chib'ej, ol yal he chi'an nok' t'a yalnhej tas k'ual.

Tato najat kajan ex t'a jun lugar ol sik'kanel Jehová ko Diosal b'aj tz'och ejmelal chi', syal he milancham nok' he wakax yet' nok' he kalnel syak' Jehová chi' t'ayex b'aj kajan ex chi', tze chi'an nok' icha syal jantak snib'ej he k'ool, icha ix aj walan t'ayex.
Ichataxon tz'aj he chi'an yalnhej tas makanhil nok' k'ultakil chej, icha chi' tz'ajpax he chi'ani, tato wach' eyaj icha yalan ley, mato maay, syalnhej he chi'an nok'.
Palta max yal-laj he chi'an nok' chib'ej max el-laj schiq'uil, yujto ha t'a schiq'uil nok' chi' ay sk'inal. Max yal-laj he chi'an nok' chib'ej chi' yet' sk'inal.
Anhej to tze tob'kanel schiq'uil nok' chi' t'a sat lu'um ichok ha ha'.
Manh he chi'a, manh eyuk'ej schiq'uil nok' nok' chi' yik wach'nhej ol ex ajelk'och yet' eyinhtilal yuj he k'anab'ajan Jehová.
Ha pax masanil tas to yikxo Dios yaj eyuuj jun yet' tastak toxo ix eyak' he ti' eyak'ani, yowalil tzeyik'b'at t'a jun lugar ol sik'el Jehová.

Ha t'a yib'anh altar yik Jehová ko Diosal, hata' tzeyak' nok' he silab' to stz'a smasanil schib'ejal yet' schiq'uil nok'. Haxo pax junxo makan nok' he silab' jun, syal he chi'an schib'ejal nok', anhej wal schiq'uil nok' stob'chajkanoch t'a yich altar t'a yichanh Jehová.

Scham eyab'ani yet' he k'anab'ajan masanil tas swal tik, yik wach' wach'nhej ol aj he b'eyb'at yet' heb' eyinhtilal t'a masanil tiempo, yujto tze k'anab'ajej tas scha sk'ol Jehová ko Diosal, tojol exnhej t'a yol sat.
Ayik ol satjokel masanil juntzanh chonhab' t'a eyichanh yuj Jehová ko Diosal, a exxo ol ex kajnajkan t'a sat slum heb' chi'.

Scham wal eyilani, manh ex b'at tzak'an t'a sb'eyb'al heb' icha tz'aj yak'anem sb'a heb' t'a sdiosal. Manh he k'anb'ej tas tz'aj yoch heb' ejmelal t'a sdiosal chi', yik wach' manh ichokta tzeyutejpax he b'a.

Manh ichok syutej sb'a heb' chi', manh ichok chi' tzeyutej he b'a t'a Jehová ko Diosal, yujto a masanil tas sk'ulej heb' chi' chakb'ilel yuj. Ha juntzanh chi' haton sb'eyb'alej heb' anima chi' yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a sdiosal. Ay pax b'aj snhustz'a yal yuninal heb' silab'il t'a sdiosal chi'.
k'anab'ajejek he b'eyb'alan masanil tas swalkan tik t'ayex. Manh eyik'el jab'ok, manh eyak'paxoch stz'akub' juntzanh cheknab'il tik.

Tzeyil wal he b'a, talaj ay junok mach sk'e waan t'a he kal schekab' Dios yalani, tz'och ijan yalani to ay tas ma wayich syila', ma sch'oxanel t'a he kal tastak to satub'tak yilji, ma ayokto syalan yuj junok tas ol ujok,
tato k'okb'il tz'elk'och tas syal chi' tz'och ijan yalan t'ayex icha tik: Kotanhek, ay wal juntzanhxo Dios manh eyojtakok, b'at onh emek kuman t'a yichanh, tzonh ochek ejmelal t'ay, tato xchi t'ayex,
manh he cha eyab' juntzanh chi' t'ay. Yujto a Jehová ko Diosal, snib'ej syila' tato yel tze xajanej yet' smasanil he k'ool yet' smasanil he pensar.
Ochanhek tzak'an t'a spatik Jehová ko Diosal, ayokab' yelk'och t'a yol he sat, k'anab'ajejek scheknab'il, ab'ek tas syala', ochanhek ejmelal t'ay, junnhejokab' eyaj yet'ok.

Ha jun anima syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios chi', mato syala' to ay tas syila', yowalil schami, yujto snib'ej tzex elkan t'a spatik Jehová. Snib'ej jun anima chi' tzex skuchb'ej yik tze pitej he b'a t'a Jehová ko Diosal onh kolanelta t'a Egipto, b'aj ek'nak onh chekab'wumal. Yuj chi' tze mak'cham jun anima chi', yik wach' satel jun chukal chi' t'a he kal.

Tato ay mach tzex kuchb'anb'at t'a elk'altak eyoch ejmelal t'a sdiosal heb' anima kajan t'a he lak'anil, ma t'a najat, haton juntzanh b'aj max kal ko b'a, manh yalnakokpax sb'a heb' ko mam kicham, manh he cha eyab' t'ay. Hak'uekoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' yajal yik schami. Mokab' ok' he k'ol t'ay, wach'chom eyuk'tak, ma eyuninal, ma eyisil, ma eyetb'eyum to xajanab'il eyuuj, ma a junok te wach' eyak'an yet'ok, manh he k'ub'ejeli. Ha ex tze b'ab'laj ik'ejk'e k'een k'een tze julanchamok. Icha pax chi' syutej masanil heb' anima heyet'ok. Julk'enajokab' chamok, yujto snib'ej tzex yik'el t'a spatik Jehová ko Diosal onh ik'anelta t'a Egipto, b'aj ek'nak onh chekab'wumal. Ol yab' jun chi' heb' ketchonhab' smasanil, ol xiw heb', manhxo ol say mulan sb'a heb' icha juntzanh ix uji chi'.
Tato ha t'a junok juntzanh chonhab' wan yak'an Jehová ko Diosal t'ayex yik tzex kajnaj t'ay, tzeyab' spekal to
ay heb' max k'anab'ajan Dios, haxo heb' skuchb'an sk'ulok heb' anima t'a jun chonhab' chi' yoch ejmelal t'a komon Dios b'aj max kal ko b'a,
scham wal he k'anb'anek' eyab'i. Tato yel ay mach wan sk'ulan jun chukal chi' t'a he kal,
a masanil heb' kajan t'a jun chonhab' chi', xikjicham heb' yet' nok' smolb'etzal nok', tze satanel masanil tastak ay t'a jun chonhab' chi'.

Ha b'aj smolb'ej sb'a heb' anima, hata' tze molb'ejoch masanil stastak heb', tzeyak'anoch sk'ak'al jun chonhab' chi' yet' masanil stastak heb' chi' silab'ok yuj eyik'anchaanh Jehová ko Diosal. Ha jun chonhab' chi', skanxonhej icha chi'. Manhxa b'ak'uinh sb'ojixik'ei.

Ha juntzanh tastak toxo ix alchaji to sateli, manh eyama', yik wach' max kot yowal Jehová ko Diosal t'ayex. Tato tze k'anab'ajej masanil juntzanh cheknab'il swalkan t'ayex tik, wach' tzeyutej he b'a t'a Jehová, ol yak' swach'k'olal t'ayex, ol yak'an q'uib' he b'isul icha ajnak yak'ankan sti' t'a heb' ko mam kicham.
Ha onh tik yuninal onhxo Jehová ko Diosal. Manh kak' echnaj ko niwanil, manh ko joxpaxel xil ko jolom t'a snanhal ko sat ayik scham junok anima,
yujto schonhab' Jehová ko Diosal kaji. Ha ix onh sik'anel t'a skal juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a sat lu'um tik, yik tzonh ochkan yikok.
Manh he chi nok' nok' max chijilaj, nok' ay yowalil yuj Dios.
Haton nok' tik syal he chi'ani: Nok' wakax, nok' kalnel, nok' chiwa,
nok' ch'ukul, masanil makanhil nok' k'ultakil chej yet' nok' kaltakte'al chiwa.
Syal he chi'an masanil nok' nok' sjax yanh, cha xechanh yech.

Haxo pax nok' max yal-laj he chi'an jun, wach'chom sjax yanh nok' palta tato manh cha xechanhok yech nok', haton nok' tik: Nok' kamello, nok' niwak chich yet' nok' tojolal chich. Ha juntzanh nok' tik manh wach'ok nok', sjax yanh nok', palta manh cha xechanhok yech nok'.
Yet' pax nok' chitam, cha xechanh yech nok', palta max sjaxlaj yanh nok'. Ha juntzanh nok' chi' yowalil tzeyojtakejeli to manh wach'ok nok'. Manh he chi nok', manh eyam nok' ayik chamnakxo nok'.
Haxo pax masanil nok' ay t'a yoltak ha ha', syal he chi'an nok' tato ay sk'axil nok' yet' stuminal spatik nok'.
Ha pax nok' malaj yik jun, manh he chi nok'. Yowalil tzeyojtakejeli to manh wach'ok nok'.
Ay pax nok' much syal he chi'ani, nok' wach' icha yalan ley.
Palta ay juntzanh nok' max yal-laj he chi'ani: Nok' ch'akb'a, nok' wakawok, nok' ch'akb'a yik ha ha',
nok' xulem, nok' milano,
yet' pax masanil makanhil nok' joj,
nok' awestruz, nok' niwak kujub', nok' xalunhe yet' masanil makanhil nok' ch'akb'a,
nok' tonton, nok' ibis yet' nok' pech,
nok' julum chay, nok' ostok, nok' kormorán,
nok' kigüeña, nok' abubilla yet' nok' sotz'.
Masanil nok' kotak nok' ay sk'axil tzek' t'a juntak petanhil, manh wach'ok nok'. Max yal-laj he chi'an nok'.
Haxo pax nok' kotak nok' to ay sk'axil alb'ilxo to wach', syal he chi'an nok'.

Manh he chi' junok nok' tonhej scham t'a ichnhejta', yujto a onh tik sik'b'il onh el yuj Jehová ko Diosal. Palta syal eyak'an nok' t'a heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan t'a he kal. Ha heb' chi' syal schi'an nok' heb'. Mato syalpax he chonhan nok' t'a heb' ch'ok chonhab'il tonhej sb'eyek' t'a he kal. Manh he tz'anh nok' yune' chiwa t'a skal yal yim snun.
Junjun ab'il yowalil tzeyik'kanel sdiezmoal sat eyawb'en yet' tastak tze mol sat.

Tzeyik'anb'at sdiezmoal ixim he trigo, he wino yet' eyakeite. Tzeyik'anpaxb'at sb'ab'el yune' nok' he wakax yet' sb'ab'el yune' nok' he kalnel t'a jun lugar ol sik'el Jehová ko Diosal b'aj ol aj skajnub'. Hata' ol he wa juntzanh chi' t'a yichanh Jehová yuj eyik'anchaanh.
Tato a jun lugar b'aj ay skajnub' chi', najat skan t'ayex, tato niwan swach'k'olal Jehová syak' t'ayex, max yal eyik'anb'at masanil he diezmo chi',
syal he chonhaneli, haxo stojol tzeyik'b'at t'a skajnub' Jehová chi'.

Haxo yet' stojol chi' syal he manan tas syal he k'ool: Nok' wakax, nok' kalnel, wino, ma tas tz'uk'ji to pajxo, ma juntzanhxo tas tze nib'ej, tzex wa t'a tzalajk'olal yet' eyal eyuninal t'a yichanh Jehová.
Ha heb' lewita kajan t'a he kal, tzeyawtej heb' wael heyet'ok, yujto manh ol yik'laj sluum heb' smakb'enok icha eyik a ex tik.
Ha slajwi junjun yoxil ab'il tzeyik'ankanel sdiezmoal sat eyawb'en yet' tas tze mol t'a jun ab'il chi'. Tze molb'ej t'a junok lugar t'a yol he chonhab' chi'.

Ha heb' lewita to maj schalaj sluum smakb'enok heyet'ok, ma heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan t'a he kal, ma heb' meb'a' manhxa smam yet' heb' ix ix chamnak yetb'eyum, syal swaan heb' tastak tze mol t'a he diezmo chi', tz'akan slaj yik' yik heb'. Tato icha chi' tze k'ulej, ol yak' swach'k'olal Jehová ko Diosal t'a yib'anh masanil tastak tze k'ulej.
T'a yuktakil ab'il tzeyaktan he k'anan meltzaj he tastak ayb'at majanil.
Ha jun tik, icha tik yaji: Masanil mach to ay tas ix yak' majanil t'a junok ketchonhab', manhxookab' sk'anb'ej, yujto a jun ab'il chi' ix yal Jehová to maxtzak yal-laj sk'anb'ajxi tas ayb'at majanil.
Ha t'a junok ch'ok chonhab'il syal he k'anb'anxi tas ix eyak' majanil chi'. Haxo pax t'a junok ketchonhab' jun, manhxo he k'anb'ej.
Tato ol he k'ulej icha chi', malaj mach ol b'at mheb'ail t'a yib'anh t'a he kal, yujto ol yak' swach'k'olal Jehová ko Diosal t'a eyib'anh t'a lum lum ol yak' chi' t'ayex.
Tato ol he k'anab'ajej he b'eyb'alan juntzanh cheknab'il wan walankan tik t'ayex,

ol yak' swach'k'olal Jehová ko Diosal t'a eyib'anh, icha wal ajnak yak'an sti', tzijtum tas ol yal eyak'an majanil t'a juntzanhxo nakión. Palta a ex tik, manhok exlaj ol he k'an tastak he majnej t'a heb'. Tzijtum juntzanh nakión ol eyak' yajalil t'a yib'anh, palta manhoklaj heb' ol ak'an yajalil t'a eyib'anh.
Tato ay junok heb' ketchonhab' tik meb'a' t'a he kal t'a junok chonhab' wan yak'an Jehová t'ayex, manh chukok tzeyutej he k'ol t'a heb', palta tze kol heb' t'a tas tz'och yuj,
tze sian tastak t'a heb', tzeyak'an smajnej heb' tastak tz'och yuj.

Tzeya ilej he pensar, xe natalaj icha tik: Manhxo ol wak'laj tas majanil, ina to lak'anxo sjawi yukil ab'il, haton jun ab'il b'aj maxtzak k'anb'aj tastak ayb'at majanil, xe chitalaj. Max yal to chuk tzeyutej he k'ol t'a heb' meb'a' ay t'a skal heb' ketchonhab', k'etalaj yaw heb' t'a Jehová yuj he chukk'olal chi', yuj chi' tz'och he mul t'a Jehová.
Mokab' chukok tzeyab'i tzex kolwaj t'a heb', b'ekanokab' yel eyuuj, yujto a yuj tas wach' tze k'ulej chi', ol yak' swach'k'olal Jehová ko Diosal t'a eyib'anh ayik ol b'eynhejb'at tiempo.
Aynhej heb' meb'a' t'a he kal, yuj chi' a in swal t'ayex to elb'enokab' eyuuj t'a heb' ketchonhab' wan yab'an syail mheb'ail t'a yol he chonhab' chi'.
Tato ay junok heb' ketisraelal, junok winak, ma junok ix ix schonhji t'ayex tz'och chekab'ok, wakenhej ab'il tz'och he chekab'ok, haxo t'a yukil ab'il jun, tzeyak'anel t'a libre.
Ayik tz'el t'a libre chi', max el-laj t'a ichnhej ta'.
Palta niwanokab' tas tzeyak' t'ay: Nok' kalnel yet' ixim trigo yet' wino. Syalelk'ochi to syik'pax yik t'a masanil tas ix yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayex.
Mokab' b'at satk'olal eyuuj to onh ek'pax chekab'wumal t'a Egipto, palta a Jehová ko Diosal onh kolanelta. Yuj chi' syak' jun cheknab'il tik t'ayex tiknaik.
Palta tato a junok heb' he chekab' chi' max yal-laj sk'ol tz'el t'a libre, yujto xajan ex yuj heb' yet' eyaleyuninal, yujto wach' yajek' heb' heyet'ok,

tato icha chi', tzeyik'kot junok k'een ol-lab' tzeyak'anoch chek'an heb' t'a spuertail he pat, tzeyolan schikin heb' yet' k'een. Icha chi' tz'aj yochkan heb' he chekab'ok t'a junelnhej. Icha pax chi' tz'utaj heb' ix ix tz'ochkan chekab'ok t'a junelnhej.

Mokab' chukok tzeyab'i ayik tzeyak'anel heb' he chekab' chi' t'a libre, yujto wake' ab'il ix ex yak' serwil heb', nanhalnhej tze tup heb' t'a stojol junok mach tz'akan scha stojol t'a junok k'u. Haxo Jehová ko Diosal ol ak'an swach'k'olal t'a yib'anh masanil tas tze k'ulej.

Masanil sb'ab'el yune' nok' he wakax, ma nok' he kalnel, tato winak tze sik'kaneli yik tz'ochkan yikok Jehová ko Diosal. Manh eyak' munlaj nok' b'ab'el yune' he wakax chi', manh he joxpaxel xil nok' b'ab'el yune' he kalnel chi'.
Junjunnhej ab'il tze chi'an nok' yet' eyal eyuninal t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal, t'a jun lugar ol sik'el skajnub'ok.
Palta tato ay jab'ok spaltail nok' jun, tato koxo yok nok', mato chuklaj yol sat nok', ma manh wal wach'ok nok', manh eyak' nok' silab'il t'a Jehová.

Ha nok' chi', syal he chi'an nok' b'aj kajan ex chi'. Yalnhej mach syal schi'an nok', taxonhej wach' yaj heb', icha yalan ley, mato maay, ichataxon tz'aj he chi'an nok' k'ultakil chej, ma nok' ch'ukul.
Palta manh he chi' schiq'uil nok', anhej to tze tob'el t'a sat lu'um, icha tz'aj stob'kanb'at ha ha'.

Ayik ayoch jun uj skuch Abib, hata' tzeyak'och q'uinh yik tze waan ixim pan malaj yich yuj eyik'anchaanh sb'i Jehová ko Diosal, yujto ha t'a jun ak'wal t'a jun uj chi' yik'nak onh elta Jehová t'a Egipto.
Ha t'a sk'ual q'uinh chi', hata' tzeyak' nok' wakax yet' nok' kalnel silab'il t'a Jehová ko Diosal, haton t'a jun lugar ol sik'eli yik tz'och skajnub'ok.

Ha nok' nok' tzeyak' silab'il chi', tze chi nok', tze waanpax ixim pan malaj yich, haton ixim tz'ak'an nachajkot yaelal, yujto elanhchamelxonhej ajnak kelta t'a Egipto chi'. Yuj chi', masanil tiempo tze nanhejkot jun k'u yik kelnakkot t'a Egipto chi'.

Ha t'a uke' k'ual chi', malajokab' jab'ok yich pan ayek' b'aj ol ex kajnaj chi'. Yet' pax nok' chib'ej tzeyak' silab'il t'a yemk'ualil t'a b'ab'el k'u, malaj jab'ok nok' skan t'a yik q'uinhib'alil t'a junxo k'u.
Ha nok' he silab' yik q'uinh chi', max yal-laj he milancham nok' t'a yalnhej tas chonhab'il ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayex.
Palta anhej t'a jun lugar ol sik'eli yik tz'och skajnub'ok, hata' tze milcham nok' t'a yemk'ualil ayik wanxo sb'at k'u, haton t'a jun hora chi' elnak onh kot t'a Egipto.
Ha nok' chib'ej chi', tze b'ol nok', tze chi'an nok' t'a jun lugar ol sik'el Jehová ko Diosal yik tz'och skajnub'ok. Haxo t'a junxo q'uinhib'alil, tzex meltzaj b'ajtak kajan ex.

Ha t'a wake' k'ual chi', anhej ixim pan malaj yich tze wa''a. Haxo t'a yukil k'ual, tze molb'an he b'a yet' niwan tzalajk'olal yuj eyik'anchaanh Jehová ko Diosal. Ha t'a jun k'u chi', malaj junok mach smunlaji.
Ayik tz'el yich sjochchaj ixim trigo, hata' schajiel yich sb'ischaj uke' semana.

Haxo slajwi uke' semana chi', tz'ochpax q'uinh yik slajwi jochoj trigo, yuj yik'jichaanh Jehová. Tzeyak'an eyofrenda to tz'el t'a he k'ol eyak'ani, hato syal jantak swach'k'olal Jehová ko Diosal syak' t'ayex.

Tzeyak'och q'uinh chi' t'a yichanh Jehová chi' t'a jun lugar ol sik'eli yik tz'och skajnub'ok. Hata' tze molb'ej he b'a yet' heb' eyal eyuninal yet' pax heb' tik: Eb' he chekab', heb' lewita kajan t'a he kal, heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, heb' manhxa smam yet' heb' ix chamnak yetb'eyum ayek' kajan t'a he kal.
Naekpaxkot a ex tik to chekab' ajnak ex ek' t'a Egipto. Yuj chi' tzeyil wal tas tz'aj he b'eyb'alan masanil tas syal jun cheknab'il tik.
Ayik toxo ix lajwiek' jochoj trigo chi' jun yet' yik toxo ix lajwi he pitz'anel yal sat eyuwa, tzeyak'anoch uke' k'ual q'uinh yik chinama.

Tzex tzalaj t'a jun q'uinh chi' yet' heb' eyal eyuninal yet' pax heb' tik: Eb' he chekab', heb' lewita, heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, heb' unin manhxalaj smam yet' heb' ix ix chamnak yetb'eyum ayek' kajan t'a he kal.

Ha jun q'uinh chi', uke' k'ual tzeyak'ochi yuj eyik'anchaanh Jehová ko Diosal, t'a jun lugar ol sik'eli yik tz'och skajnub'ok, yik wach' ol yak' swach'k'olal Jehová chi' t'a yib'anh eyawb'en yet' t'a yib'anh he munlajel. Icha chi' ol aj eyek' t'a tzalajk'olal.

Masanil heb' winh winak, yowalil tz'och heb' winh t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal t'a jun lugar ol sik'eli, oxel tz'och heb' winh t'a yol ab'il, haton t'a oxe' q'uinh tik: Q'uinh yik ixim pan malaj yich, q'uinh yik slajwi jochoj trigo yet' q'uinh chinama. Malaj junok mach sk'och t'a yichanh Jehová tato malaj yofrenda yet'nak,
palta junjun anima syik'b'at yofrenda, icha syal jantak swach'k'olal Jehová ko Diosal syak' t'ay.
Ol eyak'och heb' juez yet' heb' yajal t'a junjun chonhab' ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'a junjun eyinhtilal, yik wach' a heb' ol b'oan yaj t'a stojolal tastak sk'e waan t'a he kal.

Mokab' sk'ex tojolal heb' t'a manh stojolalok. Mokab' ch'okch'okok heb' anima t'a yol sat heb', mokab' scha tumin heb' yik smontaj heb', yujto a k'een tumin yik montub'al chi' tz'ixtanel spensar heb' aj pensar. Hanhejtona' yuj k'een tumin chi' sk'ex slolonel heb' tojol.
Anhejokab' tojolal tze k'ulej, ayik ol ex ek' t'a sat lum lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayex.
Ayik tze b'oan altar t'a Jehová ko Diosal, manh eyak'em junok te te' yechel ix Dios skuchan Asera t'a stz'ey chi'.
Manh he b'opaxk'e chek'an junok k'een k'een yechel komon Dios Baal ta', yujto yajb'ilel juntzanh chi' yuj Jehová ko Diosal.
Manh eyak' nok' wakax, ma nok' kalnel silab'il t'a Jehová ko Diosal tato ay spaltail sniwanil nok', yujto chuklaj t'a Jehová tato icha chi' sko k'ulej.

Tato ha t'a juntzanh chonhab' ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal chi' t'ayex, ol el spekal to ay junok winak, ma junok ix ix max k'anab'ajan strato Jehová chi', haxo t'a juntzanh komon Dios tz'och ejmelal, t'a k'u, t'a k'een uj, ma t'a k'een k'anal, haton juntzanh ix yal Jehová to max yal-laj koch ejmelal t'ay,
ayik tz'ab'chaj spekal chi', scham wal sb'eyk'olaji. Tato yel ix sk'ulej jun yajb'entak chi' jun anima chi',
yowalil tzeyik'el t'a stiel he chonhab' yik tze julk'enanchamok.
Palta max yal-laj yoch chamel t'a yib'anh jun anima chi' tato junnhej testigo. Yowalil ay chawanhok, ma oxwanhok testigo, ichato chi' tz'och chamel chi' t'a yib'anh.
Ha heb' testigo chi' sb'ab'laj julanoch k'een t'a jun anima chi'. Ichato chi' sjulanoch k'een masanil heb' anima t'ay. Icha chi' tz'aj yel jun chukal chi' t'a he kal.

Tato ay junok tas tz'ak'ji he ch'olb'itej yaji, palta tato max nachajel eyuuj tas tzeyutej he b'oan yaji, icha junok owal yik chamel, ma yuj junok mach slajwi, ma junokxo komon owal sk'e waan t'a he kal, tzex b'at t'a jun lugar sik'b'ilel yuj Jehová ko Diosal skajnub'ok,
tze mol alej yet' heb' sakerdote yinhtilal Leví yet' heb' juez ayoch t'a yopisio. Ha heb' chi' tz'alani tas tz'aj sb'oi.
Ha exxo tik tze k'anab'ajej tas tz'aj yalan heb' chi'.
Icha wal tz'aj yalchaj chi', icha chi' tze k'ulej. Malaj wal jab'ok tas tze k'exa'.

Palta tato ay mach tzek' t'a yib'anh, skomon b'oan t'a yol yiko', manh ichok ix aj yalan heb' sakerdote ay yopisio yuj Dios, mato max sk'anab'ajej pax tas ix yal winh juez, a jun chi' tz'och chamel t'a yib'anh. Icha chi' tz'aj satel jun pital tz'och t'a tas syal heb' yajal chi' t'a he kal.
Ayik ol yab'an jun chi' heb' chonhab', ol xiw heb', manhxo ol sk'ulej heb' icha chi'.

Ayik ayexxo och t'a sat lum lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayex, ayik toxo ix eyak' ganar eyik'an lu'um, kajan exxo ta', talaj tze komon alej icha tik: Kak'ekoch junok ko reyal ol ak'an yajalil t'ayonh, icha juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a ko lak'anil tik. Tato ol eyal icha chi',
a junok ketchonhab' ol sik'el Jehová ko Diosal, ha' ol eyak'och he reyalok. Manhok junok ch'ok chonhab'il ol eyak'och he reyalok, yujto manh ketchonhab'ok.

Palta a jun rey chi', mokab' tzijtumok nok' schej smolb'ej, mokab' schekb'at heb' winak t'a Egipto yik sb'at heb' yik'kot jantakok nok' chej ta', yujto a Jehová alannakkani to manhxa b'ak'uinh tzex b'atxi t'a Egipto chi'.
