Mokab' tzijtumok tz'aj heb' ix yetb'eyum, yik max juwiel t'a yichanh Jehová yuj heb' ix. Mokab' ste molb'ej k'een oro yet' k'een plata.
Ayik tz'och jun rey chi' t'a yopisio, schek tz'ib'chajelta skopiail juntzanh sk'ayb'ub'al Dios tik, haton juntzanh ayek' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' sakerdote yinhtilalkan Leví.

Yowalil yet'naknhej skopiail jun sk'ayb'ub'al Dios tik, sk'ayb'an t'a junjun k'u, yik wach' ay yelk'och Jehová ko Diosal t'a yol sat, ay pax yelk'och jun k'ayb'ub'al tik t'a yol sat, sb'eyb'alan tas syal juntzanh cheknab'il tik.
Yik wach' max sna'paxi to niwan yelk'och t'a yichanh heb' ketchonhab', max yik'el sb'a t'a juntzanh scheknab'il Jehová tik. Icha chi' ol aj snajtilax yopisio yet' yinhtilal t'a he kal.

Ha heb' sakerdote yinhtilalkan Leví yet' masanil heb' yetlewitail heb', malaj smakb'en lum heb' ol yik'a', icha juntzanhxo heb' ketisraelal. Ha juntzanh silab' snhusjitz'a t'a Jehová ol schi heb', ma ol swa heb' yik ol ek' tiempo yuj heb'. Ha tas yik Jehová, a chi' yik heb'.
Manh ol scha slum heb' icha yik juntzanh heb' ketchonhab', yujto a tas yik Jehová, a ayoch smakb'enok heb', icha ajnak yalan Jehová.
Ha tas yiktaxon heb' sakerdote t'a nok' wakax yet' t'a nok' kalnel syak' heb' anima silab'il, haton juntzanh tik: Sjenhjab' nok', sb'ak'chil sti' nok' yet' spimal stzukutz nok'.
Yik pax heb' yaj ixim b'ab'el trigo, b'ab'el wino, b'ab'el akeite yet' nok' b'ab'el lana tz'el t'a nok' kalnel ayik sjoxchaj nok'.
Yujto a Jehová ko Diosal ix sik'anel heb' yinhtilal Leví t'a skal masanil juntzanhxo kinhtilal, yik syak' serwil Jehová heb' t'a masanil tiempo.
Tato ay junok lewita t'a he kal, te ay snib'ej sb'at t'a jun lugar ix sik'kanel Jehová yik tz'och skajnub'ok yik b'at munlaj ta',
syal smunlaji. Lajan tz'aj icha heb' yetlewitail smunlaj ta',
schaan swael icha yik heb' chi', wach'chom ay tas ay t'ay.
Ayik ayexxoek' t'a lum lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayex, manh he b'eyb'alej sb'eyb'al juntzanh heb' anima kajan ta'.
Malajokab' junok ex tze nhustz'a eyuninal silab'il. Malajokab' junok ex tzeyak' chum, ma tze naanel tastak ol ujok, ma ajb'aalil,
ma tze k'uman spixan heb' chamnak eyalani.

Yujto a masanil heb' sk'ulan juntzanh chukal chi', te aykot yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a yib'anh heb'. Yujto yuj juntzanh tas te chuk sk'ulej heb' chi', yuj chi' ol satjokel heb' t'a eyichanh yuj Jehová chi'.
Yowalil te wach' tzeyutej he b'eyb'al t'a yichanh Jehová chi'.
Ha heb' anima ay t'a juntzanh chonhab' ol eyikej chi', syak'och sk'ool heb' tas syal heb' ajchum yet' t'a heb' ajb'aal. Ha exxo jun, max schalaj sk'ol Jehová ko Diosal tato icha chi' tze k'ulej.
Ha ko Diosal chi' ol sik'anel junok ketchonhab' tik schekab'ok, icha ix yutej in sik'anel a in tik. Yowalil ol he k'anab'ajej tas ol yala'.

Haton tik he k'annak t'a Jehová ko Diosal ayik ayonh ek' t'a lum witz Horeb, t'a jun k'u a molan onh ek' ta', eyalan icha tik: Manhxalaj ko gana skab' sjaj Jehová ko Diosal chi', ma kilan jun niwan k'ak' chi', yik wach' max onh chami, xe chi.
Yuj chi' yal Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Wach' tas ix yal heb' anima chi'.
Ol wik'chaanh junok in chekab' t'a he kal icha ach tik, junok eyetchonhab'. A' in ol wak' yojtakejel tas ol yala', ol yalan t'ayex masanil tas ol wal chi'.
Ha mach max chaan yab' tas ol in chek yal jun in chekab' chi', yowalil ol wak' yowalil t'ay, yujto a jun in chekab' chi' ol lolon in k'exulok.
Haxo pax mach syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok, palta malaj tas swal t'ay, ma jun, schekab' junokxo komon Dios, a jun chi' yowalil schami, xchikan Jehová chi'.
Palta tato a ex tik ol he na'a: ¿Tas wal ol aj kojtakaneli tato manhok Jehová schekan yal jun chekab' chi'? tato xe chi.
Tato max elk'och tas syal jun syesejoch sb'a schekab'ok Jehová chi', snachajel eyuuj to manhok Jehová tz'ak'an yala', anhej t'a yol yik snak'ei. Yuj chi' manh ex xiw t'ay.
Ayik toxo ix satel masanil juntzanh anima yuj Jehová ko Diosal, toxo ix eyikej schonhab' heb', slum heb' yet' spat heb'.
Ha t'a skal juntzanh chi' ol he sik'el oxeok chonhab' haton juntzanh ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal eyikok.

Oxe' makan ol aj he pojan lu'um. Ha t'a snanhaltak yol junjun makan lu'um chi', hata' skan junjunok juntzanh chonhab' chi'. Ol he b'oan sb'eal juntzanh chonhab' chi', yik wach' yalnhej mach smak'ancham junok yetanimail, syal sb'at skol sb'a t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi'.
Anhej mach smak'ancham junok anima, tato manh sk'anok sk'ool, manh yajk'olok sb'a heb', hata' b'at skol sb'a, yik wach' max chami.

Q'uinalok ay chawanhok heb' winh sb'at k'atzitz, tato ay junok heb' winh tz'elta k'een sch'akab', swa k'een t'a junxo winh chi', scham winh, a winh tz'elta k'een sch'akab' chi' syal sb'at winh skol sb'a t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi'.

Q'uinalok junnhej chonhab', najat sb'at sb'eal, ay smay syamchaj winh yuj junok sk'ab' yok winh ix cham chi', smak'ancham winh chi' yet' yowal sk'ool, palta manh smojok scham winh, yujto toxonton manh yajk'olok sb'a heb' winh.
Yuj chi' swal t'ayex to tze sik'kanel oxeok chonhab' b'aj syal skolan sb'a anima.

Tato ol he b'eyb'alejnhej juntzanh cheknab'il swal tik t'ayex, yujto tze xajanej Jehová ko Diosal, tze k'anab'ajani, ol yak' lum lum chi' Jehová smasanil t'ayex, icha wal ajnak yak'an sti' t'a heb' ko mam kicham. Ayik ol lewanb'ok lum he lu'um chi' yuj Jehová ko Diosal, ol he sik'anel oxeokxo chonhab' stz'akub'ok oxe' chekelxo yaj chi', haton b'aj syal he kolan he b'a.
Icha chi' ol he k'ulej, yik wach' manh komonok ol cham junok anima malaj smul t'a lum lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayex, yik wach' max kotkan t'a eyib'anh yuj heb' anima scham chi'.

Q'uinalok ay chawanhok heb' winh toxon yajk'ol sb'a, a junok winh smaklan yek' junxo winh chi' yik smak'ancham winh, ayik smak'ancham winh chi' winh, sb'at winh skol sb'a t'a junok juntzanh chonhab' chi'.

Tato icha chi', haxo heb' winh yichamtak winakil schonhab' winh ix cham chi', a heb' winh schekanb'at yamchaj winh ix sb'at skol sb'a chi' ta', tz'ik'jib'at winh t'a schonhab' yik tz'ak'jioch winh t'a yol sk'ab' junok sk'ab' yok winh ix cham chi', yik smak'jipaxcham winh.
Manh eyak' niwank'olal jun anima chi', yik wach' max kan schamel junok anima malaj smul t'a eyib'anh, yik wach' ol aj eyelk'ochi.
Ha t'a lum lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal chi' t'ayex, manh he k'ex stz'akanhil he lum aykanem yuj he mam eyicham yik tze tok'an ek' yik junokxo mach ay yik t'a stitak eyiko'.
Tato junnhej testigo t'a spatik junok anima tz'och smul, max yal-laj yoch t'a yib'anh. Masanto ay chawanhok, ma oxwanhok testigo, ichato chi' tz'och t'a yib'anh jun ay smul chi'.
Q'uinalok ay junok chuk spensar syik'chaanh junok esal lolonel t'a spatik junok mach yik syik'ankot t'a yib'anh.
Tato icha chi', yowalil tz'ik'jib'at heb' schawanhil t'a yichanh Jehová, haton t'a yichanh heb' sakerdote yet' heb' juez ayoch t'a yopisio.
Ha heb' ayoch yajalil chi', a heb' sch'olb'itani tato yel jun lolonel chi', mato es syik'chaanh jun anima t'a spatik junxo chi'.
Ha t'a yib'anh jun tz'esan chi', hata' tz'ochkan jantak tas ix snib'ej yak'och t'a yib'anh junxo anima chi'. Icha chi' tz'aj slajwi jun esalwumal chi' t'a he kal.
Ayik ol yab'an jun chi' heb' anima, ol xiw heb', manhxo ol sk'ulej heb' icha chi'.

Mokab' ok' he k'ol t'a junok esalwum chi'. Icha wal tas snib'ej t'a spatik yetanimail chi', icha chi' tz'utaji. Tato snib'ej to smak'jicham jun yetanimail chi', ma tz'ik'jielta yol sat, ma smak'jiel ye, ma xikjiel sk'ab', ma yok, icha wal snib'ej tz'utaj jun anima chi', icha chi' tz'utaji.

Ayik tzex b'at owal, manh ex xiw t'a heb' eyajk'ool chi. Wach'chom tzeyila' to ek'to sb'isul heb' t'ayex, niwanpax sb'isul nok' schej heb' yet' skarruaje heb' yik owal yet' soldado heb', manh ex xiwok yujto a Jehová ko Diosal ik'jinak onh elta t'a Egipto, ha' ol och heyet'ok.
Ayik manto k'och yorail yoch owal chi', a winh sakerdote tz'alan t'a heb' soldado icha tik:
Ab'ek ex wetchonhab', a tiknaik toxo ol eyak' owal yet' heb' kajk'ool, mokab' chab'axk'e he k'ool, manh ex xiwok. Manh ex ib'xokk'e yuj xiwelal,
yujto a Jehová ko Diosal ayoch ket'ok. Ha ol ak'an owal yet' heb' kajk'ool chi', yuj chi' ol kak' ganar heb', xcham winh.

Slajwi chi', syalan heb' yajalil heb' soldado icha tik: Tato ay junok ex toto ix he b'ok'e he pat, manto ex ochlaj t'a yool, meltzajanhek, q'uinalok tzex cham t'a skal owal tik, ch'okxo mach skajnajkan t'a yol he pat chi'.
Tato ay pax junok mach t'a ko kal tik ix yawej yuwa, manta jab'ok sat smolo', meltzajokab' t'a spat. Q'uinalok scham t'a skal owal tik, ch'okxo mach smolan sat yuwa chi'.
Tato ay junok ex ayxo he trato he nupnaji, palta manto ex nupnajok, meltzajanhek yik tzex nupnaji. Q'uinalok tzex cham t'a skal owal tik, ch'okxopax mach snupnaj yet' ix ix chi', xcham heb'.
Slajwi chi' syalanpax heb' yajalil soldado chi': Tato ayex tzex xiwi, meltzajanhek t'a he pat, yik wach' malaj heb' schab'axk'e sk'ool eyuuj, xcham heb'.
Ayik slajwi slolon masanil heb' yajal chi', tz'ak'jioch yopisio junjun kuchb'um t'a junjun makan heb' soldado.
Tato tzex k'och t'a spatiktak junok chonhab' yik tzeyak'an owal yet'ok, b'ab'el tzeyala': ¿E gana am junk'olal, mato owal? xe chi.
Tato a heb' ay t'a jun chonhab' chi' snib'ej junk'olal, tzex schaanoch heb' t'a yol schonhab' chi', yowalil tzeyak' pural heb' yochkan he chekab'ok.
Palta tato malaj snib'ej heb' yoch junk'olal heyet'ok jun, tato syal heb': Kaq'ek owal, tato xchi heb', tzex oymaj t'a spatiktak schonhab' heb' chi', tzeyak'an owal.
Haxo Jehová ko Diosal ol ak'anoch heb' t'a yol he k'ab', ol he xikancham masanil heb' winh winak.

Haxonhej heb' ix ix yet' heb' unin, nok' molb'etzal nok' yet' masanil tas ay t'a jun chonhab' chi', eyik tz'ajkani. Tzex tzalaj yet' masanil tastak ol scha sk'ol Jehová ko Diosal yik skan t'a yol he k'ab', haton masanil tas ol eyik' t'a heb' ajk'ool chi'.
Ichanhej chi' ol he k'ulej yet' juntzanh nakión najat ay b'aj ol ex kajnaj chi'.
Palta a juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a lum lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal eyikej, manhxa junok anima tzeyaktejkani.
Ol he satel juntzanh heb' tik: Eb' hitita, heb' amorreo, heb' kananeo, heb' ferezeo, heb' heweo yet' heb' jebuseo, icha wal ajnak yalan Jehová.

Icha chi' tzeyutej heb', yik wach' max ex sk'ayb'ej heb' he b'eyb'alan juntzanh tas te chuk sk'ulej ayik syak'anem sb'a heb' t'a diosal. Tato tze k'ulej tas sk'ulej heb' chi', tz'och he mul t'a Jehová ko Diosal.

Tato niwan tiempo tzex och hoyan t'a spatiktak junok chonhab', manh he ch'akel te te' sloji sat, yujto ol he lo sat te'. Ha te' awb'en te' chi', manh animaok te', max yal-laj skot te' t'ayex yak' owal heyet'ok.
Ha pax te' komon te' max loji sat jun, tze ch'akel te' yik tz'och te' he tek'nub'ok t'a spatiktak jun chonhab' chi', masanto satel jun chonhab' chi' eyuuj.
Tato tz'ilchaj sniwanil junok anima t'a spatiktakel he chonhab' t'a lum lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal eyikej chi', manh chekelok mach ix mak'anchamok,
a heb' winh juez yet' heb' winh yichamtak winakil juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a slak'anil jun chamnak chi', a heb' tz'echtani mach junok juntzanh chonhab' chi' lak'an ay b'aj ix cham jun anima chi'.
Slajwi chi', haxo heb' winh yichamtak winakil chonhab' ay t'a slak'anil chi', a heb' winh tz'ik'anb'at junok nok' kob'es wakax manta b'aj tz'och te' yugo t'ay,
syik'anem nok' heb' winh t'a sch'olanil sti' junok ha' melem b'aj mantalaj mach smunlaji. Hata' smak'ji kanhchaj sjaj nok' wakax chi'.

Haxo heb' sakerdote yinhtilal Leví tz'och testigoal t'ay, yujto anhej heb' sb'oan yaj owal yet' tastak chukal tzuji t'a skal he chonhab', haton heb' sik'b'ilel yuj Jehová ko Diosal, ayoch heb' yak'an serwil yet' yalan wach' lolonel t'a Jehová chi'.
Slajwi chi', masanil heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' chi' sb'ikel sk'ab' heb' t'a yib'anh nok' kob'es wakax chamnakxo chi',
syalan juntzanh lolonel heb' icha tik: Ha onh tik, manhok onh ix ko mak'cham jun anima tik, manh kojtakok mach ix mak'anchamok.
Mamin Jehová, ak' niwank'olal t'a kib'anh, mokab' ak'kanoch schamel jun anima tik ko mulok a onh a chonhab' onh kolb'il onh tik uuj, xcham heb'. Icha chi' tz'aj sb'o yaj schamel jun chamnak chi'.
Tato icha chi' sk'ulej heb', manhxalaj yalan yik heb' t'a jun chamnak chi', yujto ix sk'anab'ajej heb' tas syal Jehová.
Ayik tzeyak'an owal yet' heb' ajk'ool, tato tzeyak' ganar heb' yuj Jehová ko Diosal, tzeyik'ankot heb' he chekab'ok.
Tato ay mach t'a he kal tz'ilanoch junok ix ix te wach' yilji t'a skal heb', skan snib'ej t'a ix, syik'anb'at ix t'a spat,
hata' sjoxel xil sjolom ix, syik'anel yech ix,
sk'exchajel spichul ix ayochi ayik ix ik'jikot ix chi', skannhej ix t'a spat winh winak chi'. Jun ujal tz'ok' ix yuj smam snun. Slajwi chi', syik'an ix winh yetb'eyumok.
Tato slajwi chi', manhxa snib'ej winh t'a ix, syal yak'anel ix winh t'a libre. Palta max yal-laj schonhjiel ix, ma yoch ix schekab'ok winh, yujto toxo ix ixtaj ix yuj winh.

Q'uinalok ay junok winh winak chawanh yetb'eyum, jun ix te xajan yuj winh, haxo junxo ix chakb'ilel yuj winh. Tato tz'alji yune' heb' ix schawanhil, tato a jun ix chakb'ilel chi' sb'ab'laj alji yune',

ayik sk'och sk'ual spojanek' stastak winh, syak'an winh t'a heb' yuninal, max yal-laj yoch yune' ix xajanab'il chi' b'ab'el uninal. Q'uinalok icha b'ab'el unin syutej winh, chuk sk'ulej winh t'a winh sb'ab'el unin yik ix chakb'ilel chi', yujto a winh chi' yel b'ab'el unin yaj winh.
Yowalil a winh chi' b'ab'el unin yaji. Ha winh schaan cha makan smakb'en yik sb'ab'el uninab'il.
Tato ay mach ay junok yuninal te chuk, ma te pit, max sk'anab'ajej tas syal smam snun, wach'chom smak'ji, palta hanheja' max sk'anab'ajej.
Tato icha chi', a heb' mamab'il nunab'il chi', yowalil syik'b'at jun yune' heb' chi' t'a yichanh heb' winh yichamtak winakil chonhab',
syalan heb' icha tik: Ha wal jun kune' tik, te pit, te chuk. Max onh sk'anab'ajej, haxonhej chukal sk'ulej, te b'uk'tzin, anhej uk'el anh syak'a', xcham heb'.

Tato icha chi', haxo masanil heb' winh winak t'a jun chonhab' chi' sjulk'enancham jun yune' heb' chi'. Icha chi' tz'aj yik'jiel jantak chukal ay t'a yol he chonhab' chi'. Ayik syab'an jun chi' heb' ketchonhab' smasanil, sxiwk'e heb'.
Tato ay junok winak smak'jicham yuj schukal, sk'e lokan t'a junok te te',

a sniwanil chi', max kanlaj ta' tzek' ak'wal, yowalil smukchaj t'a jun k'u chi', yik wach' max eyixtejb'at lum lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal chi' t'ayex, yujto aykot skatab' Dios t'a yib'anh mach sk'e lokan t'a junok te te' chi'.
Tato ay junok ex tzeyil satkan nok' swakax, ma skalnel junok heb' eyetchonhab', manh tonhejok tzeyilkan nok', palta to tzeyik'kot nok' t'a jun eyetchonhab' chi'.

Tato manhok t'a he lak'anil kajan jun ay yik nok' chi', mato manh eyojtakok mach ay yik nok', tzeyik'kot nok', wach'okab' tz'aj nok' t'a he pat chi' masanto sayjiek' nok' yuj winh yajal nok' chi', ichato chi' tzeyak'an meltzaj nok' t'a winh.
Icha pax chi' tze k'ulej yet' junok nok' b'uru, ma junok k'apak k'apak, ma junok yalnhej tas satb'ati. Tato ay junok ex tzeyila', mokab' tonhejok tzeyilkani.
Tato ay junok ex tzeyil stelwi nok' sb'uru, ma nok' swakax junok eyetchonhab' t'a yoltak b'e, mokab' tonhejok tzeyiloch heb', palta to tzex och yet' heb' eyik'ank'e waan nok'.

Ha heb' ix ix, max yal-laj sk'anan tastak sk'an heb' winh winak heb' ix, hanheja' heb' winh winak max yalpaxlaj yak'anoch spichul heb' ix ix heb' winh, yujto syajji mach icha chi' sk'ulej yuj Jehová ko Diosal.

Tato ay junok mach ex tzeyil junok so' nok' much t'a yol b'e t'a sk'ab' junok te te', mato sat lu'um ayemi, ayoch nok' snun chi' t'a yib'anh yune', ma t'a yib'anh snholob', manh eyik'b'at nok' snun chi' yet' yune' chi'.
Syal eyik'anb'at nok' yune' chi', haxo nok' snun chi' tzeyaktejkanb'at nok' yik wach' ol ex elk'ochok, ol najatb'ok he k 'inal.
Tato ay junok ex tze b'ok'e junok he pat, panhan tz'aj yib'anh, tzeyak'ek' hoyan stitak t'a yib'anh chi' yik wach' malaj mach skot sutnajok, schami, yik max kot t'a eyib'anh.
Manh eyawej juntzanhokxo tas t'a skal b'aj awab'il eyuwa, talaj tz'ak'ji yowalil t'ayex, haxo tz'aji malaj junok makan schaji he lo sat.
Ayik tzex munlaj yet' arado, manh eyak'och te' yugo t'a junok nok' wakax yet' t'a junok nok' b'uru yik junnhej smunlaj nok' schawanhil.
Manh eyak'och pichul jalb'il t'a nok' lana yet' lino.
Tze b'ooch chanheok schional yelwanub'ok schikintak he xotil.
Tato ay junok winak tz'ik'an junok ix ix yetb'eyumok, haxo tz'aji maxtzak xajanej ix winh,
syalan winh to ay smul ix, snaank'e lolonel winh t'a spatik ix, syalan winh: Ix wik' jun ix ix tik, haxo ix in way yet' ix, ix wilani to manhxo kob'esoklaj ix, xchi winh.
Tato icha chi', haxo smam snun ix kob'es chi' tz'ik'anb'at yechel yik skob'esal ix t'a yichanh sdespacho heb' winh yichamtak winakil chonhab'.
Syalan winh smam ix chi' icha tik t'a heb' winh: Ix wak' ix wisil yetb'eyumok jun winh tik. Haxo tiknaik manhxa snib'ej winh t'a ix,

tzijtum tas syal winh. Tob' ay smul ix. Syalan winh to manhxo kob'esok ix, palta ina wal sch'oxnab'il skob'esal ix tik, xchi winh smam ix chi'. Ayik wan yalan winh icha chi', sch'oxan jun sábana winh t'a yichanh heb' winh yichamtak winakil chonhab' chi'.
Haxo heb' winh syaman winh winak chi', smak'an winh heb' winh t'a nok' tz'uum.

Slajwi chi' syak'an kien siklo k'een plata winh smultaok, yujto syesejk'e winh t'a spatik jun ix kob'es israel, syalan winh to ayxo smul ix. Ha jun tumin chi' tz'ak'ji t'a winh smam ix kob'es chi'. Manh yujok chi' maxtzak yik' ix winh, palta yowalil syik'nhej ix winh masanto chamel.
Palta tato yel a junok ix ix chi' manhxo kob'esok ix ayik ix nupnaj ix, malaj yechel t'a ix,

tz'ik'jiel ix t'a sti' spat smam, sjulk'enajcham ix yuj masanil heb' winh winak ay t'a jun chonhab' chi', yujto ix yak'och jun niwan mul ix t'a he kal, syak'anpax q'uixwelal smam ix. Icha chi' tz'aj satel juntzanh chukal chi' t'a he kal.
Tato ay junok winh winak smulan yet' junok ix ix ay yetb'eyum, tz'ilchajelta heb', scham heb' schawanhil, icha chi' tz'aj satel jun chukal chi' t'a he kal.
Tato ay junok ix kob'es ayxo strato snupnaji, haxo tz'aji ay junokxo winak tz'ixtan ix t'a yol junok chonhab',

tz'ik'jib'at heb' schawanhil t'a yichanh despacho t'a chonhab' chi'. Hata' sjulk'enajcham heb' schawanhil. Scham ix yujto maj el yaw ix yik ay mach skolani. Schampax winh winak chi' yujto ix yixtej jun ix ayxo strato yoch yetb'eyumok jun winh yetwinakil winh. Icha chi' tz'aj satel jun chukal chi' t'a he kal.

Tato ay junok ix ix ayxo strato yoch yetb'eyum, schalan sb'a ix yet' junok winh winak b'aj malaj anima, tz'ixtaj ix yuj winh, tato icha chi', anhej winh winak chi' schami yujto ix ak'ji pural ix yuj winh.
Haxo ix kob'es chi', malaj tas tz'alchaj t'a ix, yujto malaj smul ix, max yal-laj scham ix. Ha jun tas sk'ulej winh winak chi' lajan icha junok winh smak'cham junok yetanimail,
yujto sch'okoj ix ayek' b'aj malaj anima. Wach'chom tz'el yaw ix, palta malaj mach skolan ix.
Tato ay junok winh winak schalaj sb'a yet' junok ix kob'es mantalaj mach ay strato yet'ok, syak'an pural winh yixtan ix, tz'ilchajelta heb',
a winh winak chi' yowalil syak' 50 siklo k'een plata winh t'a winh smam ix, yujto ix ak'ji pural ix yuj winh. Yowalil syik'xonhej ix winh yetb'eyumok, masanto chamel.
Malajokab' junok mach tz'em ajmulal yet' ix yetb'eyum smam. Tato ay mach sk'ulan icha chi', malaj yelk'och smam t'a yol sat syal chi'.
Tato ay mach mak'b'ilpoj snholob' sk'een, ma ik'b'ilel swinakil chi', max yal-laj yoch t'a skal heb' yetisraelal ayik molanek' heb' yik'anchaanh Jehová.
Hanheja' junok mitz' unin, malaj pax yalan yik yoch t'a skal heb' smolb'ej sb'a yik syik'anchaanh Jehová. Hanhejtona' pax yinhtilal t'a b'ak'uinh max yalpaxlaj yochi.
Ha heb' amonita yet' heb' moabita, junelnhej malaj yalan yik heb' yoch t'a skal b'aj molanek' heb' schonhab' Jehová, ma yinhtilal heb' t'a b'ak'uinh.

Yujto ayik ix onh ek'ta t'a yol smakb'en heb', ayik ix onh elta t'a Egipto, maj yak'laj jab'ok ha' heb' kuk'ej, maj yak'paxlaj jab'ok ko wael heb'. Ha tas ix sk'ulej heb' to ix stup winhaj Balaam yuninal winhaj Beor heb', ix kot winh t'a Petor t'a yol yik Mesopotamia, yik tzul onh skatab'ankan winh.

Haxo Jehová ko Diosal, maj schalaj yab' tas ix yal winhaj Balaam chi', yuj chi' a katab' ijan ix yalkan winh chi' t'a kib'anh, wach' lolonel ix aj yalankan winh, yujto te xajan onh yuj Jehová ko Diosal.
Yuj chi' junelnhej malajokab' b'ak'uinh tzex och t'a junk'olal yet' heb'. Manh he b'opax tas yuj swach'ilok heb'.
Palta haxo pax heb' edomita, manh he patikejkanel heb', yujto ayto kuj ko b'a yet' heb'. Manh he patikejpaxel heb' aj Egipto, yujto ek'nak onh kajan jun pekti' t'a yol smakb'en heb'.
Hato heb' yixchikin heb' ayxo yalan yik yoch t'a ko kal b'aj sko molb'ej ko b'a yuj kik'anchaanh Jehová.
Ayik tzex b'at t'a owal yet' heb' eyajk'ool, ayik ayex ek' ta', manh he k'ulej tas chakb'ilel yuj Jehová.
Tato ay junok winh winak tz'el yinhatil ayik waynak, yowalil tz'elkan winh t'a spatiktak kampamento tzek' k'u.
Haxo t'a yemk'ualil, wach' syutej winh sb'ikanel sb'a, haxo yik sq'uik'b'i, tz'ochxikan winh t'a yol kampamento chi'.
Yowalil junnhej junok b'aj t'a spatikel kampamento b'aj tzex tzaji.
Ayik tzex b'at tzajel, tzeyik'b'at junok te te' t'a yol he pa, pach yaj snhi' te', tze joy junok olan, tzex tzajiem t'a yool. Slajwi chi', tzeyak'ankank'e lum lum t'a yib'anh.

Yujto a Jehová ko Diosal ajun heyet'ok, yiknhej yaj jun kampamento chi'. Ha tzex tanhwani, skolwajpax heyet'ok yik tzeyak'an ganar heb' eyajk'ol chi'. Max yal-laj to ay tas chuklaj ay t'a he kal chi', talaj tz'el Jehová chi' t'a he kal yuj jun chi'.
Tato ay junok chekab' tz'el elelal t'a spatrón, snib'ej tz'aj heyet'ok, manh eyak' meltzaj t'a spatrón chi'.
Kanokab' heyet'ok. Libre sik'lan junok chonhab' b'aj snib'ej tz'aji. Malajokab' mach stzuntzani.
Malajokab' junok winh winak, ma junok ix ix t'a ko kal syak'och sb'a ajmulal yik tz'och ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios.
Ha k'een tumin syak' ganar junok ix ix, ma junok winh winak t'a spatik yajmulal, manh he cha yak' k'een heb' b'aj syak' sti' yak'an t'a Jehová, yujto a jun b'eyb'al chi' te chakb'ilel yuj.
Ayik tzeyak'an k'een tumin majanil t'a junok ketchonhab', manh he k'an yune' k'een, ma yalnhej tastak, manh he k'an smajananub'al.

Ha t'a junok ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal syal he k'anan smajananub'al junok tas tzeyak' smajnej. Haxo t'a junok ketchonhab', manh he k'ana', yik wach' ol yak' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a eyib'anh t'a sat lum lum ol eyikej chi'.
Ayik tzeyak'an he ti' t'a Jehová ko Diosal, elanhchamel tze k'anab'ajej, yujto ol sk'anb'ej Jehová chi' t'ayex. Tato max eyak'a' tz'och he mul.
Tato malaj b'aj tzeyak' he ti' t'a Jehová chi' jun, malaj b'aj syal yoch he mul.
Tato ay b'aj tzeyak' he ti' eyak'an jun, yowalil tzeyak'elk'ochi, icha wal tas tz'el t'a he k'ool.
Ayik tzex och t'a skal smunlajel junok heb' ketchonhab', syal he loan sat yuwa icha jantak snib'ej he k'ol he loani, palta max yal-laj eyik'anb'at jab'ok t'a yol he pa.
Tato tzex och t'a skal strigo junok heb' ketchonhab', syal he k'utzanelta ixim sjolom he k'uxu', palta max yal-laj tze jochelta ixim yet' k'een jochlab' trigo yik tzeyik'anb'ati.

Tato ay junok winh winak syik'laj sb'a yet' junok ix ix, haxo tzek' jab'ok tiempo, ay tas syab' winh t'a spatik ix, manhxalaj snib'ej winh t'a ix, syal spukan sb'a heb', palta yowalil syak' yumal yik puklajb'ail winh t'a ix, slajwi chi' tz'elta ix t'a yol spat winh chi'.
Ayik toxo ix spuk sb'a ix yet' winh, syal yik'an junokxo winak ix.
Palta tato a junxo winh syik' ix chi' schami, mato tonhej manhxa snib'ej winh t'a ix, syak'anpax yumal yik puklajb'ail winh t'a ix, spechanelta ix winh t'a yol spat,
maxtzak yal-laj yik'an ix winh b'ab'el yetb'eyum chi', yujto manh wach'ok tato syik'xi ix winh. Chukxo t'a yol sat Jehová ko Diosal. Yuj chi' manh eyixtejb'at lum lum ol yak' Jehová chi' eyikej.

Tato ay junok winh winak toto ix och yetb'eyum, max yal-laj sb'at winh t'a owal. Max yalpaxlaj yoch winh t'a junok opisio. Jun ab'il libre tz'ajkan winh t'a spat yik syak'an tzalajb'ok sk'ol winh yet' ix yetb'eyum chi'.
Tato ay junok mach smajnan tumin t'ayex, manh he k'anek' smolino, ma scha' yuj smajananub'alok. Tato icha chi' tze k'ulej, ichato tzeyamoch waan swa'i.
Tato tz'ab'chaji to ay junok winh israel tz'elk'anb'at junok yetchonhab' yik tz'och schekab'ok, ma yik schonhaneli, yowalil scham jun winh elk'um anima chi', tz'el jun chukal chi' t'a he kal.
Tato ay mach b'aj spitzwichaanh jun yab'il skuchan lepra, yowalil sk'anab'ajej sleyal jun yab'il chi', icha tz'aj yalan heb' sakerdote, haton juntzanh ix walkan t'ayex.
Naekkoti tas sk'ulejnak ix María t'a yol b'e yuj Jehová ko Diosal, ayik kelnakkot t'a Egipto.
Tato ay k'een tumin tzeyak' smajnej junok eyetanimail, manh ex och t'a yol spat tzeyik'anelta junok tas yik skan smajananub'alok k'een.
Palta to tzex kan t'a sti' spat, tze tanhwan yik'kanelta tas ol yak' smajananub'alok k'een chi' t'ayex.
Tato te meb'a' jun anima b'aj ix eyak' k'een tumin chi' majanil, tato a sk'apak aykan smajananub'alok k'een, manh eyamkan wanaj t'ay yik tzek' ak'wal.

Ayik sq'uik'b'i tzeyak'an meltzajok, q'uinalok malaj tas sk'uej tzek' ak'wal. Tato icha chi' tzeyutej, a jun anima chi' ol yal wach' lolonel t'a eyib'anh, wach' pax tzex kan t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal.
Manh eyixtej heb' meb'a' smunlaj t'ayex, heb' eyetchonhab', ma heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal. Tze tup heb' t'a jun k'u chi'.
Tze tup heb' he majan t'a junjun yemk'ualil, yujto yowalil sman heb' tas swa t'a jun k'u chi'. Tato maay, syal sb'a heb' t'a Jehová, haxo yoch he mul t'a Jehová chi'.
Max yal-laj scham heb' mamab'il nunab'il yuj smul yuninal. Hanheja' heb' uninab'il chi', max yalpaxlaj scham heb' yuj smul smam snun chi'.
Manh he k'ulej tas manh tojolok t'a heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal, ma t'a heb' manhxa smam. Manh he k'anek' sk'apak heb' ix ix chamnakxo yetb'eyum yuj smajananub'alok junok tas smajnej.
Mokab' b'at satk'olal eyuuj to ek'nak onh chekab'ok t'a Egipto, haxo Jehová ko Diosal onh ik'anelta ta'. Yuj chi' swal t'ayex to tze k'anab'ajej masanil juntzanh cheknab'il tik.

Tato ayik wan he jochan ixim he trigo, sat he k'ool skan junok manoja ixim t'a he patik, manhxo ex meltzaj eyik'kot ixim. Kanokab' ixim ta', yik a heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal yet' heb' manhxa smam, ma heb' ix ix chamnak yetb'eyum, a heb' ol ek' sik'an ixim, yik wach' ol yak' swach'k'olal Jehová ko Diosal t'a eyib'anh yet' masanil tas tze k'ulej.

Ayik tze b'ixan sat te' eyoliwo yet' te eyuwa, manh pilanok tzeyutej he molanel sat te' t'a sk'ab'. Ha te' skan chi', manhxo ex meltzaj he molel te'. Yikxo heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, heb' manhxa smam yet' heb' ix chamnak yetb'eyum yaji.
Mokab' b'at satk'olal eyuuj to a ex tik ek'nak ex chekab'ok t'a Egipto. Yuj chi' swal t'ayex to tze k'anab'ajej masanil juntzanh cheknab'il swalkan tik t'ayex.
Tato ay chawanhok anima syak' owal, yowalil sb'at heb' t'a yichanh heb' yajal, yik sb'o yaj yowal heb' chi'.
Tato a winh ay smul chi' smoj smak'ji, syalan winh juez to tzek' jichan winh t'a sat lu'um t'a yichanh. Smak'ji winh ay smul chi' icha jantak smul chi'.
Ayik smak'ji winh chi', max yal-laj yek' t'a yib'anh 40 tz'uum tz'och t'a winh. Tato tzek' t'a yib'anh, manhxalaj yelk'och winh t'a yol sat anima syab'i.
Manh eyak'och spail sti' nok' nok' stek'wi trigo.

Tato ay chawanhok heb' winh winak yuk'tak sb'a, junnhej patil b'aj ay heb' winh, haxo tz'aji scham junok winh, mantalaj yuninal winh yet' ix yetb'eyum. Ha ix yetb'eyum winh chi', max yal-laj yik'an junokxo ch'ok winakil ix. Palta a winh yuk'tak winh yetb'eyum ix ix cham chi', a winh tz'ik'anxikan ix. Icha chi' tz'aj sk'anab'ajan sleyal winh yuj ix smu' chi'.
Ha sb'ab'el unin heb' sjawi, a sb'i winh yetb'eyum ix chamnak chi' tz'och t'ay, yik wach' max satel sb'i winh t'a skal ko chonhab'.

Palta tato malaj snib'ej winh syik' ix smu' chi' jun, syal sb'at ix t'a yichanh heb' juez yet' t'a yichanh heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab', syalan ix icha tik: Ha winh in mu' malaj snib'ej winh sb'inajkan winh yuk'tak t'a skal ko chonhab'. Max stak'laj winh wik'an in b'a yet'ok icha t'a sleyal, tato xchi ix.
Slajwi chi' tz'awtaj winh yuj heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' chi', sk'anb'an heb' winh t'a winh. Tato max yal sk'ol winh syik' ix smu' chi',

sk'och ix t'a stz'ey winh t'a yichanh heb' winh yichamtak winakil chonhab' chi', syik'anel junok xanhab' winh ix, stzub'anpax och ix t'a sat winh, syalan ix: Icha tik tz'utaj heb' winh malaj snib'ej syak'kan b'inaj yuk'tak, xcham ix.
Yuj chi', a tz'aj sb'inaj yinhtilal winh smu' ix chi' t'a skal ko chonhab', “yinhtil winh ik'b'ilel xanhab'”, xcham heb' anima.

Tato ay chawanhok heb' winh winak wan yak'an owal, sjawi ix yetb'eyum junok winh yik skolan winh yetb'eyum ix chi' snaani, tato a swinakil winh wan smak'lan sb'a yet' winh yetb'eyum ix chi' syamchaj yuj ix, stok'ankot winh ix,
tato icha chi', manhxalaj niwank'olal, xikjiel sk'ab' ix.
Manh he k'an echlab' manh tz'akanok ayik tzex chonhwaji, ma ayik tzex manwaji,
palta to a wal echlab' tz'akan, yik wach' ol najatb'ok he k 'inal t'a lum lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayex,
yujto malaj snib'ej ko Diosal chi' t'a heb' max b'eyb'alan tojolal.
Naekkoti, tas onh yutej heb' kajan t'a chonhab' Amalec ayik ayonhek' t'a yoltak b'e ayik toxo onh elta t'a Egipto.
Tze naanpaxkoti to malaj jab'ok xiwk'olal heb' t'a Dios. Ha heb' ketisraelal najat tzak'anto skot kuuj yuj k'unb'elal, ix laj miljikancham heb' yuj heb' aj Amalec chi'.

Yuj chi' ayik ol ex koljokel yuj Jehová ko Diosal t'a heb' ajk'ol oyanoch t'a spatiktak lum lum ol ak'jok eyikej chi', yowalil tze satel heb' yinhtil Amalec chi', manhxo ol b'inaj heb' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik t'a junelnhej. Mokab' b'at satk'olal jun cheknab'il tik eyuuj.
Ayik kajan exxo ek' t'a sat lum lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayex,
ayik tze molan b'ab'el sat eyawb'en t'a lu'um, tzeyik'anb'at t'a yol junok mooch t'a jun lugar sik'b'ilel yuj Jehová yik tz'och skajnub'ok.

Hata' tzex k'och t'a yichanh heb' winh ayoch sakerdoteal t'a jun pekti' chi', tzeyalan icha tik: Ha tiknaik, skal t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal to kajan onhxo t'a sat lum lum yak'nak sti' yak'an t'a heb' ko mam kicham, xe chi.
Haxo junok winh sakerdote schaanek' jun mooch tzeyik'b'at chi', syak'anoch winh t'a yichanh altar.

Slajwi chi' tzeyalan t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal icha tik: Ha heb' ko mam kicham, arameo heb', jaywannhej sb'ey heb' yek'nak heb'. Ha yek'nak heb' chi', tonhej sb'eyek' heb' t'a sat lu'um yet' nok' snok'. Ijan chamnak heb' yuj wejel, yuj chi' b'atnak heb' t'a Egipto yet' jaywanh yuninal. Hata' ochnak heb' chonhab'il, manhxo jantakok ajnak sb'isul heb', te ay smay heb'.
Palta te ilb'ajk'ol utajnak heb' yuj heb' aj Egipto chi'. Yilnak wal syaelal heb' ayik yak'jinakoch heb' t'a munlajel te ya.

Yuj chi', yalnak sb'a heb' t'a Jehová ko Diosal, haton sDiosal heb' ko mam kicham to skolwaj yet' heb'. Yab'nak Jehová chi' tas yalnak heb', yilannakpax munlajel te ya b'aj ayoch heb' chi'. Ilb'ajk'ol utajnak heb' b'aj ayoch chekab'wumal.
Sch'oxannak spoder Dios to ayxo smay yilji, ayik yik'annak elta heb' t'a Egipto chi'. Satub'tak yilji tas sch'oxnak, laj xiwnak heb' aj Egipto chi' yuj.
Onh yik'ankot t'a sat jun lum lum te yax sat tik.

Yuj chi' jun, tik skik'kot b'ab'el sat kawb'en t'a sat lum lum ix yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayonh, xe chi. Slajwi eyalan juntzanh lolonel chi', tzeyak'anoch te' mooch chi' t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal, tzex em kuman t'a yichanh.
Slajwi chi' tzex tzalaj wal yet' eyal eyuninal yuj masanil tas ix yak' Jehová chi' t'ayex. Tzeyawtan kot heb' lewita yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal.

Ha t'a junjun yoxil ab'il, tzeyak'an sdiezmoal masanil tas tzeyik' t'a tastak tzeyawej. Tzeyak'an t'a heb' lewita, t'a heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal yet' t'a heb' meb'a' unin yet' heb' ix ix chamnak yetb'eyum, yik wach' ay tas swa heb' t'a he kal.

Junjunex tzeyal t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal icha tik: Toxo ix wik'kanel t'a in pat masanil tas to ik yaji, haton t'a tas ix wik' t'a in munlajel t'a sat lum lum tik. Toxo ix wik'paxel yik heb' lewita yet' yik heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a ko kal, heb' meb'a' unin yet' heb' ix ix chamnak yetb'eyum. Toxo ix in k'anab'ajej masanil tas ix ala', malaj junok a cheknab'il tik sb'at satk'olal wuuj. Malaj junok to max in k'anab'ajej.

Malaj wal jab'ok juntzanh chi' ix in wa t'a sk'ual ayik ayin och t'a kusk'olal yuj chamel yet' t'a sk'ual manh wach'ok waj icha yalan ley. Maj waltejoch t'a heb' chamnak. Ix in k'anab'ajej masanil tas ix ala'.

Ilonhemta t'a satcha'anh, t'a lugar to ik yaji, ak' a wach'k'olal t'a kib'anh a onh a chonhab' Israel onh tik yet' t'a sat lum lum te yax sat ix ak' t'ayonh b'aj kajan onh tik, icha ajnak ak'an a ti' t'a heb' ko mam kicham, xe chi.
Ha Jehová ko Diosal ix halan masanil juntzanh cheknab'il yik tze k'anab'ajej yet' he b'eyb'alani. Tze k'anab'ajej t'a smasanil he k'ool yet' t'a smasanil he pensar.
Toxo ix eyal tiknaik to a Jehová he Diosal yaji. Ix eyak'an he ti' he k'anab'ajani, he b'eyb'alan scheknab'il, sk'ayb'ub'al yet' skachnab'il.
Haxo pax Jehová tz'alani to a onh israel onh tik, schonhab'onhxo icha ajnak yalankani, yuj chi' yowalil sko k'anab'ajej scheknab'il.

Ha Jehová chi' ol ex ak'anoch t'a niwak chonhab'il, ol ex b'inaj t'a wach'il, niwan ol aj eyelk'och t'a yichanh juntzanhxo nakión sb'onak. Schonhab' ex paxi, sik'b'ilexpaxel yuj, icha ix aj yalani, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ha winhaj Moisés yet' heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' ix halan juntzanh cheknab'il tik t'a masanil heb' chonhab': Ha tiknaik, ol he k'anab'ajej masanil tas skalkan tik t'ayex.

Ayik ol ex k'axpajek' t'a ha' Jordán yik ol ex och t'a sat lum lum te yax sat ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayex, icha ajnak yak'an sti' t'a heb' ko mam kicham, tze b'okank'e juntzanh k'een niwak k'een t'a yich lum witz Ebal, tzeyak'anoch k'een taanh t'a k'een. Tze tz'ib'ankanoch masanil juntzanh k'ayb'ub'al swalkan tik t'ayex t'a k'een. Tze k'ulej jun tik ayik ayexxoek' ta'.

Tze b'oanpaxk'e junok altar t'a Jehová ko Diosal. Ha k'een k'een tzeyak'och chi' t'ay, manh he mak'poj k'een, manh he tzeypax tojolb'ok k'een. Ha t'a yib'anh jun altar chi' tze nhustz'a silab' t'a Jehová ko Diosal.
Tzeyak'anpax silab' sch'oxan he junk'olal yet' ko Diosal chi'. Hata' tzex wa t'a tzalajk'olal t'a yichanh Jehová chi'.

B'at ta satk'olal eyuj he tz'ib'ankanoch masanil juntzanh cheknab'il swalkan tik t'ayex t'a juntzanh k'een b'aj ol eyak'och k'een taanh chi'. Te wach' tzeyutej he tz'ib'ankanochi yik chekel, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.

Ha winhaj Moisés, ajun heb' sakerdote yinhtilal Leví yet'nak winh, ix yalanxi winh t'a heb' chonhab' chi' icha tik: Ex wetisraelal, numan tzex aji, ab'ek wal tas ol wala': Ha tiknaik toxo onh och wal schonhab'ok Jehová ko Diosal.
Yuj chi' yowalil tze k'anab'ajej juntzanh cheknab'il yet' juntzanh sk'ayb'ub'al Jehová swalkanel tik t'ayex, xchi winh.
Hanhejtona' t'a jun k'u chi' ix yalpax jun cheknab'il tik winhaj Moisés t'a heb' yetchonhab' chi':
Ayik toxo ex k'axpajek' t'a ha' Jordán, a heb' yinhtilalkan Simeón, Leví, Judá, Isacar, José yet' Benjamín, tz'aj heb' t'a yich witz Gerizim, yik syal wach' lolonel heb' t'a yib'anh heb' chonhab'.
Haxo pax heb' yinhtilalkan Rubén, Gad, Aser, Zabulón, Dan yet' Neftalí, tz'aj heb' t'a yich lum witz Ebal yik syalan katab' lolonel heb' t'a yib'anh heb' chonhab'.
Haxo heb' yinhtilal Leví, te chaanh syal juntzanh lolonel tik heb' t'a heb' yetisraelal icha tik:

katab'il mach sb'oan junok yechel komon Dios t'a te te', ma t'a k'een k'een, syak'anoch t'a junok lugar k'ub'eltak yik tz'och ejmelal t'ay. Ha juntzanh chi' yajb'ilel yuj Jehová, xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
katab'il mach malaj yelk'och smam snun t'a yol sat, xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
katab'il mach sk'exan stz'akanhil sluum yik stok'ek' sluum junokxo mach, xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
katab'il mach tz'ak'an musansatil junok anima max ujilaj yilani, haxo t'a ch'ok b'eal schekkanb'ati, xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.

katab'il mach sk'ulan tas manh tojolok t'a heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, t'a heb' unin manhxa smam, ma t'a heb' ix ix chamnak yetb'eyum, xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
katab'il mach smulan yet' ix yetb'eyum smam, yujto a mach sk'ulan icha chi', syak' q'uixwelal smam chi', xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
katab'il mach smulan yet' nok' nok', xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
katab'il mach smulan yet' schab'il yanab', yanab' yuj smam ma yuj snun, xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
katab'il mach smulan yet' ix snhi', xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
katab'il mach smak'ancham junok yetanimail t'a elk'altak, xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
katab'il mach schaan tumin yik smak'ancham junok anima malaj smul, xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
katab'il mach max k'anab'ajan masanil scheknab'il Dios, xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
Tato yel tze k'anab'ajej masanil scheknab'il Jehová ko Diosal swalkan tik t'ayex, te niwan ol aj eyelk'och yuj Jehová chi' t'a yichanh juntzanhxo nakión t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Hanhejtona' tato tze k'anab'ajej Jehová ko Diosal, ol he chapax masanil juntzanh yaxilal ol wal tik:
Ol yak' swach'k'olal t'a eyib'anh t'a yol he chonhab' yet' t'a he munlajel.
Ol yak' swach'k'olal t'a yib'anh heb' eyuninal, t'a yib'anh tas tzeyawej, t'a yib'anh yune' nok' he wakax, yune' nok' he kalnel yet' t'a yib'anh juntzanhxo yune' nok' he molb'etzal nok'.
Ol yak' swach'k'olal t'a yib'anh tas ol eyak'em t'a yol he mooch yet' t'a yib'anh tas tze wa''a.
Ol yak'an swach'k'olal t'a eyib'anh b'ajtak tzex eq'ui yet' yik tzex meltzajxi t'a he pat.
Ha Jehová ol ak'anoch heb' eyajk'ol t'a yol he k'ab' ayik ol yak'an owal heb' heyet'ok. T'a stzolal ol aj skot heb' t'ayex, palta sakleminak ol aj yel heb' elelal t'ayex.

Ol yak' swach'k'olal Jehová ko Diosal t'a yib'anh tastak tzeyik' t'a he munlajel yet' t'a yib'anh masanil tas tze k'ulej. Icha wal chi' te tzalajk'olal ol ex ajek' t'a sat lum lum ol yak' Jehová chi' t'ayex.
Tato tze k'anab'ajej masanil scheknab'il Jehová chi', tze b'eyb'alani, ol ex yalnhejoch schonhab'ok to sik'b'ilex el yuj, icha ajnak yalani.
Haxo heb' anima t'a masanil nakión t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ol yojtakejel heb' to sik'b'il ex el yuj Jehová, ol xiw heb' t'ayex.
Ha Jehová chi' ol ex xajananok: Tzijtum ol aj eyuninal yet' yune' nok' he molb'etzal nok', jantak ol aj sat eyawb'en t'a lum lum yak'nak sti' t'a heb' ko mam kicham to ol yak' t'ayex.

Ol yak'ankot nhab' t'a yib'anh lum lum tik t'a stiempoal, icha jantak tz'och yopisio. Te wach'xonhej ol aj he munlajel. Masanil tastak ay t'ayex, ol te q'uib'chaanh, masanto ol yal eyak'an majanil t'a tzijtumok nakión. Ha exxo pax tik, malaj tas ol he k'an he majnej t'a junokxo mach.

Tato ol he k'anab'ajej masanil scheknab'il Jehová ko Diosal, haton masanil juntzanh swalkan t'ayex tiknaik, sat ol ex aj t'a heb' ch'ok nakional chi', haxo heb' spatiktak ol ajkan heb'. Niwan ol aj eyelk'och t'a yib'anh heb'. Malaj b'aj ol ex ak'jok ganar yuj heb'.
Icha chi' ol ex ajok, tato max eyik'el he b'a t'a spatik scheknab'il Jehová, tato max ex och tzak'an t'a spatik komon Dios, yik tzeyak'anem he b'a t'ay.
Palta tato manh ol he k'anab'ajej masanil scheknab'il yet' sk'ayb'ub'al Jehová ko Diosal, haton juntzanh wan walan tik t'ayex, ol ja wal juntzanh katab' tik t'a eyib'anh:
Te chuk eyik t'a yol he chonhab' yet' t'a he munlajel.
Syalelk'ochi to malaj tas ol eyik' t'a he munlajel chi', malaj pax tas ol he wa''a.
Ol jawok yaelal t'a yib'anh heb' eyuninal, malaj swach'il ol aj sat eyawb'en. Manh ol q'uib' yune' nok' he wakax, yune' nok' he kalnel, yune' nok' he chiwa yet' masanil nok' he molb'etzal nok'.
Chuk eyik b'ajtaknhej tzex eq'ui yet' yik tzex meltzajxi t'a he pat.
Ol yak'kot yaelal Jehová yet' ilk'olal t'a eyib'anh. Toxonhej ol ex somchajel t'a masanil tastak ol he k'ulej. Elanhchamel ol ex satel yuj chukal tze k'ulej yuj eyaktankan Jehová chi'.
Ha Jehová ol ak'ankot juntzanh ilya te ow t'a eyib'anh, masanto ol ex satel t'a sat lum lum b'aj ol ex kajnaj chi'.

Ol yak'paxkot yab'il yab'il Jehová chi' to ol ex cham yuj, k'ak'al ilya te chuk yet' he malk'ei. Haxo eyawb'en ol takjokelok. Manhxo ol yak'laj nhab', takinh ol aj smasanil. Ol och tz'aub' t'a he munlajel masanto ol yal he sateli.
Manhxalaj nhab' ol kot t'a satcha'anh. Manhxo ol yak'laj sat eyawb'en t'a lum lum chi'.
Manhxalaj nhab' ol yak'a'. Haxonhej lum pokok yet' k'een arena ol em yuj Jehová ko Diosal, masanto ol ex satelok.

Ha Jehová chi' ol ex ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' eyajk'ool. T'a stzolal ol aj he b'at t'a owal, haxo ol ajok, sakleminak ol aj eyel t'a heb'. Ol sat sk'ool masanil nakión t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik ayik ol yab'an heb' tas ol ex ik'anok.
Ha nok' ostok yet' nok' kaltakte'al nok' ol chianb'at he niwanil. Manhxalaj mach ol xib'tan nok' t'ayex.
Ha Jehová ol ak'an k'ab'at he niwanil yuj mal yab'il, icha wal ajnak heb' aj Egipto. Ol k'epax kisk'oy t'ayex yet' yaxk'a yet' q'uilaj yab'il, manhxalaj yanhal juntzanh ilya chi'.
Ol ex kistalaxok, ol somchajel he k'ool, manhxo ol yal-laj eyilani.

Toxonhej ol ex ek' machmon t'a chimk'ualil, icha tz'aj yek' machmon heb' max ujitaxon yilani. Haxo t'a masanil tas ol he k'ulej, manhxalaj tas ol elk'och t'a wach'il. Ol ex te ixtaxelok. Ilb'ajk'olxonhej ol ex ajok. Manhxalaj mach ol ex kolanok.
Ha mach ol sb'o strato snupnaj yet' junok ix ix, ch'okxo mach ol way yet' ix. Ol he b'ok'e junok he pat, palta manhxo ol ex kajnaj t'a yool. Ol eyawej junok eyuwa, palta manhxo ol he lo sat.

T'a wal eyichanh ol smilcham nok' he wakax heb' ajk'ool, palta manh ol he chi' jab'ok schib'ejal nok'. T'a eyichanh ol yik'b'at nok' he b'uru heb', manhxo ol yak' meltzaj nok' heb' t'ayex. Ol yik'b'at nok' he kalnel heb', manhxalaj mach ol yal skolankan nok' t'a heb'.
Eyichanh wal ol b'atkan heb' eyuninal yet' heb' ix eyisil t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il. Toxonhej ol ex k'unb'ok he maklan sjax heb', palta manhxa jab'ok tas syal eyuuj.
Ha heb' anima manh eyojtakok, a heb' ol satanel masanil sat eyawb'en yet' jantak he munlajel. Ol ex ixtaj wal, ob'iltakxonhej ol ex ajok.
Ayik ol eyilan masanil juntzanh chi', toxonhej ol ex kistalaxkanok.
Ol yak' wal kot yaelal Jehová t'a eyib'anh, ol k'e yab'il yaxk'a t'a sjolom he penek, t'a he xub' yet' t'a masanil he niwanil. Manhxo ol anhtaj jun ilya chi' eyuuj.

Ol ex ik'jokb'at yuj Jehová chi' yet' he reyal sik'b'iloch eyuuj t'a junok nakión to manh eyojtakok, manh yojtakokpax heb' he mam eyicham. Hata' ol eyak'em he b'a t'a juntzanh komon Dios b'ob'il t'a te te', ma t'a k'een k'een.
Ol sat sk'ol juntzanhxo nakión yab'an tas ol ex utajok. Ol aljok he pekal, ol ex b'uchjok yuj juntzanh chonhab' b'aj ol ex yik'b'at Jehová chi'.
Te niwan inhat ol eyawej, palta jab'nhej sat ol he molo', anhej nok' k'ulub' ol k'uxanb'atok.
Ol eyawej eyuwa, ol he mesani, palta manh ol he b'ixlaj sat, malaj wino ol eyuk'ej, anhej nok' yaxtaj ol lajanelok.
Ay te' oliwo t'a sat he lu'um, palta malaj yakeiteal te' ol he k'ana' yujto tonhej ol k'ajb'anel sat te'.
Ay eyuninal, ay eyisil, palta manh ol ajlaj heb' heyet'ok, yujto ol ik'jokb'at heb' t'a juntzanhxo nakión.
Masanil te te' syak' sat t'a he chonhab', pilan ol lajwokel te' yuj nok' k'ulub'.
Ha heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan t'a he kal, niwanxo ol aj yelk'och heb' t'a eyichanh, a exxo tik, manhxalaj ol aj eyelk'ochi yujto ol ex lajwokemok.
Ha heb' chi', ay tas ol yal yak'an heb' majanil, palta a exxo tik, manhxalaj tas t'ayex. Ha heb' sat ol aj t'ayex, a exxo tik spatiktakil ol ex ajkanok.
Masanil juntzanh yaelal tik ol ja t'a eyib'anh. Ol eyab'xonhej syail masanto ol yal he sateli, yujto maj he k'anab'ajej masanil scheknab'il yet' sk'ayb'ub'al Jehová ko Diosal ix yak' t'ayex.
Ha juntzanh yaelal tik sch'oxkot yowal sk'ol Dios t'ayex yet' t'a heb' eyinhtilal t'a masanil tiempo.
Yujto maj eyak'em he b'a t'a Jehová ko Diosal t'a tzalajk'olal yet' t'a smasanil he k'ool ayik ix yak'an swach'k'olal t'a eyib'anh,

yuj chi' yowalil ol eyak' serwil heb' ajk'ool ol yak'kot t'ayex, ol eyab' syail wejel, takinhtial, manh pichulal yet' masanil yaelal. Ol eyab' wal syail yuj heb' eyajk'ool chi' masanto ol yal he sateli.

Ha heb' anima t'a junok nakión te najat b'aj slajwik'och yol yib'anhk'inal tik, a heb' ol yik'kot Jehová t'ayex, yelk'olal ol aj skot heb' icha sjenhwi nok' ch'akb'a. Ch'ok ti'al syal heb', manh ol eyab'laj tas ol yal heb'.
Te owal anima heb'. Malaj yelk'och heb' icham anima yet' heb' unin t'a heb'.

Ol schib'at yune' nok' he molb'etzal nok' heb', ol sloanb'at sat eyawb'en te' heb', masanto ol ex ixtajwal. Manhxalaj he trigo, he wino, eyakeite, ma yune' nok' he wakax yet' yune' nok' he kalnel ol to kan yuj heb', anhej to ol ex cham yuj wejel.

Ol och hoyan heb' ajk'ol chi' t'a spatiktak he chonhab'. Ol jawok heb' t'ayex masanto ol yal yem lanhnaj smuroal he chonhab' chaanh yajk'ei yet' b'aj skol sb'a heb' soldado ayoch yipok he k'ool. Masanil juntzanh chonhab' ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayex, ol laj yoymitej heb'.

Ayik ol laj oymaj heb' ajk'ol chi' t'a he chonhab' chi', haxo yuj wejel ol he chianb'at eyuninal yet' eyisil ix yak' Jehová ko Diosal. Wach'chom ay junok winak t'a he kal te wach' syutej sb'a, palta yuj wejel chi' ol schib'at yuninal. Manh ol yak' jab'ok t'a yuk'tak, t'a ix yetb'eyum to xajan yuj yet' t'a juntzanhxo yuninal olto kanok.

Wach'chom ay junok ix ix manh komonok syutej sb'a t'a he kal, te b'eyum ix, malaj b'aj tz'em yok ix t'a sat lu'um, aynhejoch xanhab' ix, palta yujto manhxa tas swa ix yuj b'aj oyanoch heb' ajk'ol t'a spatiktak he chonhab' chi', ol schib'at yune' ix toto tz'alji yet' smoj yune' chi'. Manh ol yak' jab'ok ix t'a winh yetb'eyum, ma t'a juntzanhxo yune'.
Ha Jehová ko Diosal te wach', te ay smay, palta tato malaj yelk'och t'ayex, manh ol he b'eyb'alejpax masanil juntzanh cheknab'il tz'ib'ab'ilkan tik,
ol yak' wal kot niwak yaelal ko Diosal chi' t'a eyib'anh yet' t'a yib'anh eyinhtilal. Ha wal ilya te chuk ol yak' t'a eyib'anh to manhxalaj yanhal.
Ol kot wal juntzanh ilya t'a eyib'anh, icha wal juntzanh ilya ik'annak heb' aj Egipto, haton juntzanh b'aj te xiwnak ex. Manhxo ol el-laj juntzanh yaelal chi' t'a eyib'anh.
Ayto juntzanhxo yaelal max b'inajlaj t'a juntzanh slolonel Dios tik ol jawok t'a eyib'anh yik tzex sateli.
Ha ex wal tik ex wetisraelal, te niwanxo he b'isul, lajan exxo icha k'een k'anal t'a satcha'anh, palta ol ex satelok. Manhxo niwanok ol ajkan he b'isul, tato manh ol he k'anab'ajej Jehová ko Diosal.

Icha ix aj stzalaj sk'ol sch'oxan swach'k'olal t'ayonh, ix yak'an q'uib' ko b'isul, icha pax chi' ol aj stzalaj sk'ol yuj he sateli. Elanhchamel ol aj ex yik'anxiel t'a lum lum b'aj toxo ol ex kajnaj tik.

Ha ex olto ex kanok, a Jehová ol ex saklemankanb'at b'ajtak slajwik'och yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Hata' ol ex och ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios b'ob'il t'a te te', ma t'a k'een k'een, haton komon Dios b'aj max eyak'em he b'a, manh yak'nakokpaxem sb'a heb' ko mam kicham t'ay.

Ayik ayex ek' t'a juntzanh nakión chi', manh ol eyik' jab'ok eyip, malaj jab'ok tas b'aj ay eyalan eyiko'. Yujto t'a xiwk'olal ol ex ajek' yuj Jehová ta', kuseltakxonhej ol aj yilji he sat yuj ilk'olal.
Xiwk'olal ol ex ajek' t'a masanil tiempo yuj he chamel. Ol ex te xiw t'a k'ualil yet' t'ak'walil.
Ol ex te xiw wal sik'lab'il yuj juntzanh te ay smay ol eyila'. Ha t'a q'uinhib'alil ol eyala': Tzok wal k'ik'b'i, xe chama. Haxo t'ak'walil ol eyalanxi: Tzok sakb'i, xe chama.

Wach'chom ix yal Jehová to manhxa b'ak'uinh tzex meltzaj t'a Egipto, palta a ol ex ak'anxib'at ta' t'a yol barko. Hata' ol he chonhoch he b'a schekab'ok heb' eyajk'ol chi', palta manhxalaj mach ol ex mananok, xchi winhaj Moisés chi' t'a heb'.

Ha juntzanh lolonel yik trato ix schek Jehová yal winhaj Moisés t'a heb' yetisraelal ayik ayek' heb' t'a yol smakb'en Moab. Stz'akub' sb'a juntzanh tik yet' trato ix sb'o Jehová yet' heb' t'a lum witz Horeb.

Ix smolb'ej masanil heb' yetchonhab' winhaj Moisés, ix yalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: Ha ex tik, eyilnak wal tas utajnak winh sreyal Egipto yet' heb' ayoch yajalil yet' winh yet' masanil smakb'en Egipto chi' yuj Jehová.
Testigo eyaj t'a juntzanh yaelal yet' tas satub'tak yilji sk'ulejnak Jehová chi'.
Palta masanto tiknaik maxto yak'laj eyojtakejeli tas syalelk'och juntzanh chi'.
40 ab'il ix ex in kuchb'ej t'a takinh lu'um. Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', maj lajwokel-laj he pichul, maj lajwokel-laj he xanhab'.
Maj he walaj ixim pan, maj eyuk'laj wino, ma yal sat te' awb'en te' pajb'inak, yik wach' snachajel eyuuj to a Jehová haton ko Diosal.
Ayik ix onh jawi t'a jun lugar tik, ix elta winhaj Sehón sreyal Hesbón yak' owal ket'ok yet' winhaj Og sreyal Basán, palta ix kak' ganar heb'.
Ix kik'ankan sluum heb', ix kak'an t'a heb' yinhtilal Rubén, t'a heb' yinhtilal Gad yet' t'a nanhalxo heb' yinhtilal Manasés.
Yuj chi', k'anab'ajejek he b'eyb'alan jun trato tik, yik wach'nhej ol aj eyelk'och t'a masanil tastak ol he k'ulej.
Ha tiknaik, tik wal molan onh ek' t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal. Masanil heb' yajal t'a eyinhtilal, heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab', heb' ay yopisio yet' masanil heb' ketisraelal:
Eb' winh winak, heb' unin, heb' ix ix yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan t'a ko kal, haton heb' k'atzitzwum yet' heb' kuchum ha',
molan onh eq'ui yik wach' sko chakan strato Jehová ko Diosal b'aj syak'kan sti' t'ayonh.

Ha wal tiknaik scheklajkaneli to tzonh ochkan schonhab'ok Jehová ko Diosal, haxo tz'ochkan ko Diosalok, icha yutejnak yak'an sti' t'a winhaj Abraham, t'a winhaj Isaac yet' t'a winhaj Jacob, haton heb' ko mam kicham.
Manhoknhej ket' a onh molan onh ek' tik sb'o jun trato tik Jehová chi',
palta yet' pax heb' kinhtilal toto ol aljok.
Ha ex tik eyojtak wal sik'lab'il tas wal aj kek'nak t'a Egipto yet' tas ajnak ko k'axpajek'ta t'a yol smakb'en juntzanh nakión t'a yoltak b'e.
Hata' kilnak juntzanh komon Dios, juntzanh yechel nab'a te', nab'a k'een, nab'a plata yet' nab'a oro, te chuklaj sk'ulej juntzanh anima chi', ayik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'ay.

Komonok malaj junok anima t'a ko kal tik, winak, ma ix, ma junok yinhtilal heb' ketchonhab' tz'aktankan Jehová ko Diosal, haxo t'a sdiosal juntzanh nakión chi' tz'och ejmelal. Tato icha chi' sk'ulej, lajan icha junok yib' te' swolani, a swol chi' te k'a', scham anima yuj.

Tato ay junok mach t'a ko kal tik te nhikan syutej sb'a snaani, slajwi yab'an tas tz'ajkan jun trato tik, syalan icha tik: Wach'chom tzin pitej in b'a tzin k'ulan masanil tas snib'ej in k'ool, palta malaj tas ol in ik'anok, tato xchi, ol kot yaelal t'a kib'anh ko masanil wach'chom wach' onh, ma chuk onh.

Yuj chi' manhxo ol ak'joklaj niwank'olal jun anima chi' yuj Jehová, a yowal sk'ol ol jawok t'a yib'anh jun anima chi'. Ha masanil juntzanh yaelal tz'ib'ab'ilkan tik, ha' ol kot t'a yib'anh, ol satjokpaxel yinhtilal t'a sat lum lum tik yuj Jehová.

Ha Jehová chi' ol ik'anel jun anima chi' t'a skal masanil yinhtilal heb' ketisraelal, ol yak'anoch yaelal t'a yib'anh, yuj chi' masanil yaelal sb'inaj t'a trato b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan masanil ley, ol kot t'a yib'anh jun anima chi'.
Ha heb' eyinhtilal t'a b'ak'uinh yet' juntzanhxo anima ch'ok chonhab'il ol kot t'a najat, ol yil wal yaelal heb' yet' ilya ol yak'kot Jehová t'a yib'anh lum lum tik.

Ol yil heb' to a lum lum chi' tz'anak lu'um smasanil, anhej k'een azufre yet' atz'am atz'am ay t'a lu'um. Manhxalaj tas ol yal yawchaj t'a lu'um. Manhxalaj tas ol q'uib' t'a lu'um, wach'chom anh ank'ultak manhxo ol q'uib'laj anh. Icha wal ajnak satel juntzanh chonhab' yuj yowal sk'ol Jehová, haton Sodoma, Gomorra, Adma yet' Zeboim, icha wal chi' ol aj lum he lu'um tik.
Yuj chi', masanil anima t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik ol sk'anb'ej heb': ¿Tas yuj icha chi' ix yutej jun chonhab' chi' Jehová? ¿Tas yuj ix te kot wal yowal sk'ol t'a heb'? xcham heb' anima chi'.

Haxo ol laj spakan juntzanhxo heb': Icha chi' ix aj jun chonhab' chi', yujto ix yaktejkan strato Jehová heb', haton trato sb'onak Jehová chi' yet' heb' smam yicham heb', ayik yik'jinakelta heb' t'a Egipto.
Ix och heb' ejmelal t'a komon Dios b'aj max yak'taxonem sb'a heb', manhok Jehová ix halan t'a heb' to tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a juntzanh chi'.
Yuj chi' ix kot yowal sk'ol Jehová chi' t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' chi', ix kot masanil juntzanh katab' tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a strato t'a yib'anh heb'.
Ix yik'el jun chonhab' chi' yet' yowal sk'ool, ix yak'ankanb'at heb' t'a skaltak juntzanhxo nakión, ichaton wan yuji tiknaik, xcham heb' ol pakan jun lolonel chi'.

Ay wal tas manh kojtakok, a juntzanh chi', yik Jehová ko Diosal yaji. Palta ay tas ak'b'il kojtakejel yet' heb' kuninal, haton masanil juntzanh k'ayb'ub'al tik yet' kachnab'il yik sko k'anab'ajej t'a masanil tiempo.

Ayik ol ujok masanil juntzanh tas ix wal tik t'ayex, haton swach'k'olal Jehová ko Diosal yet' pax skatab' yuj he patikaneli, palta tato ol sna sb'a he k'ol ayik ayexxo ek' t'a masanil nakión b'aj ol ex yak'kanb'ati,
tato yet' smasanil he k'ool yet' pax smasanil he pensar tze k'anab'ajan yet' heb' eyuninal icha wal tz'aj walankan tik t'ayex,
ol sk'ex spensar ko Diosal chi', ol yak'anxi swach'k'olal t'ayex. Ol ok'pax sk'ol t'ayex, ol ex smolb'anxikot b'aj ix ex saklemkanb'at chi'.
Wach'chom ex saklemkanb'ati, ix laj ex k'ochkan b'aj slajwik'och yol yib'anhk'inal tik, hato ta' ol ex yik'xikot Jehová ko Diosal chi'.
Ol ex smolb'anpax b'aj ek'nak kajan heb' ko mam kicham. Hata' ol ex ajxok. Ek'b'al niwan ol aj he b'eyumal yet' he b'isul yuj Jehová chi' t'a yichanh heb' ko mam kicham chi'.
Ol yak'och yechel strato Jehová t'a he pensar yet' t'a spensar heb' eyinhtilal yik ol he xajanej t'a smasanil he k'ool yet' t'a smasanil he pensar yik wach' ol ex ajok.
Haxo Jehová chi' ol ak'anb'at masanil katab' tik t'a yib'anh heb' ajk'ol ix chichonoch sk'ol t'ayex, heb' ex ixtani.
Ha exxo tik, ol ex meltzajxok t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová he k'anab'ajan masanil scheknab'il swalkan tik t'ayex.

Yuj chi', te b'eyum ol ex ajxok yuj Jehová chi', ol yak'an swach'k'olal t'a yib'anh tastak tze k'ulej, t'a yib'anh eyuninal yet' nok' he molb'etzal nok' yet' t'a he munlajel. Tato tze k'anab'ajej masanil tas syal Jehová, masanil scheknab'il yet' k'ayb'ub'al tz'ib'ab'ilkan tik, tato t'a smasanil he k'ool yet' t'a smasanil he pensar tzeyak'och he b'a t'a yol sk'ab', ol tzalaj sk'ol yak'an swach'k'olal t'ayex, icha ajnak yak'an tzalajb'ok sk'ol yet' heb' ko mam kicham.
Ha juntzanh cheknab'il swak' eyojtakejel tik, manh ajaltakok ko k'anab'ajani, manh najatok ayel t'a ko tz'ey.

Manhok t'a satchanh ay, yik wach' max eyal icha tik: ¿Mach wal syal sk'ek'och t'a satcha'anh yik sb'at yik'anemta jun cheknab'il tik, syak'an kojtakejeli, yik wach' sko b'eyb'alej? max yal eyalan icha chi'.

Hanhejtona', manhokpax t'a sk'axepal ha' mar ay, yik max eyal icha tik: ¿Mach syal sk'axpajek' t'a ha' mar chi', yik sb'at yik'ankot t'ayonh, syak'an kojtakaneli sko b'eyb'alani? max yal eyalan icha chi'.
Okxo jun, a jun cheknab'il tik ayek' t'a ko kal, skalub'tanhej, aypaxoch t'a ko pensar, yik wach' sko k'anab'ajej.
Ha tiknaik, tik wal swak' he sik'lej tas tze nib'ej: ¿Am k 'inal yet' wach'il, mato ha' katab' yet' chamel?

Tato tze k'anab'ajej masanil tas swalkan tik t'ayex, tze xajanan Jehová ko Diosal, tzex ochnhej tzak'an yuj, tze k'anab'ajan scheknab'il yet' sk'ayb'ub'al, wach' ol ex ajok, tzijtum ol aj sb'isul eyuninal. Ichato chi' ol yak'an syaxil Jehová ko Diosal t'a eyib'anh t'a sat lum lum b'aj wan eyoch tik yik tze makb'enej.
Tato max he cha eyab' juntzanh tik jun, palta to tze b'ek he b'a he montajb'at t'a spatik komon Dios, tzex em kuman t'ay,
tato icha chi', wal t'a jun rato tik swalkan t'ayex to ol ex chamok. Manhxo ol najtilax he k 'inal t'a sat lum lum ol eyikej chi' ayik ol ex k'axpajkanek' t'a ha' Jordán.

Wal t'a jun k'u tik swak'kanoch satcha'anh yet' lum lum tik testigoal to swak' he sik'lej tas tze nib'ej, am he k 'inal yet' wach'il, mato a katab' yet' chamel. Palta sik'lejek he k 'inal, yik wach'nhej tzex aj yet' heb' eyinhtilal.

Tze xajanej Jehová ko Diosal. Tze k'anab'ajej, manh eyaktejkani, yuj chi' ol he cha he k 'inal, najtil ol ex ek' t'a sat lum lum yak'nak sti' yak'an t'a heb' ko mam kicham, haton t'a winhaj Abraham, t'a winhaj Isaac yet' t'a winhaj Jacob, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Moisés t'a heb' chonhab' israel icha tik:
Ayxo 120 ab'il in k 'inal, manhxa wal wip in b'eyek' ex in kuchb'ej, hanhejtona' toxo ix yal Jehová t'ayin to manhxo ol in k'axpajek' t'a ha' Jordán tik.

Palta a Jehová ol b'ab'lajnhej t'a eyichanh, ol satanel masanil juntzanh chonhab' ayek' b'aj ol ex k'och chi'. Ha exxo ol ex kajnajkan t'a slum heb'. Haxo winhaj Josué ol ex kuchb'anok, icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'ayex.
Ha Jehová chi' ol satanel heb' anima t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', icha ix aj satanel heb' winh sreyal amorreo, haton winhaj Sehón yet' winhaj Og yet' heb' yetchonhab' heb'.
Ha ol ak'anoch juntzanh nakión chi' t'a yol he k'ab', ol he satanel heb' icha ix aj walan t'ayex.

Tek'b'ejek he b'a, manh ex xiwok ayik ol he chalan he b'a yet' heb' ajk'ol chi', yujto a Jehová ko Diosal ayoch heyet'ok. Manh he na' to ol ex aktajkan yuj, manh ol ex yak'kanlaj he ch'okoj, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yawtankot winhaj Josué chi' winh. T'a yichanh masanil heb' chonhab' israel ix yal winh t'a winh icha tik: Tza tek'b'ej wal a b'a, manh ach xiwok, yujto a ach ol ik'b'at jun chonhab' tik t'a sat lum lum yak'nak sti' Jehová yak'an t'a heb' ko mam kicham. Ha ach ol ak'kan junjun makan heb' t'a smakb'en.
Ha Jehová ol b'ab'laj uuj. Aynhejek' het'ok, manh ol ach yaktejkanlaj, yuj chi' manh ach xiwok, manh ach meltzaj t'a a patik, xchi winhaj Moisés chi' t'a winh.

Ix stz'ib'an juntzanh tik winhaj Moisés chi', ix yak'ankan winh t'a yol sk'ab' heb' sakerdote yinhtilal Leví tz'ik'anb'at skaxail strato Jehová yet' t'a masanil heb' winh yichamtak winakil chonhab' Israel.

Ix yalan winh icha tik: Ayik slajwi yuktakil ab'il, t'a yol ab'il yik slajwikan b'ok, ayik molanek' masanil anima t'a yichanh Jehová t'a jun lugar sik'b'ilel yuj t'a juntzanh sk'ual q'uinh chinama, hata' tz'awtaj ley tik yab' masanil anima.

Smolb'ej sb'a masanil anima, heb' winh winak, heb' ix ix yet' heb' kotak unin yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal. Tze molb'ej he b'a yuj eyab'ani yet' eyojtakanel masanil tas syal jun ley tik, yik wach' ay yelk'och Jehová ko Diosal t'a yol he sat, yik tze k'anab'ajan tas syala'.

Icha pax chi' heb' eyinhtilal manto ojtannakok jun ley tik, ol yab'kan heb' yik wach' ay yelk'och Jehová chi' t'a yol sat heb' t'a masanil tiempo t'a sat lum lum ol eyikej t'a sk'axepalek' ha' Jordán tik, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: Wanxo sk'och stiempoal yik ol ach chamok. Yuj chi' awtejkot winhaj Josué, tzex b'at t'a in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a yik wach' ol wak'kanoch yopisio winh, xchi t'a winh. Ix b'at winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Josué chi'.
Hata' ix sch'ox sb'a Jehová chi' t'a heb' winh t'a skal jun niwan asun ix och moyan t'a sti' kajnub' chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: Ha ach tik toxo ol ach chamok. Slajwi chi', a jun chonhab' tik ol ochkan tzak'an heb' yuj juntzanh yechel skomon diosal juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a spatik yichanh b'aj ol k'och heb'. Ol in yaktejkan heb', ol yixtanb'at in trato heb' ix in b'o yet'ok.

Yuj chi', ol kot wowal t'a heb', ol waktankan heb' sch'okoj. Manhxo ol wab' tas ol yal heb'. Manhxo jantakok yaelal ol kotkan t'a yib'anh heb', masanto ol yal heb' icha tik: ¿Tas wal yuj skab' syail? Yuj am to manhxo ayok ek' ko Diosal t'a ko kal, xcham heb'.
Ayik ol yab'an juntzanh yaelal chi' heb', ol wik'el in b'a t'a skal heb' yuj masanil chukal sk'ulej, yuj pax to tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a juntzanh yechel chi'.
Ha tiknaik jun, tz'ib'ejek jun b'it ol wal t'ayex, ol he k'ayb'an heb' eyetchonhab' Israel tik t'ay, ol sb'itan heb' yik swak'och testigoal t'a yib'anh heb'.

Ayik ol lajwok wik'anoch heb' anima tik t'a sat lum lum te yax sat chi', lum wak'nak in ti' wak'an t'a heb' he mam eyicham, ol wa heb' sik'lab'il, ol b'ak'uechb'ok heb'. Ol lajwok chi', ol b'at heb' t'a spatik juntzanh komon Dios. Ol och heb' ejmelal t'a juntzanh chi'. Ol in spatikanel heb', ol yixtanb'at in trato heb' in b'onak yet'ok.

Ayik ol jawok jantak yaelal yet' ilk'olal t'a yib'anh heb', a jun b'it tik ol ak'an testigoal t'a yib'anh heb'. Haxo heb' yinhtilal heb' ol naankot jun b'it tik, ol sb'itan heb'. Yujto ayik manto ochlaj heb' t'a lum lum wak'nak in ti' wak'an t'a heb', wojtakxo tas ayek' t'a spensar heb', xchi Jehová chi'.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi' ix stz'ib'ejkan jun b'it tik winhaj Moisés, ix yak'an winh sk'ayb'ej heb' yetisraelal.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Josué, yuninal winhaj Nun icha tik: Tza tek'b'ej wal a b'a, manh ach xiwok, yujto ayinnhej och het'ok. Ha ach ol ik' och heb' etisraelal tik t'a sat lum lum wak'nak in ti' wak'an t'ayex, xchi t'a winh.
Ixlajwi stz'ib'ankan masanil juntzanh ley chi' winhaj Moisés chi',
ix yalan winh t'a heb' yinhtil Leví et'jinak skaxail strato Jehová icha tik:
Ik'ekb'at jun tz'ib'ab'il tik, tzeyak'anoch t'a stz'ey skaxail strato Jehová ko Diosal, yik syak' testigoal t'a eyib'anh.
Yujto wojtak to te pit ex, malaj he gana sk'exwi he pensar. Ayik ayinto ek' heyet'ok, te pitnhej tzeyutej he b'a, okxom wal ol in chamok.
Awtejek heb' yichamtak winakil junjun eyinhtilal yet' heb' yajalil chonhab', yik swalankanel jun b'it tik t'a heb'. Swak'anoch satcha'anh yet' sat lu'um tik testigoal.

Wojtakxo to ayik ol in chamok ol eyixtankanb'at he b'a, ol eyaktankan jun b'e b'aj tzex wak'kanoch tik. Hanhejtona' wojtakxopaxi to ha t'a b'ak'uinh, ol jawok yaelal t'a eyib'anh, yujto ol he tzuntzejkot yowal sk'ol Jehová yuj chukal ol he k'ulej t'a yichanh, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix och ijan winhaj Moisés yalan masanil slolonelal jun b'it tik t'a yichanh heb' chonhab' icha tik:
Yab'okab' satcha'anh in loloni. Yab'okab'pax lum lum tas ol wala'.
Ha k'ayb'ub'al swal tik lajan wal icha yem nhab'. Ha lolonel swal tik lajan wal icha yal ak'wal tz'emi, hanheja' icha yem nhab' t'a yib'anh te te' yet' t'a yib'anh anh ank'ultak, icha chi' yaji.
Swalkaneli to niwan yelk'och Jehová. Ik'ekchaanh sb'i ko Diosal.
Ha Jehová b'aj sko kol ko b'a lajan icha junok k'een niwan tenam. Te wach'nhej tas sb'o'o, te tojolnhej sb'eyb'al. Tz'elnhejk'och tas syala'.
Ha ex wetchonhab' ex tik, te manh he mojok tzex och yuninalok Jehová, te malaj he wach'il, te pit ex t'ay.

¿Tom yet' he pital chi' tzeyak' spak t'a Jehová? Ha ex tik malaj he pensar, malaj jab'ok he jelanil. ¿Tom manhok Jehová ko Mam yaj jun? ¿Tom manhok onh b'oani? Ha onh b'oani, onh yak'anoch t'a chonhab'il.
Naekkot tas sk'ulejnak Jehová, tze naan t'a juntzanh tiempo ix ek'b'ati. k'anb'ejek eyab' t'a he mam he nun. Ab'ekpax tas syal heb' winh ichamtak winak.
Ayik ix pukaxkanb'at anima t'a junjun nakión yuj Jehová Haxonhej Ochi, yuj yak'ankanem stz'akanhil sluum junjun chonhab', t'a sb'ab'elal ix sna t'a jantak ko b'isul a onh israel onh tik.
Ha onh yinhtilal onh winhaj Jacob ix onh sik'kanel Jehová yik tzonh ochkan yikok.
Onh ilchajelta yuj t'a jun tzinan lu'um, b'aj te ow yek' ik'. Ix onh stanhwej wal, ix onh sya ilani, icha wal ko ya ilan snenal yol ko sat.
Icha tz'aj sjuanb'at so' nok' niwak ch'akb'a, sk'ayb'an yune' nok' yik sjenhwi, icha pax tz'aj yik'anb'at yune' nok' chi' t'a yib'anh sk'axil, icha wal chi' ix onh yutej Jehová.
Ha ix onh ik'ankoti, malaj junok komon Dios ix kolwaj yet'ok.

Ix laj yak'kan lum tzalkixtak kikej. Ha tas sq'uib'k'e t'a sat lu'um ix yak' kab'lej, ix yak'anpax nok' yalchab' tz'elta t'a yoltak k'een k'een t'ayonh yet' akeite tz'el t'a te' oliwo sq'uib' t'a skaltak k'een k'een.

Te niwan yal yim nok' ko wakax yet' nok' chiwa ix elta, ix ko b'oan queso t'ay. Ay nok' kelemtak kalnel ix ko chi'a. Ix ko chipax nok' ch'ak kalnel yet' nok' chiwa te b'ak'uech stanhwaj t'a Basán. Ha wal ixim trigo te wach' ix ko wa''a, ix kuk'an wino, haton yal sat te' uwa.
Ex wetchonhab', haxo yik ix ex b'ak'uechb'i a ex chonhab' Jesurún ex tik, ix eyik'anel he b'a t'a Jehová ix onh b'oani, ix he patikejkanel ko Kolumal chi'.
Ix he tzuntzej wal kot yowal sk'ol Jehová, yujto ix ex och ejmelal t'a juntzanh ch'ok diosal chakb'ilel yuj.

Ix eyak'an he silab' t'a juntzanh enemigo, juntzanh manh diosok, t'a juntzanh komon Dios manta b'aj tzeyak'em he b'a, juntzanh komon Dios toto sb'ojik'ei, b'aj manh yak'nakok em sb'a heb' ko mam kicham.
Ha ex wetisraelal ex tik, ix b'at satk'olal eyuuj mach ix onh b'oani yet' ko Kolumal. Majxo he nakot ko Diosal ix onh ak'an pitzwok.
Yuj chi' ix kot yowal sk'ol Jehová ayik ix yilan juntzanh chi', ix ex spatikejkanel a ex yuninal ex tik.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Manhxo ol in b'at k'elan t'a heb', ol wila'' tas ol yutok sb'a heb'. Wal yel a juntzanh anima tik te malaj swach'il heb', max yal-laj wak'anoch heb' yipok in k'ool.

Ix stzuntzejkot wowal heb' yuj juntzanh sdiosal to manh diosok. Ix chichon in k'ol t'a heb' yuj juntzanh Dios malaj yelk'och chi'. Wuuj, ol tz'a sk'ool heb' yuj juntzanhxo chonhab' malaj yelk'ochi. Hanhejtona', ol in tzuntzejkot yowal heb' yuj tas ol wak' t'a juntzanhxo anima manto nachajel yuj.
Ix te kot wal yowal in k'ool, icha sk'e nhilnhon yok te' k'ak'. Masanil tas ay t'a yich lum lum stz'akanb'at yuj, scha sk'ak'al lu'um masanto sk'och t'a yich niwak witz.
Ichato ol in julb'at juntzanh jul-lab' t'a yib'anh heb', syalelk'ochi to ol wak'b'at masanil makanhil yaelal t'a yib'anh heb'. Haton juntzanh tik:
Wejel, k'ak'al ilya te ow, jun yaelal te ow satanel anima. Ol wak'anb'at nok' chium nok' t'a skal heb' yet' nok' chan te ow swenenoal.
Ol laj cham yuninal heb' t'a yoltak kalle yuj k'een espada. Xiwk'olalxonhej ol ajek' heb' t'a spat. Ol cham heb' kelemtak, heb' ix kob'estak, heb' icham anima yet' heb' unin tzato chuni.
Ix in na' to ol in saklemkanb'at heb' israel tik, ol in satanel heb' t'a sat lum lum tik yik wach' manhxa b'aj ol b'inaj heb'.
Palta malaj in gana tzin sb'uch heb' ajk'ool, malaj in gana syik'chaanh sb'a heb'. Talaj syal heb' icha tik: Ha onh wal ix ko satel heb' israel tik, manhok Jehová ix satanel heb', talaj xchi heb'.
Malaj jab'ok spensar heb' anima chi', max nachajel-laj yuj heb'.
Tato ay spensar heb', tzam nachajel yuj heb' tas ol elk'ochok.

¿Tas yuj ix el lemnaj mil heb' israel t'a junok heb' yajk'ool? ¿Tas yuj lajunhe' mil heb' ix el lemnaj t'a chawanhok heb'? Ha heb' ajk'ol chi' malaj jab'ok tas syal yuj heb', palta a in Jehová in Skolumal in heb' israel chi', ix wak'och heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb', xchi Jehová.
Ha heb' kajk'ol chi' yojtak heb' to a sdiosal heb' skolani, max yal slajb'an sb'a yet' ko Kolumal a onh tik.
Ha heb' kajk'ol chi' stzalaj heb' yet' chukal icha schukal heb' aj Sodoma yet' heb' aj Gomorra. Haxo stzalajk'olal heb' chi' lajan icha weneno.
Ha swino heb' lajan icha swenenoal sti' nok' chan, scham anima yuj, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Masanil chukal ix sk'ulej heb' ajk'ol chi', naannhej wuuj, ichato tonhej sik'an wuuj.
Ha innhej ay walan wik wak'anoch syaelal heb'. Ha in ol wak' spak t'a heb' icha smoj schaan heb'. Ay jun k'ual ol satel heb', yujto lak'anxo sja sk'ual. Jab'xonhej sk'och yorail satel heb', xchi.

Ha Jehová ol och yet' heb' schonhab' ayik ol yilani to manhxalaj yip heb'. Ol ok' sk'ool Jehová chi' t'a heb' schekab', ayik ol yilani to manhxa junok mach syal skolwaji, manhxalaj heb' chekab', ma heb' yik sb'a.
Ichato chi' ol sk'anb'an Jehová t'a heb' ajk'ol chi': ¿B'ajtil ay he diosal tiknaik, juntzanh tzex kolani, haton juntzanh tzeyak'och yipok he k'ool,
juntzanh schianb'at xepual he silab' yet' yuk'an he wino tzeyak' t'ay silab'il? Q'ueokab' wan he diosal chi' yik skolwaj heyet'ok. Kotokab'i yik tzex stanhwej.

Naekkoti to a innhej Dios in. Malaj junokxo Dios t'a wichanh. Ha in swak'cham anima, a in pax swak'xi pitzwok heb'. Ha in swak' echnaj heb' anima, swanhtanpax heb'. Malaj mach syal skolan sb'a t'a yol in k'ab'.
Ha in Jehová in tik, ayinnhej ek' t'a masanil tiempo, swik'chaanh in k'ab' swak'an in ti'

to ol in b'o yaj jun owal tik. Icha junok snhikk'e ye k'een yespada toxonhej skopopi yik sb'at t'a owal, icha chi' ol in k'ulej, yik ol in b'at wak' spak t'a heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, ol wak' syaelal heb' icha t'a smojal schaan heb'.

Chik'takxonhej ol aj in jul-lab' yuj schiq'uil heb'. Haxo wespada ol xikankanb'at schib'ejal heb' chamnak yet' pax heb' yamb'ilkot t'a owal. Haxo sjolom heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin chi', chik'takxonhej ol ajkanok, xchi Jehová chi'.

Ex anima t'a junjun nakión, tzalajanhek yet' schonhab' Jehová, yujto ol spaktzitej schamel heb' schekab'. Ol satel heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'a heb', ol yak'an tup smul heb' schonhab' chi' t'a yib'anh. Ol sakb'itajxi slum heb' yuj Jehová, haton b'aj ix laj emkan schiq'uil heb', xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix k'och winhaj Moisés t'a yichanh masanil chonhab' Israel, tzak'anoch winhaj Josué yuninal winhaj Nun yuj winh, ix yalan masanil slolonelal jun b'it tik winh t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh icha tik:
Ha tas ix wal tik t'ayex, naannhejokab' eyuj t'a masanil tiempo. Hak'uekoch t'a he k'ool. k'ayb'ejek heb' eyuninal yik ol sk'anab'ajej jun ley tik heb' sik'lab'il.
Manh komon lolonelok juntzanh tik, palta to ay he k 'inal yuj. Tato tze k'anab'ajej smasanil, ol najatb'ok he k 'inal t'a sat lum lum ol eyikej t'a sk'axepalek' ha' Jordán tik, xchi winh.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi' ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Q'ueanh t'a lum switzal Abarim, tzach k'ek'och t'a sjolom lum switzal Nebo t'a yol lum yik heb' moabita, t'a yichanh Jericó. Hata' ol ilkanb'at lum Canaán ol wak' t'a heb' etchonhab' tik.
Ha t'a sjolom jun lum witz b'aj ol ach k'e chi', hata' ol ach chamok, icha ix aj scham winh uk'tak aj Aarón t'a lum jolom witz Hor.
Yujto ix he tenek' tas ix wal t'ayex he chawanhil, maj in eyik'chaanh t'a yichanh heb' chonhab' israel t'a ha ha' skuchan Meriba-kades, t'a takinh lum Zin.
Yuj chi' manhxo ol ach k'ochlaj t'a lum lum ix wak' in ti' wak'an t'a heb' etchonhab' Israel, najatxonhej ol ilkanb'at lu'um, xchi t'a winh.
Ayik wan sk'och stiempoal scham winhaj Moisés schekab' Jehová, ix och ijan winh yalankan wach' lolonel t'a heb' yetisraelal.

Ix yalan winh icha tik: Skot Jehová t'a lum witz Sinaí. Hato t'a Edom syak'kot sakil k'inal t'ayonh. Hato pax t'a lum witz Parán syak'kot kopan stzikikial. Skot yet' heb' yángel manhxo b'ischajb'enok. Ha t'a swach' k'ab' yet'nak ley, sk'e nhilnhon sk'ak'al.
Ha Jehová sxajanan heb' schonhab', stanhwej heb' yikxo. Ha heb' chi' tz'och ejmelal t'a yichanh, sk'anab'ajan scheknab'il heb'.
Ha jun ley swak'kan tik, ichato smakb'en heb' yinhtilal Jacob yaji.
Ha Jehová ayoch reyal t'a Jesurún, ayik smolb'an sb'a heb' yajalil chonhab', ayik smolb'an sb'a masanil heb' yinhtilal Israel, xchi winh.

Ix syamanoch winh yalankan wach' lolonel t'a yib'anh junjun inhtilal. Ix yalan winh yuj heb' yinhtilal Rubén icha tik: Aynhejokab' ek' heb' yinhtilal Rubén. Mokab' satel heb', mokab' kennhejok ol aj sb'isul heb', xchi winh.

Ix yalanpax winh yuj heb' yinhtilal Judá icha tik: Mamin Jehová, ab' tas syal heb' yinhtilal Judá. Ik' meltzaj heb' t'a schonhab', kolwajanh yet' a poder yik syal stek'b'an sb'a heb' t'a yichanh heb' yajk'ool, xchi winh.

Ix yalanpax winh yuj heb' yinhtilal Leví icha tik: Mamin Jehová, ik k'een Tumim yet' k'een Urim, ix ak' k'een t'a winh sik'b'ilel uuj, haton winh ix ak' prowal t'a Masah, winh ix a telaj a b'a yet'ok t'a ha' Meriba.
Yelxo wal ix ach snib'ej heb' yinhtilal Leví chi' t'a yichanh smam snun, t'a yichanh yuk'tak, ma yuninal. Ha heb' chi' ix sk'anab'ajej a cheknab'il heb', maj yixtejb'at a trato heb' alb'ilkani.
Syak'nhej a ley heb' sk'ayb'ej heb' yinhtilal Jacob. Syalannhej a k'ayb'ub'al heb' t'a heb' yetisraelal. Snhusannhej inkienso heb' t'a ichanh, snhusan juntzanh silab' heb' stz'a smasanil t'a altar.

Mamin Jehová, ak' wal a wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh heb', schaokab' a k'ol yik syak'an yopisio heb' t'ayach. Tza satkanel heb' yajk'ol heb' yik wach' maxtzak k'e wan heb' schichon sk'ol t'a heb', xchi winh.
Ix yalanpax winh yuj heb' yinhtilal Benjamín icha tik: Te xajan heb' yinhtilal Benjamín yuj Jehová, t'a junk'olal ayek' heb'. Ha skolwaj yet' heb'. Ha ayoch stanhwumalok heb', xchi winh.
Ix yalanpax winh yuj heb' yinhtilal José icha tik: Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a yib'anh sluum heb' yinhtilal José. Aokab' yal ak'wal wach' tz'em t'a lu'um, ayokab' ha ha' sk'eul t'a sat lu'um.
Wach'okab' tz'aj sq'uib' sat tas tz'el t'a sat sluum heb' t'a junjun ab'il, wach'okab'pax tz'aj sat te te' t'a junjun ujal.
Niwanokab' sat te' awb'en te' wach' tz'el t'a spak'ultak lum witz aytaxonek' t'a peka' smol heb'.

Wach'okab' tz'aj sat te' awb'en te' tz'el t'a sat sluum heb' yuj swach'k'olal Jehová, haton sch'oxnak sb'a t'a skal te' q'uiix ayoch sk'ak'al. Kotokab'kan masanil juntzanh wach'k'olal tik t'a yib'anh heb' yinhtilal José, haton winh sik'b'ilel t'a skal heb' yuk'tak.

Te ay smay heb' yinhtilal José, haton heb' yinhtilal Efraín manhxo b'ischajb'enok yet' heb' yinhtilal Manasés, smilalxo heb'. Te ay smay heb' icha junok nok' mam wakax, ma icha yip junok nok' kaltakte'al wakax niwak sch'aak. Ol spech masanil chonhab' heb' masanto b'aj slajwik'och yol yib'anhk'inal, xchi winh.

Ix yalanpax winh yuj heb' yinhtilal Zabulón yet' heb' yinhtilal Isacar icha tik: Tzalajanhek ex yinhtilal Zabulón b'ajtak tzex eq'ui. Hanhejtona' ex pax tik ex yinhtilal Isacar, tzalajanhek b'ajtak kajan ex.

Tzeyawtejkot masanil heb' eyetisraelal t'a tzalkixtak, tzeyak'an silab' to scha sk'ol Jehová. Tzeyak' tzalajb'ok he k'ool yet' b'eyumal ay t'a yol ha' mar yet' juntzanh tas te wach' ay t'a stitak ha' chi', xchi winh.

Ix yalanpax winh yuj heb' yinhtilal Gad icha tik: Ik'jokab' chaanh Jehová ix ak'an lewanb'ok sluum heb' yinhtil Gad. Lajan heb' icha nok' nun choj tz'em kutzan, sjekchitanel sk'ab' yet' sjolom schib'ej. Icha chi' ol yutej heb' yajk'ool heb' yinhtil Gad chi'.

Ix sik'kanel lum lum te wach' heb' yinhtilal Gad chi'. Ha jun lu'um chi' smoj wal to ha t'a heb' yajal tz'ak'ji lu'um. Ayik ix smolb'an sb'a heb' yajalil chonhab' Israel, a heb' yinhtilal Gad ix sk'anab'ajej heb' icha wal yalan scheknab'il Jehová, xchi winh.
Ix yalanpax winh yuj heb' yinhtilal Dan icha tik: Ha wal heb' yinhtilal Dan tik lajan wal heb' icha junok nok' kelem choj ay t'a Basán sk'e tz'itnajok, xchi winh.
Ix yalanpax winh yuj heb' yinhtilal Neftalí icha tik: Ha heb' yinhtilal Neftalí tik, wach' yajkan heb' yuj swach'k'olal Jehová, yik heb' yaj lum tz'emk'och t'a sur t'a ha' nhajab', xchi winh.

Ix yalanpax winh yuj heb' yinhtilal Aser icha tik: Tzijtumokab' swach'k'olal Jehová syak' t'a heb' yinhtilal Aser, xajanokab' heb' yuj heb' yetisraelal. Ochokab' heb' b'eyumal yuj yakeiteal te' oliwo ay t'a sluum.
Aokab' k'een hierro yet' k'een bronke tzek' k'atan syamnub'alok spuertail schonhab' heb'. Tek'anokab' heb' t'a masanil tiempo.
Ex Jesurún, malaj mach syal slajb'an sb'a yet' ko Diosal. Te ay smay sb'eyek' t'a yib'anh asun ayik sjawi onh skolo'.
Ha Dios aynhejek' ket'ok. T'a masanil tiempo tzonh stanhwej. Ha jantak spoder malaj slajwub', tzonh skol sik'lab'il. Ha Jehová ol ik'anel heb' kajk'ol t'a kichanh, ol yalani to ol ko satel heb'.

Ha onh israel yinhtil onh winhaj Jacob tik, junk'olal ol onh ajnhejek' yet' kinhtilal t'a ko lu'um. Te wach' ol aj ixim ko trigo yet' sat te' ko uwa, yujto manh ol och waan yak'an nhab' t'a ko lu'um tik.

Ex wetisraelal, te wach' kiko', ¿mach wal junok syal slajb'an sb'a ket'ok? Ha Jehová tzonh kolani, a tzonh tanhwani, skolwajpax ket'ok. Icha kespada yaj Jehová yik skak'an ganar heb' kajk'ool. Ol yak'em sb'a heb' kajk'ol chi' t'ayonh, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.

Ha t'a spanhanil yol yik Moab ayek' winhaj Moisés chi' ayik ix k'e winh t'a jolom witz Nebo ay t'a sjolom lum niwan witz Pisga, haton lum ay t'a yichanh Jericó. Hata' ix sch'oxkanb'at masanil lum lum Jehová yil winh: Haton masanil lum Galaad masanto b'aj ay smakb'en heb' yinhtilal Dan,
lum smakb'en heb' yik Neftalí, heb' yik Efraín, heb' yik Manasés yet' masanil lum yik heb' yik Judá, masanto sk'och lum t'a ha' mar Mediterráneo.
Skot lum t'a Neguev masanto sk'och lum t'a yak'likal sti' ha' Jordán yet' t'a masanil spatiktak Jericó schonhab'il te' palma, masanto sk'och lum t'a Zoar.

Ix yalan Jehová chi' t'a winh icha tik: Haton jun lu'um tik wak'nak in ti' wak'an t'a winhaj Abraham, t'a winhaj Isaac yet' t'a winhaj Jacob. Walannak t'a heb' winh icha tik: Ha jun lu'um tik ol wak' t'a heb' eyinhtilal, xin chi, yuj chi' tzin ch'oxkanb'at lum t'ayach, wach'chom manhxo ol ach k'och t'a lu'um, xchi Jehová chi' t'a winh.
Ixlajwi chi', hata' ix cham winhaj Moisés schekab' Jehová chi', t'a yol yik Moab, icha ix aj yalan Jehová chi' t'a winh.
Ha t'a jun ch'olan t'a yol yik Moab t'a yichanh Bet-peor ix mukji winh yuj Jehová chi', palta malaj mach ojtannak jun b'aj mukankan sniwanil winh chi'.
120 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix cham winh. Wach'to yilan winh, tek'antopax winh ayik ix cham winh chi'.
Jun wal ujal ix och heb' chonhab' israel t'a kusk'olal yuj schamel winh chi' t'a tzinan lu'um yik Moab, icha sb'eyb'al heb'.

Ayik manto cham winhaj Moisés chi', ix yak'kanb'at sk'ab' winh t'a yib'anh winhaj Josué yuninal winhaj Nun yik schaankan sjelanil winh yet' yopisio icha ix aj yalan Jehová. Yuj chi' a heb' chonhab' israel, ix sk'anab'ajej heb' tas ix yal winhaj Josué chi'.
Atax t'a jun pekti' chi', manhxa junokxo schekab' Jehová t'a skal heb' chonhab' israel k'elk'umb'a ix aj Jehová ix lolon yet'ok, icha ix aj slolon yet' winhaj Moisés.

Manhxa junokxo mach ix k'ulan tas satub'tak yilji yet' milagro icha sk'ulejnak Jehová yet' winhaj Moisés chi' t'a yol yik Egipto t'a yichanh winh rey yet' t'a yichanh heb' ayoch yajalil yet' winh yet' t'a masanil heb' aj Egipto chi'.
Malaj junokxo mach niwan yelk'och sk'ulan tastak ay smay icha sk'ulejnak winhaj Moisés t'a yichanh heb' yetisraelal.
